verses.translation: In peace, their bodies' duality is eliminated.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai sahaj man bhiaa ana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Bliss comes naturally to their minds.
They meet the Lord, the Embodiment of Supreme Bliss. ||5||
In peaceful poise, they drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
In peace and poise, they give to the poor.
Their souls naturally delight in the Lord's Sermon.
The Imperishable Lord abides with them. ||6||
In peace and poise, they assume the unchanging position.
In peace and poise, the unstruck vibration of the Shabad resounds.
In peace and poise, the celestial bells resound.
Within their homes, the Supreme Lord God is pervading. ||7||
With intuitive ease, they meet the Lord, according to their karma.
With intuitive ease, they meet with the Guru, in the true Dharma.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai sahaj bhiaa so jaanai ||
verses.translation: Those who know, attain the poise of intuitive peace.
Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||8||3||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
First, they come forth from the womb.
They become attached to their children, spouses and families.

verses.original: ਭੋਜਨੁ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਬਹੁ ਕਪਰੇ ॥ ਸਰਪਰ ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰਹਿਗੇ ਬਪੁਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhojan anik prakaar bahu kapare || sarapar gavan karahige bapure ||1||
verses.translation: The foods of various sorts and appearances will surely pass away, O wretched mortal! ||1||

verses.original: ਕਵਨੁ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ਜੋ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਟਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kavan asathaan jo kabahu na Tarai ||
verses.translation: What is that place which never perishes?

verses.original: ਕਵਨੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kavan sabadh jit dhuramat harai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: What is that Word by which the dirt of the mind is removed? ||1||Pause||
In the Realm of Indra, death is sure and certain.
The Realm of Brahma shall not remain permanent.
The Realm of Shiva shall also perish.
The three dispositions, Maya and the demons shall vanish. ||2||

verses.original: ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰ ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨ ਅਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gir tar dharan gagan ar taare ||
verses.translation: The mountains, the trees, the earth, the sky and the stars;
the sun, the moon, the wind, water and fire;
day and night, fasting days and their determination;
the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas shall pass away. ||3||
The sacred shrines of pilgrimage, gods, temples and holy books;
rosaries, ceremonial tilak marks on the forehead, meditative people, the pure, and the performers of burnt offerings;
wearing loin cloths, bowing in reverence and the enjoyment of sacred foods
- all these, and all people, shall pass away. ||4||
Social classes, races, Muslims and Hindus;
beasts, birds and the many varieties of beings and creatures;
the entire world and the visible universe
- all forms of existence shall pass away. ||5||
Through the Praises of the Lord, devotional worship, spiritual wisdom and the essence of reality,
eternal bliss and the imperishable true place are obtained.
There, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord's Glorious Praises are sung with love.
There, in the city of fearlessness, He dwells forever. ||6||

verses.original: ਤਹ ਭਉ ਭਰਮਾ ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: teh bhau bharamaa sog na chi(n)taa ||
verses.translation: There is no fear, doubt, suffering or anxiety there;
there is no coming or going, and no death there.
There is eternal bliss, and the unstruck celestial music there.
The devotees dwell there, with the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises as their support. ||7||
There is no end or limitation to the Supreme Lord God.
Who can embrace His contemplation?
Says Nanak, when the Lord showers His Mercy,
the imperishable home is obtained; in the Saadh Sangat, you shall be saved. ||8||4||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
One who kills this is a spiritual hero.
One who kills this is perfect.
One who kills this obtains glorious greatness.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo is maare tis kaa dhukh jaiee ||1||
verses.translation: One who kills this is freed of suffering. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਕੋਇ ਜਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa koi j dhubidhaa maar gavaavai ||
verses.translation: How rare is such a person, who kills and casts off duality.

verses.original: ਇਸਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eiseh maar raaj jog kamaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Killing it, he attains Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo is maare tis kau bhau naeh ||
verses.translation: One who kills this has no fear.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo is maare su naam samaeh ||
verses.translation: One who kills this is absorbed in the Naam.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo is maare tis kee tirasanaa bujhai ||
verses.translation: One who kills this has his desires quenched.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਿਝੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo is maare su dharageh sijhai ||2||
verses.translation: One who kills this is approved in the Court of the Lord. ||2||
One who kills this is wealthy and prosperous.
One who kills this is honorable.
One who kills this is truly a celibate.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਤੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo is maare tis hovai gatee ||3||
verses.translation: One who kills this attains salvation. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਆਇਆ ਗਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo is maare tis kaa aaiaa ganee ||
verses.translation: One who kills this - his coming is auspicious.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਧਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo is maare su nihachal dhanee ||
verses.translation: One who kills this is steady and wealthy.
One who kills this is very fortunate.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jo is maare su anadhin jaagaa ||4||
verses.translation: One who kills this remains awake and aware, night and day. ||4||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo is maare su jeevan mukataa ||
verses.translation: One who kills this is Jivan Mukta, liberated while yet alive.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo is maare tis kee niramal jugataa ||
verses.translation: One who kills this lives a pure lifestyle.
One who kills this is spiritually wise.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jo is maare su sahaj dhiaanee ||5||
verses.translation: One who kills this meditates intuitively. ||5||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਰੈ ॥ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਮ ਜਾਪ ਤਪ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: eis maaree bin thai na parai || koT karam jaap tap karai ||
verses.translation: Without killing this, one is not acceptable, even though one may perform millions of rituals, chants and austerities.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: eis maaree bin janam na miTai ||
verses.translation: Without killing this, one does not escape the cycle of reincarnation.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: eis maaree bin jam te nahee chhuTai ||6||
verses.translation: Without killing this, one does not escape death. ||6||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: eis maaree bin giaan na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Without killing this, one does not obtain spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਧੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: eis maaree bin jooTh na dhoiee ||
verses.translation: Without killing this, one's impurity is not washed off.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: eis maaree bin sabh kichh mailaa ||
verses.translation: Without killing this, everything is filthy.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਉਲਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: eis maaree bin sabh kichh jaulaa ||7||
verses.translation: Without killing this, everything is a losing game. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau bhe kirapaal kirapaa nidh ||
verses.translation: When the Lord, the Treasure of Mercy, bestows His Mercy,

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਈ ਖਲਾਸੀ ਹੋਈ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: tis bhiee khalaasee hoiee sagal sidh ||
verses.translation: one obtains release, and attains total perfection.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur dhubidhaa jaa kee hai maaree ||
verses.translation: One whose duality has been killed by the Guru,
says Nanak, contemplates God. ||8||5||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਤ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: har siau jurai ta sabh ko meet ||
verses.translation: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, then everyone is his friend.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਤ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: har siau jurai ta nihachal cheet ||
verses.translation: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, then his consciousness is steady.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕਾੜੑਾ ॥
verses.translit: har siau jurai na viaapai kaaR(h)aa ||
verses.translation: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, he is not afflicted by worries.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਤ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har siau jurai ta hoi nisataaraa ||1||
verses.translation: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, he is emancipated. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: re man mere too(n) har siau jor ||
verses.translation: O my mind, unite yourself with the Lord.
Nothing else is of any use to you. ||1||Pause||
The great and powerful people of the world
are of no use, you fool!

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲੁ ਸੁਣਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa dhaas neech kul suneh ||
verses.translation: The Lord's slave may be born of humble origins,

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਧਰਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tis kai sa(n)g khin meh udhareh ||2||
verses.translation: but in his company, you shall be saved in an instant. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਜਨ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: koT majan jaa kai sun naam ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is equal to millions of cleansing baths.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
verses.translit: koT poojaa jaa kai hai dhiaan ||
verses.translation: Meditating on it is equal to millions of worship ceremonies.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: koT pu(n)n sun har kee baanee ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Word of the Lord's Bani is equal to giving millions in alms.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਫਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: koT falaa gur te bidh jaanee ||3||
verses.translation: To know the way, through the Guru, is equal to millions of rewards. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਚੇਤ ॥
verses.translit: man apune meh fir fir chet ||
verses.translation: Within your mind, over and over again, think of Him,
and your love of Maya shall depart.
The Imperishable Lord is always with you.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਚੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: man mere rach raam kai ra(n)g ||4||
verses.translation: O my mind, immerse yourself in the Love of the Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਭ ਭੂਖ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai kaam utarai sabh bhookh ||
verses.translation: Working for Him, all hunger departs.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਦੂਤ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai kaam na joheh dhoot ||
verses.translation: Working for Him, the Messenger of Death will not be watching you.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਗਮਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai kaam teraa vadd gamar ||
verses.translation: Working for Him, you shall obtain glorious greatness.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਮਰੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jaa kai kaam hoveh too(n) amar ||5||
verses.translation: Working for Him, you shall become immortal. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਕਉ ਨਹੀ ਡਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jaa ke chaakar kau nahee ddaan ||
verses.translation: His servant does not suffer punishment.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਕਉ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jaa ke chaakar kau nahee baan ||
verses.translation: His servant suffers no loss.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦਫਤਰਿ ਪੁਛੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai dhafatar puchhai na lekhaa ||
verses.translation: In His Court, His servant does not have to answer for his account.
So serve Him with distinction. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਊਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai uoon naahee kaahoo baat ||
verses.translation: He is not lacking in anything.
He Himself is One, although He appears in so many forms.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee dhirasaT hoi sadhaa nihaal ||
verses.translation: By His Glance of Grace, you shall be happy forever.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਘਾਲ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: man mere kar taa kee ghaal ||7||
verses.translation: So work for Him, O my mind. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੂੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa ko chatur naahee ko mooRaa ||
verses.translation: No one is clever, and no one is foolish.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa ko heen naahee ko sooraa ||
verses.translation: No one is weak, and no one is a hero.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: jit ko laiaa tit hee laagaa ||
verses.translation: As the Lord attaches someone, so is he attached.
He alone is the Lord's servant, O Nanak, who is so blessed. ||8||6||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one's life is like that of a snake.
This is how the faithless cynic lives, forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: ek nimakh jo simaran meh jeeaa ||
verses.translation: One who lives in meditative remembrance, even for an instant,

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਦਿਨਸ ਲਾਖ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: koT dhinas laakh sadhaa thir theeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: lives for hundreds of thousands and millions of days, and becomes stable forever. ||1||Pause||
Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one's actions and works are cursed.
Like the crow's beak, he dwells in manure. ||2||
Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one acts like a dog.
The faithless cynic is nameless, like the prostitute's son. ||3||
Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a horned ram.
The faithless cynic barks out his lies, and his face is blackened. ||4||
Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a donkey.
The faithless cynic wanders around in polluted places. ||5||
Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a mad dog.
The greedy, faithless cynic falls into entanglements. ||6||
Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, he murders his own soul.

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਨੀਚ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: saakat neech tis kul nahee jaatee ||7||
verses.translation: The faithless cynic is wretched, without family or social standing. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis bhiaa kirapaal tis satasa(n)g milaiaa ||
verses.translation: When the Lord becomes merciful, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
Says Nanak, the Guru has saved the world. ||8||7||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan moh param gat paiee ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Word, I have attained the supreme status.
The Perfect Guru has preserved my honor. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan dhiaaio moh naau ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Word, I meditate on the Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh moh miliaa thaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained a place of rest. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਰਸਨ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan sun rasan vakhaanee ||
verses.translation: I listen to the Guru's Word, and chant it with my tongue.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te a(n)mirat meree baanee ||2||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, my speech is like nectar. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan miTiaa meraa aap ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Word, my selfishness and conceit have been removed.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur kee dhiaa te meraa vadd parataap ||3||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's kindness, I have obtained glorious greatness. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan miTiaa meraa bharam ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Word, my doubts have been removed.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan pekhio sabh braham ||4||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Word, I see God everywhere. ||4||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan keeno raaj jog ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Word, I practice Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gur kai sa(n)g tariaa sabh log ||5||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Guru, all the people of the world are saved. ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan mere kaaraj sidh ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Word, my affairs are resolved.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan paiaa naau nidh ||6||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Word, I have obtained the nine treasures. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin jin keenee mere gur kee aasaa ||
verses.translation: Whoever places his hopes in my Guru,

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: tis kee kaTeeaai jam kee faasaa ||7||
verses.translation: has the noose of death cut away. ||7||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan jaagiaa meraa karam ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Word, my good karma has been awakened.
O Nanak, meeting with the Guru, I have found the Supreme Lord God. ||8||8||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: tis gur kau simarau saas saas ||
verses.translation: I remember the Guru with each and every breath.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur mere praan satigur meree raas ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru is my breath of life, the True Guru is my wealth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa dharasan dhekh dhekh jeevaa ||
verses.translation: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I live.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur ke charan dhoi dhoi peevaa ||1||
verses.translation: I wash the Guru's Feet, and drink in this water. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਨਿਤ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee ren nit majan karau ||
verses.translation: I take my daily bath in the dust of the Guru's Feet.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਹਰਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: janam janam kee haumai mal harau ||2||
verses.translation: The egotistical filth of countless incarnations is washed off. ||2||
I wave the fan over the Guru.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤੇ ਹਾਥੁ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mahaa agan te haath dhe raakhaa ||3||
verses.translation: Giving me His Hand, He has saved me from the great fire. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਢੋਵਉ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: tis gur kai gireh ddovau paanee ||
verses.translation: I carry water for the Guru's household;

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਅਕਲ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jis gur te akal gat jaanee ||4||
verses.translation: from the Guru, I have learned the Way of the One Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪੀਸਉ ਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: tis gur kai gireh peesau neet ||
verses.translation: I grind the corn for the Guru's household.
By His Grace, all my enemies have become friends. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin gur mo kau dheenaa jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Guru who gave me my soul,
has Himself purchased me, and made me His slave. ||6||
He Himself has blessed me with His Love.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਕਰੀ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa tis gur kau karee namasakaar ||7||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, I humbly bow to the Guru. ||7||

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਭੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: kal kales bhai bhram dhukh laathaa ||
verses.translation: My troubles, conflicts, fears, doubts and pains have been dispelled;
says Nanak, my Guru is All-powerful. ||8||9||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: mil mere gobi(n)dh apanaa naam dheh ||
verses.translation: Meet me, O my Lord of the Universe. Please bless me with Your Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਅਸਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam binaa dhirag dhirag asaneh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, cursed, cursed is love and intimacy. ||1||Pause||
Without the Naam, one who dresses and eats well
is like a dog, who falls in and eats impure foods. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜੇਤਾ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥ ਜਿਉ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam binaa jetaa biauhaar || jiau mritak mithiaa seegaar ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, all occupations are useless, like decorations on a dead body. ||2||
One who forgets the Naam and indulges in pleasures,

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਹੀ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੋਗ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sukh supanai nahee tan meh rog ||3||
verses.translation: shall find no peace, even in dreams; his body shall become diseased. ||3||
One who renounces the Naam and engages in other occupations,
shall see all of his false pretenses fall away. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: naam sa(n)g man preet na laavai ||
verses.translation: One whose mind does not embrace love for the Naam
shall go to hell, even though he may perform millions of ceremonial rituals. ||5||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਆਰਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam jin man na aaraadhaa ||
verses.translation: One whose mind does not contemplate the Name of the Lord

verses.original: ਚੋਰ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: chor kee niaaiee jam pur baadhaa ||6||
verses.translation: is bound like a thief, in the City of Death. ||6||
Hundreds of thousands of ostentatious shows and great expanses
- without the Naam, all these displays are false. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam soiee jan lei ||
verses.translation: That humble being repeats the Name of the Lord,
O Nanak, whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy. ||8||10||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਜੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਨਿਬਾਹੈ ॥ ਸੋ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਚਾਹੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aadh madh jo a(n)t nibaahai || so saajan meraa man chaahai ||1||
verses.translation: My mind longs for that Friend, who shall stand by me in the beginning, in the middle and in the end. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: har kee preet sadhaa sa(n)g chaalai ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Love goes with us forever.
The Perfect and Merciful Lord cherishes all. ||1||Pause||
He shall never perish, and He shall never abandon me.
Wherever I look, there I see Him pervading and permeating. ||2||
He is Beautiful, All-knowing, the most Clever, the Giver of life.
God is my Brother, Son, Father and Mother. ||3||
He is the Support of the breath of life; He is my Wealth.
Abiding within my heart, He inspires me to enshrine love for Him. ||4||
The Lord of the World has cut away the noose of Maya.
He has made me His own, blessing me with His Glance of Grace. ||5||
Remembering, remembering Him in meditation, all diseases are healed.
Meditating on His Feet, all comforts are enjoyed. ||6||
The Perfect Primal Lord is Ever-fresh and Ever-young.
The Lord is with me, inwardly and outwardly, as my Protector. ||7||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨ ॥ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਦੀਨ ॥੮॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak har har padh cheen || sarabas naam bhagat kau dheen ||8||11||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, that devotee who realizes the state of the Lord, Har, Har, is blessed with the treasure of the Naam. ||8||11||
Raag Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰੇ ਅਸੰਖ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: khojat fire asa(n)kh a(n)t na paareeaa ||
verses.translation: Countless are those who wander around searching for You, but they do not find Your limits.
They alone are Your devotees, who are blessed by Your Grace. ||1||
I am a sacrifice, I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਡਰਾਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਭੈਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sun sun pa(n)th ddaraau bahut bhaihaareeaa ||
verses.translation: Continually hearing of the terrifying path, I am so afraid.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਤਕੀ ਓਟ ਸੰਤਾਹ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mai takee oT sa(n)taeh leh ubaareeaa ||2||
verses.translation: I have sought the Protection of the Saints; please, save me! ||2||
The Fascinating and Beauteous Beloved is the Giver of support to all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਿਖਾਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur niv niv laagau pai dheh dhikhaareeaa ||3||
verses.translation: I bow low and fall at the Feet of the Guru; if only I could see the Lord! ||3||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਕੀਏ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਨੇਕ ਇਕਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: mai ke'ee mitr anek ikas balihaareeaa ||
verses.translation: I have made many friends, but I am a sacrifice to the One alone.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੀਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sabh gun kis hee naeh har poor bha(n)ddaareeaa ||4||
verses.translation: No one has all virtues; the Lord alone is filled to overflowing with them. ||4||

verses.original: ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਸੂਖਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: chahu dhis japeeaai naau sookh savaareeaa ||
verses.translation: His Name is chanted in the four directions; those who chant it are embellished with peace.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਆਹੀ ਓੜਿ ਤੁਹਾਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: mai aahee oR tuhaar naanak balihaareeaa ||5||
verses.translation: I seek Your Protection; Nanak is a sacrifice to You. ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢਿਓ ਭੁਜਾ ਪਸਾਰਿ ਮੋਹ ਕੂਪਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaaddio bhujaa pasaar moh koopaareeaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru reached out to me, and gave me His Arm; He lifted me up, out of the pit of emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਜੀਤਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: mai jeetio janam apaar bahur na haareeaa ||6||
verses.translation: I have won the incomparable life, and I shall not lose it again. ||6||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: mai paio sarab nidhaan akath kathaareeaa ||
verses.translation: I have obtained the treasure of all; His Speech is unspoken and subtle.
In the Court of the Lord, I am honored and glorified; I swing my arms in joy. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਧਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਅਪਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ladhaa ratan amol apaareeaa ||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has received the invaluable and incomparable jewel.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਕਹਉ ਪੁਕਾਰੀਆ ॥੮॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa bhaujal tareeaai kahau pukaareeaa ||8||12||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean; I proclaim this loudly to all. ||8||12||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Dye yourself in the color of the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਮੰਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jap jihavaa har ek ma(n)go ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the One Lord with your tongue, and ask for Him alone. ||1||Pause||
Renounce your ego, and dwell upon the spiritual wisdom of the Guru.
Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, join the Sangat, the Holy Congregation. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਗਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: jo dheesai so sa(n)g na gio ||
verses.translation: Whatever you see, shall not go with you.
The foolish, faithless cynics are attached - they waste away and die. ||2||
The Name of the Fascinating Lord is all-pervading forever.
Among millions, how rare is that Gurmukh who attains the Name. ||3||
Greet the Lord's Saints humbly, with deep respect.
You shall obtain the nine treasures, and receive infinite peace. ||4||
With your eyes, behold the holy people;
in your heart, sing the treasure of the Naam. ||5||
Abandon sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment.
Thus you shall be rid of both birth and death. ||6||
Pain and darkness shall depart from your home,
when the Guru implants spiritual wisdom within you, and lights that lamp. ||7||
One who serves the Lord crosses over to the other side.
O servant Nanak, the Gurmukh saves the world. ||8||1||13||
Fifth Mehla, Gauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਭਰਮ ਗਏ ॥
verses.translit: har har gur gur karat bharam ge ||
verses.translation: Dwelling upon the Lord, Har, Har, and the Guru, the Guru, my doubts have been dispelled.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: merai man sabh sukh paio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My mind has obtained all comforts. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਲਤੋ ਜਲਤੋ ਤਉਕਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: balato jalato taukiaa gur cha(n)dhan seetalaio ||1||
verses.translation: I was burning, on fire, and the Guru poured water on me; He is cooling and soothing, like the sandalwood tree. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੀਪਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: agiaan a(n)dheraa miT giaa gur giaan dheepaio ||2||
verses.translation: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled; the Guru has lit the lamp of spiritual wisdom. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਾਵਕੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗਹਰੋ ਚਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਨਾਵ ਤਰਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paavak saagar gaharo char sa(n)tan naav taraio ||3||
verses.translation: The ocean of fire is so deep; the Saints have crossed over, in the boat of the Lord's Name. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਹਮ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਚ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਆਪਾਇਓ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naa ham karam na dharam such prabh geh bhujaa aapaio ||4||
verses.translation: I have no good karma; I have no Dharmic faith or purity. But God has taken me by the arm, and made me His own. ||4||

verses.original: ਭਉ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੋ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਓ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: bhau kha(n)ddan dhukh bha(n)jano bhagat vachhal har naio ||5||
verses.translation: The Destroyer of fear, the Dispeller of pain, the Lover of His Saints - these are the Names of the Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਅਨਾਥਹ ਨਾਥ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਸੰਤ ਓਟਾਇਓ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: anaatheh naath kirapaal dheen sa(n)mrith sa(n)t oTaio ||6||
verses.translation: He is the Master of the masterless, Merciful to the meek, All-powerful, the Support of His Saints. ||6||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: niraguneeaare kee benatee dheh dharas har raio ||7||
verses.translation: I am worthless - I offer this prayer, O my Lord King: ""Please, grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.""||7||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਇਓ ॥੮॥੨॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak saran tuhaaree Thaakur sevak dhuaarai aaio ||8||2||14||
verses.translation: Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, O my Lord and Master; Your servant has come to Your Door. ||8||2||14||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਭੋਗਾ ਇਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਅੰਧ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g sa(n)g bikhiaa ke bhogaa in sa(n)g a(n)dh na jaanee ||1||
verses.translation: He is immersed in the enjoyment of corrupt pleasures; engrossed in them, the blind fool does not understand. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਸੰਚਉ ਹਉ ਖਾਟਤਾ ਸਗਲੀ ਅਵਧ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau sa(n)chau hau khaaTataa sagalee avadh bihaanee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: "I am earning profits, I am getting rich", he says, as his life passes away. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਸੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਹਉ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hau sooraa paradhaan hau ko naahee mujheh samaanee ||2||
verses.translation: "I am a hero, I am famous and distinguished; no one is equal to me."||2||

verses.original: ਜੋਬਨਵੰਤ ਅਚਾਰ ਕੁਲੀਨਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jobanava(n)t achaar kuleenaa man meh hoi gumaanee ||3||
verses.translation: "I am young, cultured, and born of a good family." In his mind, he is proud and arrogant like this. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਉਲਝਾਇਓ ਬਾਧ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਾ ਮਰਤਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਸਰਾਨੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jiau ulajhaio baadh budh kaa maratiaa nahee bisaraanee ||4||
verses.translation: He is trapped by his false intellect, and he does not forget this until he dies. ||4||

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਸਖੇ ਪਾਛੇ ਤਿਨਹੂ ਕਉ ਸੰਪਾਨੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: bhaiee meet ba(n)dhap sakhe paachhe tinahoo kau sa(n)paanee ||5||
verses.translation: Brothers, friends, relatives and companions who live after him - he entrusts his wealth to them. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਮਨੁ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਨੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jit laago man baasanaa a(n)t saiee pragaTaanee ||6||
verses.translation: That desire, to which the mind is attached, at the last moment, becomes manifest. ||6||

verses.original: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਚਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਇਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਬੰਧਾਨੀ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aha(n)budh such karam kar ieh ba(n)dhan ba(n)dhaanee ||7||
verses.translation: He may perform religious deeds, but his mind is egotistical, and he is bound by these bonds. ||7||

verses.original: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਨੀ ॥੮॥੩॥੧੫॥੪੪॥ ਜੁਮਲਾ
verses.translit: dhiaal purakh kirapaa karahu naanak dhaas dhasaanee ||8||3||15||44|| jumalaa
verses.translation: O Merciful Lord, please bless me Your Mercy, that Nanak may become the slave of Your slaves. ||8||3||15||44||Total||
One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

verses.translit: raag gauRee poorabee chha(n)t mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Chhant, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੁੰਧ ਰੈਣਿ ਦੁਹੇਲੜੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dh rain dhuhelaReeaa jeeau needh na aavai ||
verses.translation: For the bride, the night is painful; sleep does not come.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਦੁਬਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਹਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: saa dhan dhubaleeaa jeeau pir kai haavai ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride has grown weak, in the pain of separation from her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਧਨ ਥੀਈ ਦੁਬਲਿ ਕੰਤ ਹਾਵੈ ਕੇਵ ਨੈਣੀ ਦੇਖਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhan theeiee dhubal ka(n)t haavai kev nainee dhekhe ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride is wasting away, in the pain of separation from her Husband; how can she see Him with her eyes?

verses.original: ਸੀਗਾਰ ਮਿਠ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਜਨ ਸਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਏ ॥
verses.translit: seegaar miTh ras bhog bhojan sabh jhooTh kitai na lekhe ||
verses.translation: Her decorations, sweet foods, sensuous pleasures and delicacies are all false; they are of no account at all.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮਤ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਾਲੀ ਦੁਧਾ ਥਣੀ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: mai mat joban garab gaalee dhudhaa thanee na aave ||
verses.translation: Intoxicated with the wine of youthful pride, she has been ruined, and her breasts no longer yield milk.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak saa dhan milai milaiee bin pir needh na aave ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride meets her Husband Lord, when He causes her to meet Him; without Him, sleep does not come to her. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੁੰਧ ਨਿਮਾਨੜੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਧਨੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dh nimaanaReeaa jeeau bin dhanee piaare ||
verses.translation: The bride is dishonored without her Beloved Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kiau sukh paavaigee bin ur dhaare ||
verses.translation: How can she find peace, without enshrining Him in her heart?

verses.original: ਨਾਹ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: naeh bin ghar vaas naahee puchhahu sakhee saheleeaa ||
verses.translation: Without her Husband, her home is not worth living in; go and ask your sisters and companions.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਵਸਹਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੀਆ ॥ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਜਨ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bin naam preet piaar naahee vaseh saach suheleeaa || sach man sajan sa(n)tokh melaa gurmatee sahu jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Without Naam, the Name of the Lord, there is no love and affection; but with her True Lord, she abides in peace. Through mental truth and contentment, union with the True Friend is attained; through the Guru's Teachings, the Husband Lord is known.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam na chhoddai saa dhan naam sahaj samaaneeaa ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that soul-bride who does not abandon the Naam, is intuitively absorbed in the Naam. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਹੋ ਹਮ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: mil sakhee sahelaReeho ham pir raavehaa ||
verses.translation: Come, O my sisters and companions - let's enjoy our Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੁਛਿ ਲਿਖਉਗੀ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur puchh likhaugee jeeau sabadh sanehaa ||
verses.translation: I will ask the Guru, and write His Word as my love-note.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh saachaa gur dhikhaiaa manmukhee pachhutaaneeaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru has shown me the True Word of the Shabad. The self-willed manmukhs will regret and repent.

verses.original: ਨਿਕਸਿ ਜਾਤਉ ਰਹੈ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜਾਮਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: nikas jaatau rahai asathir jaam sach pachhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: My wandering mind became steady, when I recognized the True One.

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਉਤਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਵੇਲਓ ॥
verses.translit: saach kee mat sadhaa nautan sabadh neh navelo ||
verses.translation: The Teachings of Truth are forever new; the love of the Shabad is forever fresh.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee sahaj saachaa milahu sakhee saheleeho ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Glance of Grace of the True Lord, celestial peace is obtained; let's meet Him, O my sisters and companions. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ ਜੀਉ ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: meree ichh punee jeeau ham ghar saajan aaiaa ||
verses.translation: My desire has been fulfilled - my Friend has come to my home.
At the Union of husband and wife, the songs of rejoicing were sung.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਰਹਸੀ ਮੁੰਧ ਮਨਿ ਓਮਾਹਓ ॥
verses.translit: gun gai ma(n)gal prem rahasee mu(n)dh man omaaho ||
verses.translation: Singing the songs of joyful praise and love to Him, the soul-bride's mind is thrilled and delighted.

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਰਹੰਸੇ ਦੁਸਟ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਹਓ ॥
verses.translit: saajan raha(n)se dhusaT viaape saach jap sach laaho ||
verses.translation: My friends are happy, and my enemies are unhappy; meditating on the True Lord, the true profit is obtained.

verses.original: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਸਿ ਭਿੰਨੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar joR saa dhan karai binatee rain dhin ras bhi(n)neeaa ||
verses.translation: With her palms pressed together, the soul-bride prays, that she may remain immersed in the Love of her Lord, night and day.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰੁ ਧਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਇਛ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak pir dhan kareh raleeaa ichh meree pu(n)neeaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Husband Lord and the soul-bride revel together; my desires are fulfilled. ||4||1||
Gauree, Chhant, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜੀਉ ਏਕਲੜੀ ਬਨ ਮਾਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: sun naeh prabhoo jeeau ekalaRee ban maahe ||
verses.translation: Hear me, O my Dear Husband God - I am all alone in the wilderness.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰੈਗੀ ਨਾਹ ਬਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: kiau dheeraigee naeh binaa prabh veparavaahe ||
verses.translation: How can I find comfort without You, O my Carefree Husband God?

verses.original: ਧਨ ਨਾਹ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਬਿਖਮ ਰੈਣਿ ਘਣੇਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhan naeh baajhahu reh na saakai bikham rain ghanereeaa ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride cannot live without her Husband; the night is so painful for her.

verses.original: ਨਹ ਨੀਦ ਆਵੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮੇਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: neh needh aavai prem bhaavai sun bena(n)tee mereeaa ||
verses.translation: Sleep does not come. I am in love with my Beloved. Please, listen to my prayer!

verses.original: ਬਾਝਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਾਰੇ ਏਕਲੜੀ ਕੁਰਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: baajhahu piaare koi na saare ekalaRee kuralaae ||
verses.translation: Other than my Beloved, no one cares for me; I cry all alone in the wilderness.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak saa dhan milai milaiee bin preetam dhukh paae ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the bride meets Him when He causes her to meet Him; without her Beloved, she suffers in pain. ||1||
She is separated from her Husband Lord - who can unite her with Him?

verses.original: ਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ras prem milee jeeau sabadh suhaavai ||
verses.translation: Tasting His Love, she meets Him, through the Beautiful Word of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੇ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਦੀਪਕ ਦੇਹ ਉਜਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhe suhaavai taa pat paavai dheepak dheh ujaarai ||
verses.translation: Adorned with the Shabad, she obtains her Husband, and her body is illuminated with the lamp of spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: sun sakhee sahelee saach suhelee saache ke gun saarai ||
verses.translation: Listen, O my friends and companions - she who is at peace dwells upon the True Lord and His True Praises.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਾ ਪਿਰਿ ਰਾਵੀ ਬਿਗਸੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur melee taa pir raavee bigasee a(n)mirat baanee ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, she is ravished and enjoyed by her Husband Lord; she blossoms forth with the Ambrosial Word of His Bani.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਜਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak saa dhan taa pir raave jaa tis kai man bhaanee ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Husband Lord enjoys His bride when she is pleasing to His Mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਨੀਘਰੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa mohanee neeghareeaa jeeau kooR muThee kooRiaare ||
verses.translation: Fascination with Maya made her homeless; the false are cheated by falsehood.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਖੂਲੈ ਗਲ ਜੇਵੜੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kiau khoolai gal jevaReeaa jeeau bin gur at piaare ||
verses.translation: How can the noose around her neck be untied, without the Most Beloved Guru?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har preet piaare sabadh veechaare tis hee kaa so hovai ||
verses.translation: One who loves the Beloved Lord, and reflects upon the Shabad, belongs to Him.

verses.original: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਨਾਵਣ ਕਿਉ ਅੰਤਰ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: pu(n)n dhaan anek naavan kiau a(n)tar mal dhovai ||
verses.translation: How can giving donations to charities and countless cleansing baths wash off the filth within the heart?

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਗਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਬੇਬਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: naam binaa gat koi na paavai haTh nigreh bebaanai ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, no one attains salvation. Stubborn self-discipline and living in the wilderness are of no use at all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚ ਘਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak sach ghar sabadh sin(j)aapai dhubidhaa mahal k jaanai ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the home of Truth is attained through the Shabad. How can the Mansion of His Presence be known through duality? ||3||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: teraa naam sachaa jeeau sabadh sachaa veechaaro ||
verses.translation: True is Your Name, O Dear Lord; True is contemplation of Your Shabad.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: teraa mahal sachaa jeeau naam sachaa vaapaaro ||
verses.translation: True is the Mansion of Your Presence, O Dear Lord, and True is trade in Your Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: naam kaa vaapaar meeThaa bhagat laahaa anadhino ||
verses.translation: Trade in Your Name is very sweet; the devotees earn this profit night and day.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: tis baajh vakhar koi na soojhai naam levahu khin khino ||
verses.translation: Other than this, I can think of no other merchandise. So chant the Naam each and every moment.

verses.original: ਪਰਖਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: parakh lekhaa nadhar saachee karam poorai paiaa ||
verses.translation: The account is read; by the Grace of the True Lord and good karma, the Perfect Lord is obtained.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam mahaa ras meeThaa gur poorai sach paiaa ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Nectar of the Name is so sweet. Through the Perfect True Guru, it is obtained. ||4||2||

verses.translit: raag gauRee poorabee chha(n)t mahalaa teejaa
verses.translation: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Chhant, Third Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saa dhan binau kare jeeau har ke gun saare ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride offers her prayers to her Dear Lord; she dwells upon His Glorious Virtues.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: khin pal reh na sakai jeeau bin har piaare ||
verses.translation: She cannot live without her Beloved Lord, for a moment, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: bin har piaare reh na saakai gur bin mahal na paieeaai ||
verses.translation: She cannot live without her Beloved Lord; without the Guru, the Mansion of His Presence is not found.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jo gur kahai soiee par keejai tisanaa agan bujhaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Guru says, she should surely do, to extinguish the fire of desire.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har saachaa soiee tis bin avar na koiee bin seviaai sukh na paae ||
verses.translation: The Lord is True; there is no one except Him. Without serving Him, peace is not found.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak saa dhan milai milaiee jis no aap milaae ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that soul-bride, whom the Lord Himself unites, is united with Him; He Himself merges with her. ||1||

verses.original: ਧਨ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੜੀਏ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhan rain suhelaRe'e jeeau har siau chit laae ||
verses.translation: The life-night of the soul-bride is blessed and joyful, when she focuses her consciousness on her Dear Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seve bhaau kare jeeau vichahu aap gavaae ||
verses.translation: She serves the True Guru with love; she eradicates selfishness from within.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਓ ॥
verses.translit: vichahu aap gavaae har gun gaae anadhin laagaa bhaao ||
verses.translation: Eradicating selfishness and conceit from within, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, she is in love with the Lord, night and day.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਮੇਲੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਓ ॥
verses.translit: sun sakhee sahelee jeea kee melee gur kai sabadh samaao ||
verses.translation: Listen, dear friends and companions of the soul - immerse yourselves in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੀ ਤਾ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਧਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: har gun saaree taa ka(n)t piaaree naame dharee piaaro ||
verses.translation: Dwell upon the Lord's Glories, and you shall be loved by your Husband, embracing love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੋ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kaaman naeh piaaree raam naam gal haaro ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride who wears the necklace of the Lord's Name around her neck is loved by her Husband Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਧਨ ਏਕਲੜੀ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhan ekalaRee jeeau bin naeh piaare ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride who is without her beloved Husband is all alone.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮੁਠੀ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai muThee jeeau bin gur sabadh karaare ||
verses.translation: She is cheated by the love of duality, without the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਉਣੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadh piaare kaun dhutar taare maiaa moh khuaaiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad of her Beloved, how can she cross over the treacherous ocean? Attachment to Maya has led her astray.

verses.original: ਕੂੜਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੀ ਤਾ ਪਿਰਿ ਮੁਤੀ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kooR vigutee taa pir mutee saa dhan mahal na paiee ||
verses.translation: Ruined by falsehood, she is deserted by her Husband Lord. The soul-bride does not attain the Mansion of His Presence.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhe raatee sahaje maatee anadhin rahai samaae ||
verses.translation: But she who is attuned to the Guru's Shabad is intoxicated with celestial love; night and day, she remains absorbed in Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak kaaman sadhaa ra(n)g raatee har jeeau aap milaae ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that soul-bride who remains constantly steeped in His Love, is blended by the Lord into Himself. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: taa mileeaai har mele jeeau har bin kavan milaae ||
verses.translation: If the Lord merges us with Himself, we are merged with Him. Without the Dear Lord, who can merge us with Him?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਆਪਣੇ ਜੀਉ ਕਉਣੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur preetam aapane jeeau kaun bharam chukaae ||
verses.translation: Without our Beloved Guru, who can dispel our doubt?

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਇਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਮਾਏ ਤਾ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur bharam chukaae iau mileeaai maae taa saa dhan sukh paae ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru, doubt is dispelled. O my mother, this is the way to meet Him; this is how the soul-bride finds peace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa bin ghor a(n)dhaar bin gur mag na paae ||
verses.translation: Without serving the Guru, there is only pitch darkness. Without the Guru, the Way is not found.

verses.original: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaaman ra(n)g raatee sahaje maatee gur kai sabadh veechaare ||
verses.translation: That wife who is intuitively imbued with the color of His Love, contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kaaman har var paiaa gur kai bhai piaare ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride obtains the Lord as her Husband, by enshrining love for the Beloved Guru. ||4||1||
Gauree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਰੀ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: pir bin kharee nimaanee jeeau bin pir kiau jeevaa meree maiee ||
verses.translation: Without my Husband, I am utterly dishonored. Without my Husband Lord, how can I live, O my mother?

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਤਨਿ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: pir bin needh na aavai jeeau kaapaR tan na suhaiee ||
verses.translation: Without my Husband, sleep does not come, and my body is not adorned with my bridal dress.

verses.original: ਕਾਪਰੁ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ਜਾ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: kaapar tan suhaavai jaa pir bhaavai gurmatee chit laieeaai ||
verses.translation: The bridal dress looks beautiful upon my body, when I am pleasing to my Husband Lord. Following the Guru's Teachings, my consciousness is focused on Him.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa suhaagan jaa satigur seve gur kai a(n)k samaieeaai ||
verses.translation: I become His happy soul-bride forever, when I serve the True Guru; I sit in the Lap of the Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੇਲਾ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੀ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhai melaa taa pir raavee laahaa naam sa(n)saare ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the soul-bride meets her Husband Lord, who ravishes and enjoys her. The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the only profit in this world.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kaaman naeh piaaree jaa har ke gun saare ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride is loved by her Husband, when she dwells upon the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਣੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saa dhan ra(n)g maane jeeau aapane naal piaare ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride enjoys the Love of her Beloved.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis ra(n)g raatee jeeau gur sabadh veechaare ||
verses.translation: Imbued with His Love night and day, she contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh veechaare haumai maare in bidh milahu piaare ||
verses.translation: Contemplating the Guru's Shabad, she conquers her ego, and in this way, she meets her Beloved.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saa dhan sohaagan sadhaa ra(n)g raatee saachai naam piaare ||
verses.translation: She is the happy soul-bride of her Lord, who is forever imbued with the Love of the True Name of her Beloved.

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗਹੀਐ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: apune gur mil raheeaai a(n)mrit gaheeaai dhubidhaa maar nivaare ||
verses.translation: Abiding in the Company of our Guru, we grasp the Ambrosial Nectar; we conquer and cast out our sense of duality.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kaaman har var paiaa sagale dhookh visaare ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride attains her Husband Lord, and forgets all her pains. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰਹੁ ਭੁਲੀ ਜੀਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaaman pirahu bhulee jeeau maiaa moh piaare ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride has forgotten her Husband Lord, because of love and emotional attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਝੂਠੀ ਝੂਠਿ ਲਗੀ ਜੀਉ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jhooThee jhooTh lagee jeeau kooR muThee kooRiaare ||
verses.translation: The false bride is attached to falsehood; the insincere one is cheated by insincerity.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੇ ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kooR nivaare gurmat saare jooaai janam na haare ||
verses.translation: She who drives out her falsehood, and acts according to the Guru's Teachings, does not lose her life in the gamble.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh seve sach samaavai vichahu haumai maare ||
verses.translation: One who serves the Word of the Guru's Shabad is absorbed in the True Lord; she eradicates egotism from within.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ਐਸਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam ridhai vasaae aaisaa kare seegaaro ||
verses.translation: So let the Name of the Lord abide within your heart; decorate yourself in this way.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak kaaman sahaj samaanee jis saachaa naam adhaaro ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride who takes the Support of the True Name is intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਰੀ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: mil mere preetamaa jeeau tudh bin kharee nimaanee ||
verses.translation: Meet me, O my Dear Beloved. Without You, I am totally dishonored.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਨੈਣੀ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: mai nainee needh na aavai jeeau bhaavai a(n)n na paanee ||
verses.translation: Sleep does not come to my eyes, and I have no desire for food or water.

verses.original: ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਰੀਐ ਹਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: paanee a(n)n na bhaavai mareeaai haavai bin pir kiau sukh paieeaai ||
verses.translation: I have no desire for food or water, and I am dying from the pain of separation. Without my Husband Lord, how can I find peace?

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਉ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: gur aagai karau bina(n)tee je gur bhaavai jiau milai tivai milaieeaai ||
verses.translation: I offer my prayers to the Guru; if it pleases the Guru, He shall unite me with Himself.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape mel le sukhadhaataa aap miliaa ghar aae ||
verses.translation: The Giver of peace has united me with Himself; He Himself has come to my home to meet me.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kaaman sadhaa suhaagan naa pir marai na jaae ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride is forever the Lord's favorite wife; her Husband Lord does not die, and He shall never leave. ||4||2||
Gauree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਬੇਧੀ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kaaman har ras bedhee jeeau har kai sahaj subhaae ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride is pierced through with the sublime essence of the Lord, in intuitive peace and poise.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: man mohan moh leeaa jeeau dhubidhaa sahaj samaae ||
verses.translation: The Enticer of hearts has enticed her, and her sense of duality has been easily dispelled.

verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa sahaj samaae kaaman var paae gurmatee ra(n)g laae ||
verses.translation: Her sense of duality has been easily dispelled, and the soul-bride obtains her Husband Lord; following the Guru's Teachings, she makes merry.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਕੁਸਤਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਗਲ ਤਾਈ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eih sareer kooR kusat bhariaa gal taiee paap kamaae ||
verses.translation: This body is filled to overflowing with falsehood, deception and the commission of sins.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh bhagat jit sahaj dhun upajai bin bhagatee mail na jaae ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh practices that devotional worship, by which the celestial music wells up; without this devotional worship, filth is not removed.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kaaman pireh piaaree vichahu aap gavaae ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride who sheds selfishness and conceit from within, is dear to her Beloved. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaaman pir paiaa jeeau gur kai bhai piaare ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride has found her Husband Lord, through the love and affection of the Guru.

verses.original: ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਤੀ ਜੀਉ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: rain sukh sutee jeeau a(n)tar ur dhaare ||
verses.translation: She passes her life-night sleeping in peace, enshrining the Lord in her heart.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar ur dhaare mileeaai piaare anadhin dhukh nivaare ||
verses.translation: Enshrining Him deep within her heart night and day, she meets her Beloved, and her pains depart.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar mahal pir raave kaaman gurmatee veechaare ||
verses.translation: Deep within the mansion of her inner being, she enjoys her Husband Lord, reflecting upon the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਆ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit naam peeaa dhin raatee dhubidhaa maar nivaare ||
verses.translation: She drinks deeply of the Nectar of the Naam, day and night; she conquers and casts off her sense of duality.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sach milee sohaagan gur kai het apaare ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the happy soul-bride meets her True Lord, through the Infinite Love of the Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਵਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aavahu dhiaa kare jeeau preetam at piaare ||
verses.translation: Come, and shower Your Mercy upon me, my most Darling, Dear Beloved.

verses.original: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaaman binau kare jeeau sach sabadh seegaare ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride offers her prayers to You, to adorn her with the True Word of Your Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sach sabadh seegaare haumai maare gurmukh kaaraj savaare ||
verses.translation: Adorned with the True Word of Your Shabad, she conquers her ego, and as Gurmukh, her affairs are resolved.

verses.original: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jug jug eko sachaa soiee boojhai gur beechaare ||
verses.translation: Throughout the ages, the One Lord is True; through the Guru's Wisdom, He is known.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਸੰਤਾਪੀ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh kaam viaapee moh sa(n)taapee kis aagai jai pukaare ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is engrossed in sexual desire, and tormented by emotional attachment. With whom should she lodge her complaints?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak manmukh thaau na paae bin gur at piaare ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukh finds no place of rest, without the most Beloved Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਭੋਲੀ ਨਿਗੁਣੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਪਿਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dh iaanee bholee niguneeaa jeeau pir agam apaaraa ||
verses.translation: The bride is foolish, ignorant and unworthy. Her Husband Lord is Unapproachable and Incomparable.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape mel mileeaai jeeau aape bakhasanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: He Himself unites us in His Union; He Himself forgives us.

verses.original: ਅਵਗਣ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰਾ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: avagan bakhasanahaaraa kaaman ka(n)t piaaraa ghaT ghaT rahiaa samaiee ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride's Beloved Husband Lord is the Forgiver of sins; He is contained in each and every heart.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: prem preet bhai bhagatee paieeaai satigur boojh bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has made me understand this understanding, that the Lord is obtained through love, affection and loving devotion.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh rahai dhin raatee anadhin rahai liv laiee ||
verses.translation: She remains forever in bliss, day and night; she remains immersed in His Love, night and day.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak sahaje har var paiaa saa dhan nau nidh paiee ||4||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that soul-bride who obtains the nine treasures, intuitively obtains her Husband Lord. ||4||3||
Gauree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਸਰੁ ਸਬਲੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੀਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa sar sabal varatai jeeau kiau kar dhutar tariaa jai ||
verses.translation: The sea of Maya is agitated and turbulent; how can anyone cross over this terrifying world-ocean?

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam kar bohithaa jeeau sabadh khevaT vich pai ||
verses.translation: Make the Lord's Name your boat, and install the Word of the Shabad as the boatman.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਘਾਏ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh khevaT vich paae har aap laghaae in bidh dhutar tareeaai ||
verses.translation: With the Shabad installed as the boatman, the Lord Himself shall take you across. In this way, the difficult ocean is crossed.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਇਉ ਮਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh bhagat paraapat hovai jeevatiaa iau mareeaai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains devotional worship of the Lord, and thus remains dead while yet alive.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: khin meh raam naam kilavikh kaaTe bhe pavit sareeraa ||
verses.translation: In an instant, the Lord's Name erases his sinful mistakes, and his body becomes pure.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਕੰਚਨ ਭਏ ਮਨੂਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak raam naam nisataaraa ka(n)chan bhe manooraa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, emancipation is obtained, and the slag iron is transformed into gold. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਸਤਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: eisataree purakh kaam viaape jeeau raam naam kee bidh nahee jaanee ||
verses.translation: Men and women are obsessed with sex; they do not know the Way of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਖਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa sut bhaiee khare piaare jeeau ddoob mue bin paanee ||
verses.translation: Mother, father, children and siblings are very dear, but they drown, even without water.

verses.original: ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਧਾਤੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ddoob mue bin paanee gat nahee jaanee haumai dhaat sa(n)saare ||
verses.translation: They are drowned to death without water - they do not know the path of salvation, and they wander around the world in egotism.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਸੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo aaiaa so sabh ko jaasee ubare gur veechaare ||
verses.translation: All those who come into the world shall depart. Only those who contemplate the Guru shall be saved.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai raam naam vakhaanai aap tarai kul taare ||
verses.translation: Those who become Gurmukh and chant the Lord's Name, save themselves and save their families as well.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam vasai ghaT a(n)tar gurmat mile piaare ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within their hearts; through the Guru's Teachings, they meet their Beloved. ||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ਬਾਜੀ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin ko thir naahee jeeau baajee hai sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, nothing is stable. This world is just a drama.

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhiraR bhagat sachee jeeau raam naam vaapaaraa ||
verses.translation: Implant true devotional worship within your heart, and trade in the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam vaapaaraa agam apaaraa gurmatee dhan paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Trade in the Lord's Name is infinite and unfathomable. Through the Guru's Teachings, this wealth is obtained.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਇਹ ਸਾਚੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sevaa surat bhagat ieh saachee vichahu aap gavaieeaai ||
verses.translation: This selfless service, meditation and devotion is true, if you eliminate selfishness and conceit from within.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਮਤਿ ਹੀਣ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਅੰਧੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: ham mat heen moorakh mugadh a(n)dhe satigur maarag paae ||
verses.translation: I am senseless, foolish, idiotic and blind, but the True Guru has placed me on the Path.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh sabadh suhaave anadhin har gun gaae ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are adorned with the Shabad; night and day, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aap karaae kare aap jeeau aape sabadh savaare ||
verses.translation: He Himself acts, and inspires others to act; He Himself embellishes us with the Word of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਜੀਉ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਭਗਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aape satigur aap sabadh jeeau jug jug bhagat piaare ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the Shabad; in each and every age, He loves His devotees.

verses.original: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਭਗਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jug jug bhagat piaare har aap savaare aape bhagatee laae ||
verses.translation: In age after age, He loves His devotees; the Lord Himself adorns them, and He Himself enjoins them to worship Him with devotion.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬੀਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape dhaanaa aape beenaa aape sev karaae ||
verses.translation: He Himself is All-knowing, and He Himself is All-seeing; He inspires us to serve Him.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਾਟੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape gunadhaataa avagun kaaTe hiradhai naam vasaae ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Giver of merits, and the Destroyer of demerits; He causes His Name to dwell within our hearts.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਚੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak sadh balihaaree sache viTahu aape kare karaae ||4||4||
verses.translation: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the True Lord, who Himself is the Doer, the Cause of causes. ||4||4||
Gauree, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee sevaa kar piraa jeeau har naam dhiaae ||
verses.translation: Serve the Guru, O my dear soul; meditate on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਮੰਞਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)n(j)h dhoor na jaeh piraa jeeau ghar baiThiaa har paae ||
verses.translation: Do not leave me, O my dear soul - you shall find the Lord while sitting within the home of your own being.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਦਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: ghar baiThiaa har paae sadhaa chit laae sahaje sat subhaae ||
verses.translation: You shall obtain the Lord while sitting within the home of your own being, focusing your consciousness constantly upon the Lord, with true intuitive faith.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee sevaa kharee sukhaalee jis no aap karaae ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru brings great peace; they alone do it, whom the Lord inspires to do so.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਨਾਮੋ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naamo beeje naamo ja(n)mai naamo ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: They plant the seed of the Name, and the Name sprouts within; the Name abides within the mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sach naam vaddiaaiee poorab likhiaa paae ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, glorious greatness rests in the True Name; It is obtained by perfect pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਜਾ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam meeThaa piraa jeeau jaa chaakheh chit laae ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is so sweet, O my dear; taste it, and focus your consciousness on it.

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ਮੁਯੇ ਜੀਉ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa har ras chaakh muye jeeau an ras saadh gavaae ||
verses.translation: Taste the sublime essence of the Lord with your tongue, my dear, and renounce the pleasures of other tastes.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਏ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa har ras paae jaa har bhaae rasanaa sabadh suhaae ||
verses.translation: You shall obtain the everlasting essence of the Lord when it pleases the Lord; your tongue shall be adorned with the Word of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhiaae sadhaa sukh paae naam rahai liv laae ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, a lasting peace is obtained; so remain lovingly focused on the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naame upajai naame binasai naame sach samaae ||
verses.translation: From the Naam we originate, and into the Naam we shall pass; through the Naam, we are absorbed in the Truth.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਲਵਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam gurmatee paieeaai aape le lavaae ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam is obtained through the Guru's Teachings; He Himself attaches us to it. ||2||

verses.original: ਏਹ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਧਨ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਸਿਧਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eh viddaanee chaakaree piraa jeeau dhan chhodd paradhes sidhaae ||
verses.translation: Working for someone else, O my dear, is like forsaking the bride, and going to foreign countries.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੋਭਿ ਲੁਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai kinai sukh na paio piraa jeeau bikhiaa lobh lubhaae ||
verses.translation: In duality, no one has ever found peace, O my dear; you are greedy for corruption and greed.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੋਭਿ ਲੁਭਾਏ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਓਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa lobh lubhaae bharam bhulaae oh kiau kar sukh paae ||
verses.translation: Greedy for corruption and greed, and deluded by doubt, how can anyone find peace?

verses.original: ਚਾਕਰੀ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਖਰੀ ਦੁਖਾਲੀ ਆਪੁ ਵੇਚਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: chaakaree viddaanee kharee dhukhaalee aap vech dharam gavaae ||
verses.translation: Working for strangers is very painful; doing so, one sells himself and loses his faith in the Dharma.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧਨ ਟਿਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਤਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa ba(n)dhan Tikai naahee khin khin dhukh sa(n)taae ||
verses.translation: Bound by Maya, the mind is not stable. Each and every moment, it suffers in pain.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਤਦੇ ਚੂਕੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak maiaa kaa dhukh tadhe chookai jaa gur sabadhee chit laae ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the pain of Maya is taken away by focusing one's consciousness on the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh mugadh gaavaar piraa jeeau sabadh man na vasaae ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are foolish and crazy, O my dear; they do not enshrine the Shabad within their minds.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa kaa bhram a(n)dh piraa jeeau har maarag kiau paae ||
verses.translation: The delusion of Maya has made them blind, O my dear; how can they find the Way of the Lord?

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kiau maarag paae bin satigur bhaae manmukh aap ganaae ||
verses.translation: How can they find the Way, without the Will of the True Guru? The manmukhs foolishly display themselves.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har ke chaakar sadhaa suhele gur charanee chit laae ||
verses.translation: The Lord's servants are forever comfortable. They focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jis no har jeeau kare kirapaa sadhaa har ke gun gaae ||
verses.translation: Those unto whom the Lord shows His Mercy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਗਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak naam ratan jag laahaa gurmukh aap bujhaae ||4||5||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the only profit in this world. The Lord Himself imparts this understanding to the Gurmukh. ||4||5||7||
Raag Gauree, Chhant, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਕਿਉ ਦੇਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: merai man bairaag bhiaa jeeau kiau dhekhaa prabh dhaate ||
verses.translation: My mind has become sad and depressed; how can I see God, the Great Giver?

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: mere meet sakhaa har jeeau gur purakh bidhaate ||
verses.translation: My Friend and Companion is the Dear Lord, the Guru, the Architect of Destiny.

verses.original: ਪੁਰਖੋ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰੁ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲਹ ਤੁਝੈ ਉਡੀਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: purakho bidhaataa ek sreedhar kiau mileh tujhai uddeeneeaa ||
verses.translation: The One Lord, the Architect of Destiny, is the Master of the Goddess of Wealth; how can I, in my sadness, meet You?

verses.original: ਕਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੀਸੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਦਰਸ ਨਿਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar kareh sevaa sees charanee man aas dharas nimaaneeaa ||
verses.translation: My hands serve You, and my head is at Your Feet. My mind, dishonored, yearns for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨ ਘੜੀ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪਲੁ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: saas saas na ghaRee visarai pal moorat dhin raate ||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, I think of You, day and night; I do not forget You, for an instant, even for a moment.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਜਿਉ ਪਿਆਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak saari(n)g jiau piaase kiau mileeaai prabh dhaate ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I am thirsty, like the rainbird; how can I meet God, the Great Giver? ||1||

verses.original: ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਜੀਉ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: eik binau karau jeeau sun ka(n)t piaare ||
verses.translation: I offer this one prayer - please listen, O my Beloved Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਚਲਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: meraa man tan moh leeaa jeeau dhekh chalat tumaare ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are enticed, beholding Your wondrous play.

verses.original: ਚਲਤਾ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਉਦਾਸ ਧਨ ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰਏ ॥
verses.translit: chalataa tumaare dhekh mohee udhaas dhan kiau dheere ||
verses.translation: Beholding Your wondrous play, I am enticed; but how can the sad, forlorn bride find contentment?

verses.original: ਗੁਣਵੰਤ ਨਾਹ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਬਾਲਾ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਪੂਰਏ ॥
verses.translit: gunava(n)t naeh dhiaal baalaa sarab gun bharapoore ||
verses.translation: My Lord is Meritorious, Merciful and Eternally Young; He is overflowing with all excellences.

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਦੋਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਾਤੇ ਹਉ ਵਿਛੁੜੀ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: pir dhos naahee sukheh dhaate hau vichhuRee buriaare ||
verses.translation: The fault is not with my Husband Lord, the Giver of peace; I am separated from Him by my own mistakes.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak dhiaa dhaarahu ghar aavahu naeh piaare ||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, please be merciful to me, and return home, O my Beloved Husband Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਅਰਪੀ ਸਭਿ ਦੇਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau man arapee sabh tan arapee arapee sabh dhesaa ||
verses.translation: I surrender my mind, I surrender my whole body; I surrender all my lands.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਸਿਰੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਇ ਸਦੇਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau sir arapee tis meet piaare jo prabh dhei sadhesaa ||
