verses.translation: I surrender my head to that beloved friend, who brings me news of God.

verses.original: ਅਰਪਿਆ ਤ ਸੀਸੁ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: arapiaa ta sees suthaan gur peh sa(n)g prabhoo dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: I have offered my head to the Guru, the most exalted; He has shown me that God is with me.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮਨਹੁ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: khin maeh sagalaa dhookh miTiaa manahu chi(n)dhiaa paiaa ||
verses.translation: In an instant, all suffering is removed. I have obtained all my mind's desires.

verses.original: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਕਰੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhin rain raleeaa karai kaaman miTe sagal a(n)dhesaa ||
verses.translation: Day and night, the soul-bride makes merry; all her anxieties are erased.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਲੋੜਤੇ ਹਮ ਜੈਸਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak ka(n)t miliaa loRate ham jaisaa ||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I have met the Husband Lord of my longing. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: merai man anadh bhiaa jeeau vajee vaadhaiee ||
verses.translation: My mind is filled with bliss, and congratulations are pouring in.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਲਾਲੁ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਭ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ghar laal aaiaa piaaraa sabh tikhaa bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: My Darling Beloved has come home to me, and all my desires have been satisfied.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤ ਲਾਲੁ ਗੁਪਾਲੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਖੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: miliaa ta laal gupaal Thaakur sakhee ma(n)gal gaiaa ||
verses.translation: I have met my Sweet Lord and Master of the Universe, and my companions sing the songs of joy.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮੀਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਹਰਖੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਦੂਤ ਥਾਉ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meet ba(n)dhap harakh upajiaa dhoot thaau gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: All my friends and relatives are happy, and all traces of my enemies have been removed.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਵਜਹਿ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: anahat vaaje vajeh ghar meh pir sa(n)g sej vichhaiee ||
verses.translation: The unstruck melody vibrates in my home, and the bed has been made up for my Beloved.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕੰਤੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak sahaj rahai har miliaa ka(n)t sukhadhaiee ||4||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I am in celestial bliss. I have obtained the Lord, the Giver of peace, as my Husband. ||4||1||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: mohan tere uooche ma(n)dhar mahal apaaraa ||
verses.translation: O Mohan, your temple is so lofty, and your mansion is unsurpassed.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਦੁਆਰ ਜੀਉ ਸੰਤ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: mohan tere sohan dhuaar jeeau sa(n)t dharam saalaa ||
verses.translation: O Mohan, your gates are so beautiful. They are the worship-houses of the Saints.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲ ਅਪਾਰ ਦੈਆਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: dharam saal apaar dhaiaar Thaakur sadhaa keeratan gaavahe ||
verses.translation: In these incomparable worship-houses, they continually sing Kirtan, the Praises of their Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਹਾ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeh saadh sa(n)t ikatr hoveh tahaa tujheh dhiaavahe ||
verses.translation: Where the Saints and the Holy gather together, there they meditate on you.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹੋਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar dhiaa miaa dhiaal suaamee hoh dheen kirapaaraa ||
verses.translation: Be Kind and Compassionate, O Merciful Lord; be Merciful to the meek.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak dharas piaase mil dharasan sukh saaraa ||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; receiving Your Darshan, I am totally at peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਬਚਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਚਾਲ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: mohan tere bachan anoop chaal niraalee ||
verses.translation: O Mohan, your speech is incomparable; wondrous are your ways.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੂੰ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਜੀ ਅਵਰ ਸਭ ਰਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: mohan too(n) maaneh ek jee avar sabh raalee ||
verses.translation: O Mohan, you believe in the One. Everything else is dust to you.

verses.original: ਮਾਨਹਿ ਤ ਏਕੁ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: maaneh ta ek alekh Thaakur jineh sabh kal dhaareeaa ||
verses.translation: You adore the One Lord, the Unknowable Lord and Master; His Power gives Support to all.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਚਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਆ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh bachan gur kai vas keeaa aadh purakh banavaareeaa ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Word, you have captured the heart of the Primal Being, the Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aap chaliaa aap rahiaa aap sabh kal dhaareeaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself move, and You Yourself stand still; You Yourself support the whole creation.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak paij raakhahu sabh sevak saran tumaareeaa ||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, please preserve my honor; all Your servants seek the Protection of Your Sanctuary. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: mohan tudh satasa(n)gat dhiaavai dharas dhiaanaa ||
verses.translation: O Mohan, the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, meditates on you; they meditate on the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਨਿਦਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: mohan jam neR na aavai tudh japeh nidhaanaa ||
verses.translation: O Mohan, the Messenger of Death does not even approach those who meditate on You, at the last moment.

verses.original: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਗੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੋ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: jamakaal tin kau lagai naahee jo ik man dhiaavahe ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death cannot touch those who meditate on You single-mindedly.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਬਚਨਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਸੇ ਸਭੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: man bachan karam j tudh araadheh se sabhe fal paavahe ||
verses.translation: Those who worship and adore You in thought, word and deed, obtain all fruits and rewards.

verses.original: ਮਲ ਮੂਤ ਮੂੜ ਜਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਹੋਤੇ ਸਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: mal moot mooR j mugadh hote s dhekh dharas sugiaanaa ||
verses.translation: Those who are foolish and stupid, filthy with urine and manure, become all-knowing upon gaining the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak raaj nihachal pooran purakh bhagavaanaa ||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, Your Kingdom is Eternal, O Perfect Primal Lord God. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਫਲੁ ਫਲਿਆ ਸਣੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mohan too(n) sufal faliaa san paravaare ||
verses.translation: O Mohan, you have blossomed forth with the flower of your family.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਨ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮੀਤ ਭਾਈ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mohan putr meet bhaiee kuTa(n)b sabh taare ||
verses.translation: O Mohan, your children, friends, siblings and relatives have all been saved.

verses.original: ਤਾਰਿਆ ਜਹਾਨੁ ਲਹਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: taariaa jahaan lahiaa abhimaan jinee dharasan paiaa ||
verses.translation: You save those who give up their egotistical pride, upon gaining the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਕਹਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jinee tudhano dha(n)n kahiaa tin jam neR na aaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who call you 'blessed'.

verses.original: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਥੇ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: bea(n)t gun tere kathe na jaahee satigur purakh muraare ||
verses.translation: Your Virtues are unlimited - they cannot be described, O True Guru, Primal Being, Destroyer of demons.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਟੇਕ ਰਾਖੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak Tek raakhee jit lag tariaa sa(n)saare ||4||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, Yours is that Anchor, holding onto which the whole world is saved. ||4||2||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla,
Shalok:

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਅਸੰਖ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: patit asa(n)kh puneet kar puneh puneh balihaar ||
verses.translation: Countless sinners have been purified; I am a sacrifice, over and over again, to You.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਪਾਵਕੋ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦਾਹਨਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak raam naam jap paavako tin kilabikh dhaahanahaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditation on the Lord's Name is the fire which burns away sinful mistakes like straw. ||1||
Chhant:

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨਾ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਧੋ ॥
verses.translit: jap manaa too(n) raam narain govi(n)dhaa har maadho ||
verses.translation: Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord God, the Lord of the Universe, the Lord, the Master of Wealth.

verses.original: ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨਾ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਮੁਕੰਦੇ ਕਟੀਐ ਕਾਲ ਦੁਖ ਫਾਧੋ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaai manaa muraar muka(n)dhe kaTeeaai kaal dhukh faadho ||
verses.translation: Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord, the Destroyer of ego, the Giver of salvation, who cuts away the noose of agonizing death.

verses.original: ਦੁਖਹਰਣ ਦੀਨ ਸਰਣ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhukhaharan dheen saran sreedhar charan kamal araadheeaai ||
verses.translation: Meditate lovingly on the Lotus Feet of the Lord, the Destroyer of distress, the Protector of the poor, the Lord of excellence.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਾਧੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jam pa(n)th bikhaRaa agan saagar nimakh simarat saadheeaai ||
verses.translation: The treacherous path of death and the terrifying ocean of fire are crossed over by meditating in remembrance on the Lord, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਕਲਿਮਲਹ ਦਹਤਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਅਰਾਧੋ ॥
verses.translit: kalimaleh dhahataa sudh karataa dhinas rain araadho ||
verses.translation: Meditate day and night on the Lord, the Destroyer of desire, the Purifier of pollution.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਾਧੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak karahu kirapaa gopaal gobi(n)dh maadho ||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, please be Merciful to me, O Cherisher of the world, Lord of the Universe, Lord of wealth. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨਾ ਦਾਮੋਦਰੁ ਦੁਖਹਰੁ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: simar manaa dhaamodhar dhukhahar bhai bha(n)jan har raiaa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, remember the Lord in meditation; He is the Destroyer of pain, the Eradicator of fear, the Sovereign Lord King.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗੋ ਦਇਆਲ ਮਨੋਹਰੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sreera(n)go dhiaal manohar bhagat vachhal biradhaiaa ||
verses.translation: He is the Greatest Lover, the Merciful Master, the Enticer of the mind, the Support of His devotees - this is His very nature.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਨਹਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat vachhal purakh pooran maneh chi(n)dhiaa paieeaai ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He fulfills the desires of the mind.

verses.original: ਤਮ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਉਧਾਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: tam a(n)dh koop te udhaarai naam ma(n)n vasaieeaai ||
verses.translation: He lifts us up out of the deep, dark pit; enshrine His Name within your mind.

verses.original: ਸੁਰ ਸਿਧ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਗੁਣ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਗਤੀ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sur sidh gan ga(n)dharab mun jan gun anik bhagatee gaiaa ||
verses.translation: The gods, the Siddhas, the angels, the heavenly singers, the silent sages and the devotees sing Your countless Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak karahu kirapaa paarabraham har raiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, please be merciful to me, O Supreme Lord God, my King. ||2||

verses.original: ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: chet manaa paarabraham paramesar sarab kalaa jin dhaaree ||
verses.translation: O my mind, be conscious of the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, who wields all power.

verses.original: ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: karunaa mai samarath suaamee ghaT ghaT praan adhaaree ||
verses.translation: He is All-powerful, the Embodiment of compassion. He is the Master of each and every heart;

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: praan man tan jeea dhaataa bea(n)t agam apaaro ||
verses.translation: He is the Support of the breath of life. He is the Giver of the breath of life, of mind, body and soul. He is Infinite, Inaccessible and Unfathomable.

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਮੋਹਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਦਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: saran jog samarath mohan sarab dhokh bidhaaro ||
verses.translation: The All-powerful Lord is our Sanctuary; He is the Enticer of the mind, who banishes all sorrows.

verses.original: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: rog sog sabh dhokh binaseh japat naam muraaree ||
verses.translation: All illnesses, sufferings and pains are dispelled, by chanting the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਮਰਥ ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak karahu kirapaa samarath sabh kal dhaaree ||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, please be merciful to me, All-powerful Lord; You are the Wielder of all power. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਮਨਾ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaau manaa achut abinaasee sabh te uooch dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Imperishable, Eternal, Merciful Master, the Highest of all.

verses.original: ਬਿਸੰਭਰੁ ਦੇਵਨ ਕਉ ਏਕੈ ਸਰਬ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: bisa(n)bhar dhevan kau ekai sarab karai pratipaalaa ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is the Sustainer of the Universe, the Great Giver; He is the Cherisher of all.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਮਹਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਾਨਾ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੇ ਸਭ ਕਿਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: pratipaal mahaa dhiaal dhaanaa dhiaa dhaare sabh kisai ||
verses.translation: The Cherisher Lord is so very merciful and wise; He is compassionate to all.

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨਾਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: kaal ka(n)Tak lobh moh naasai jeea jaa kai prabh basai ||
verses.translation: The pains of death, greed and emotional attachment simply vanish, when God comes to dwell in the soul.

verses.original: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਦੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: suprasa(n)n dhevaa safal sevaa bhiee pooran ghaalaa ||
verses.translation: When the Lord is thoroughly pleased, then one's service becomes perfectly fruitful.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ ਜਪਤ ਦੀਨ ਦੈਆਲਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak ichh punee japat dheen dhaiaalaa ||4||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, my desires are fulfilled by meditating on the Lord, Merciful to the meek. ||4||3||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੇਹਾ ਮਨਾਇ ਲੈਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੈ ॥
verses.translit: sun sakhe'ee mil udham karehaa manai laih har ka(n)tai ||
verses.translation: Listen, O my companions: let's join together and make the effort, to surrender to our Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਮੋਹਹ ਸਾਧੂ ਮੰਤੈ ॥
verses.translit: maan tiaag kar bhagat Thagauree moheh saadhoo ma(n)tai ||
verses.translation: Renouncing our pride, let's charm Him with the potion of devotional worship, and the mantra of the Holy Saints.

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਇਹ ਰੀਤਿ ਭਲੀ ਭਗਵੰਤੈ ॥
verses.translit: sakhee vas aaiaa fir chhodd na jaiee ieh reet bhalee bhagava(n)tai ||
verses.translation: O my companions, when He comes under our power, He shall never leave us again. This is the good nature of the Lord God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਰਾ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੰਤੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jaraa maran bhai narak nivaarai puneet karai tis ja(n)tai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God dispels the fear of old age, death and hell; He purifies His beings. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਏ ਇਹ ਭਲੀ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਏਹੁ ਮਤਾਂਤੁ ਪਕਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sun sakhe'ee ieh bhalee bina(n)tee eh mataa(n)t pakaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Listen, O my companions, to my sincere prayer: let's make this firm resolve.

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਰਹਤ ਹੋਇ ਗੀਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਹਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj subhai upaadh rahat hoi geet govi(n)dheh gaieeaai ||
verses.translation: In the peaceful poise of intuitive bliss, violence will be gone, as we sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: kal kales miTeh bhram naaseh man chi(n)dhiaa fal paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Our pains and troubles shall be eradicated, and our doubts shall be dispelled; we will receive the fruits of our minds' desires.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: paarabraham pooran paramesar naanak naam dhiaaieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect, Transcendent Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਇਛ ਕਰੀ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖ ਮਨਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sakhee ichh karee nit sukh manaiee prabh meree aas pujaae ||
verses.translation: O my companions, I yearn for Him continually; I invoke His Blessings, and pray that God may fulfill my hopes.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਦਰਸ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਪੇਖਉ ਥਾਨ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: charan piaasee dharas bairaagan pekhau thaan sabaae ||
verses.translation: I thirst for His Feet, and I long for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; I look for Him everywhere.

verses.original: ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: khoj lahau har sa(n)t janaa sa(n)g sa(n)mrith purakh milaae ||
verses.translation: I search for traces of the Lord in the Society of the Saints; they will unite me with the All-powerful Primal Lord God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਰਿਜਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak tin miliaa surijan sukhadhaataa se vaddabhaagee maae ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those humble, noble beings who meet the Lord, the Giver of peace, are very blessed, O my mother. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਵਸਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਿਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sakhee naal vasaa apune naeh piaare meraa man tan har sa(n)g hiliaa ||
verses.translation: O my companions, now I dwell with my Beloved Husband; my mind and body are attuned to the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੇਰੀ ਨੀਦ ਭਲੀ ਮੈ ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sun sakhe'ee meree needh bhalee mai aapanaRaa pir miliaa ||
verses.translation: Listen, O my companions: now I sleep well, since I found my Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਖੋਇਓ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਕਉਲੁ ਖਿਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhram khoio saa(n)t sahaj suaamee paragaas bhiaa kaul khiliaa ||
verses.translation: My doubts have been dispelled, and I have found intuitive peace and tranquility through my Lord and Master. I have been enlightened, and my heart-lotus has blossomed forth.

verses.original: ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਨ ਟਲਿਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੨॥੫॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: var paiaa prabh a(n)tarajaamee naanak sohaag na Taliaa ||4||4||2||5||11||
verses.translation: I have obtained God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, as my Husband; O Nanak, my marriage shall last forever. ||4||4||2||5||11||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Gauree, Baavan Akhree ~ The 52 Letters, Fifth Mehla:
Shalok:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਿਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurdhev maataa gurdhev pitaa gurdhev suaamee paramesuraa ||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru is my mother, the Divine Guru is my father; the Divine Guru is my Transcendent Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਖਾ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਬੰਧਿਪ ਸਹੋਦਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurdhev sakhaa agiaan bha(n)jan gurdhev ba(n)dhip sahodharaa ||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru is my companion, the Destroyer of ignorance; the Divine Guru is my relative and brother.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੰਤੁ ਨਿਰੋਧਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurdhev dhaataa har naam upadhesai gurdhev ma(n)t nirodharaa ||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru is the Giver, the Teacher of the Lord's Name. The Divine Guru is the Mantra which never fails.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਪਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurdhev saa(n)t sat budh moorat gurdhev paaras paras paraa ||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru is the Image of peace, truth and wisdom. The Divine Guru is the Philosopher's Stone - touching it, one is transformed.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਜਨੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurdhev teerath a(n)mirat sarovar gur giaan majan apara(n)paraa ||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage, and the pool of divine ambrosia; bathing in the Guru's wisdom, one experiences the Infinite.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਹਰਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਕਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurdhev karataa sabh paap harataa gurdhev patit pavit karaa ||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru is the Creator, and the Destroyer of all sins; the Divine Guru is the Purifier of sinners.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਧਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurdhev aadh jugaadh jug jug gurdhev ma(n)t har jap udharaa ||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru existed at the primal beginning, throughout the ages, in each and every age. The Divine Guru is the Mantra of the Lord's Name; chanting it, one is saved.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurdhev sa(n)gat prabh mel kar kirapaa ham mooR paapee jit lag taraa ||
verses.translation: O God, please be merciful to me, that I may be with the Divine Guru; I am a foolish sinner, but holding onto Him, I am carried across.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurdhev satigur paarabraham paramesar gurdhev naanak har namasakaraa ||1||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru is the True Guru, the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord; Nanak bows in humble reverence to the Lord, the Divine Guru. ||1||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਆਪਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਆਪਹਿ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: aapeh keeaa karaiaa aapeh karanai jog ||
verses.translation: He Himself acts, and causes others to act; He Himself can do everything.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਦੂਸਰ ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak eko rav rahiaa dhoosar hoaa na hog ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the One Lord is pervading everywhere; there has never been any other, and there never shall be. ||1||
Pauree:
ONG: I humbly bow in reverence to the One Universal Creator, to the Holy True Guru.
In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, He is the Formless Lord.
He Himself is in the absolute state of primal meditation; He Himself is in the seat of peace.
He Himself listens to His Own Praises.
He Himself created Himself.
He is His Own Father, He is His Own Mother.
He Himself is subtle and etheric; He Himself is manifest and obvious.
O Nanak, His wondrous play cannot be understood. ||1||
O God, Merciful to the meek, please be kind to me,

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tere sa(n)tan kee man hoi ravaalaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: that my mind might become the dust of the feet of Your Saints. ||Pause||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਏਕ ॥
verses.translit: nira(n)kaar aakaar aap niragun saragun ek ||
verses.translation: He Himself is formless, and also formed; the One Lord is without attributes, and also with attributes.

verses.original: ਏਕਹਿ ਏਕ ਬਖਾਨਨੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ekeh ek bakhaanano naanak ek anek ||1||
verses.translation: Describe the One Lord as One, and Only One; O Nanak, He is the One, and the many. ||1||
Pauree:
ONG: The One Universal Creator created the Creation through the Word of the Primal Guru.
He strung it upon His one thread.
He created the diverse expanse of the three qualities.
From formless, He appeared as form.
The Creator has created the creation of all sorts.
The attachment of the mind has led to birth and death.
He Himself is above both, untouched and unaffected.
O Nanak, He has no end or limitation. ||2||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਸਾਹ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਸੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: seiee saeh bhagava(n)t se sach sa(n)pai har raas ||
verses.translation: Those who gather Truth, and the riches of the Lord's Name, are rich and very fortunate.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਚਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਿਹ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sach such paieeaai teh sa(n)tan kai paas ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, truthfulness and purity are obtained from Saints such as these. ||1||
Pauree:
SASSA: True, True, True is that Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
verses.translit: sat purakh te bhi(n)n na kouoo ||
verses.translation: No one is separate from the True Primal Lord.
They alone enter the Lord's Sanctuary, whom the Lord inspires to enter.
Meditating, meditating in remembrance, they sing and preach the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Doubt and skepticism do not affect them at all.
They behold the manifest glory of the Lord.
They are the Holy Saints - they reach this destination.
Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||3||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਪੁਕਾਰਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸਭ ਕੂਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan kahaa pukaarate maiaa moh sabh koor ||
verses.translation: Why are you crying out for riches and wealth? All this emotional attachment to Maya is false.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹੋਤ ਜਾਤ ਸਭੁ ਧੂਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam bihoone naanakaa hot jaat sabh dhoor ||1||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, all are reduced to dust. ||1||
Pauree:
DHADHA: The dust of the feet of the Saints is sacred.

verses.original: ਧਨਿ ਤੇਊ ਜਿਹ ਰੁਚ ਇਆ ਮਨੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhan teuoo jeh ruch iaa manooaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed are those whose minds are filled with this longing.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਸੁਰਗ ਨ ਆਛਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhan nahee baachheh surag na aachheh ||
verses.translation: They do not seek wealth, and they do not desire paradise.

verses.original: ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਰਜ ਰਾਚਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: at pria preet saadh raj raacheh ||
verses.translation: They are immersed in the deep love of their Beloved, and the dust of the feet of the Holy.

verses.original: ਧੰਧੇ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਆਪਹਿ ਤਾਹੂ ॥ ਜੋ ਏਕ ਛਾਡਿ ਅਨ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੂ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhe kahaa biaapeh taahoo || jo ek chhaadd an kateh na jaahoo ||
verses.translation: How can worldly affairs affect those who do not abandon the One Lord, and who go nowhere else?

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੀਐ ਦੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai heeaai dheeo prabh naam ||
verses.translation: One whose heart is filled with God's Name,
O Nanak, is a perfect spiritual being of God. ||4||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਭੇਖ ਅਰੁ ਙਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਮਿਲਿਅਉ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: anik bhekh ar n(g)iaan dhiaan manahaTh miliaau na koi ||
verses.translation: By all sorts of religious robes, knowledge, meditation and stubborn-mindedness, no one has ever met God.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਙਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak kirapaa bhiee bhagat n(g)iaanee soi ||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, those upon whom God showers His Mercy, are devotees of spiritual wisdom. ||1||
Pauree:
NGANGA: Spiritual wisdom is not obtained by mere words of mouth.
It is not obtained through the various debates of the Shaastras and scriptures.

verses.original: ਙਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਇ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਸੋਊ ॥
verses.translit: n(g)iaanee soi jaa kai dhiraR souoo ||
verses.translation: They alone are spiritually wise, whose minds are firmly fixed on the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਕਛੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਊ ॥
verses.translit: kahat sunat kachh jog na houoo ||
verses.translation: Hearing and telling stories, no one attains Yoga.

verses.original: ਙਿਆਨੀ ਰਹਤ ਆਗਿਆ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: n(g)iaanee rahat aagiaa dhiraR jaa kai ||
verses.translation: They alone are spiritually wise, who remain firmly committed to the Lord's Command.

verses.original: ਉਸਨ ਸੀਤ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਸਭ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: ausan seet samasar sabh taa kai ||
verses.translation: Heat and cold are all the same to them.
The true people of spiritual wisdom are the Gurmukhs, who contemplate the essence of reality;
O Nanak, the Lord showers His Mercy upon them. ||5||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਆਵਨ ਆਏ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਪਸੁ ਢੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: aavan aae sirasaT meh bin boojhe pas ddor ||
verses.translation: Those who have come into the world without understanding are like animals and beasts.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋ ਬੁਝੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭਾਗ ਮਥੋਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh so bujhai jaa kai bhaag mathor ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who become Gurmukh understand; upon their foreheads is such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਯਾ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਏਕਹਿ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: yaa jug meh ekeh kau aaiaa ||
verses.translation: They have come into this world to meditate on the One Lord.
But ever since their birth, they have been enticed by the fascination of Maya.

verses.original: ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਤਪ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: garabh ku(n)T meh uradh tap karate ||
verses.translation: Upside-down in the chamber of the womb, they performed intense meditation.
They remembered God in meditation with each and every breath.
But now, they are entangled in things which they must leave behind.
They forget the Great Giver from their minds.

verses.original: ਧਾਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: dhaarahu kirapaa jiseh gusaiee || it ut naanak tis bisarahu naahee ||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord showers His Mercy, do not forget Him, here or hereafter. ||6||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਆਵਤ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aavat hukam binaas hukam aagiaa bhi(n)n na koi ||
verses.translation: By His Command, we come, and by His Command, we go; no one is beyond His Command.

verses.original: ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਤਿਹ ਮਿਟੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਹ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aavan jaanaa teh miTai naanak jeh man soi ||1||
verses.translation: Coming and going in reincarnation is ended, O Nanak, for those whose minds are filled with the Lord. ||1||
Pauree:
This soul has lived in many wombs.
Enticed by sweet attachment, it has been trapped in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਇਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: ein maiaa trai gun bas keene ||
verses.translation: This Maya has subjugated beings through the three qualities.
Maya has infused attachment to itself in each and every heart.
O friend, tell me some way,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਤਰਉ ਬਿਖਮ ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaa te tarau bikham ieh maiaa ||
verses.translation: by which I may swim across this treacherous ocean of Maya.
The Lord showers His Mercy, and leads us to join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਮਾਏ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak taa kai nikaT na maae ||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, Maya does not even come near. ||7||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਕਿਰਤ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਸੁਭ ਅਸੁਭ ਕੀਨੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: kirat kamaavan subh asubh keene tin prabh aap ||
verses.translation: God Himself causes one to perform good and bad actions.

verses.original: ਪਸੁ ਆਪਨ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਾ ਕਮਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pas aapan hau hau karai naanak bin har kahaa kamaat ||1||
verses.translation: The beast indulges in egotism, selfishness and conceit; O Nanak, without the Lord, what can anyone do? ||1||
Pauree:
The One Lord Himself is the Cause of all actions.
He Himself distributes sins and noble acts.

verses.original: ਇਆ ਜੁਗ ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: eiaa jug jit jit aapeh laio ||
verses.translation: In this age, people are attached as the Lord attaches them.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਓ ਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: so so paio ju aap dhivaio ||
verses.translation: They receive that which the Lord Himself gives.

verses.original: ਉਆ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਊ ॥
verses.translit: auaa kaa a(n)t na jaanai kouoo ||
verses.translation: No one knows His limits.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਊ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਊ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo karai souoo fun houoo ||
verses.translation: Whatever He does, comes to pass.
From the One, the entire expanse of the Universe emanated.
O Nanak, He Himself is our Saving Grace. ||8||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕੁਸਮ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਖ ਸੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: raach rahe banitaa binodh kusam ra(n)g bikh sor ||
verses.translation: Man remains engrossed in women and playful pleasures; the tumult of his passion is like the dye of the safflower, which fades away all too soon.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰਉ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਮੈ ਮੋਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak teh saranee parau binas jai mai mor ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, seek God's Sanctuary, and your selfishness and conceit shall be taken away. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਹ ਰਚਹੁ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: re man bin har jeh rachahu teh teh ba(n)dhan paeh ||
verses.translation: O mind: without the Lord, whatever you are involved in shall bind you in chains.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਸਾਕਤ ਤੇਊ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeh bidh katahoo na chhooTeeaai saakat teuoo kamaeh ||
verses.translation: The faithless cynic does those deeds which will never allow him to be emancipated.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਰਮ ਰਤ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: hau hau karate karam rat taa ko bhaar afaar ||
verses.translation: Acting in egotism, selfishness and conceit, the lovers of rituals carry the unbearable load.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਉ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਤਉ ਏਊ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: preet nahee jau naam siau tau euoo karam bikaar ||
verses.translation: When there is no love for the Naam, then these rituals are corrupt.

verses.original: ਬਾਧੇ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਮੀਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: baadhe jam kee jevaree meeThee maiaa ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: The rope of death binds those who are in love with the sweet taste of Maya.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਮੋਹੇ ਨਹ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਹੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: bhram ke mohe neh bujheh so prabh sadhahoo sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: Deluded by doubt, they do not understand that God is always with them.

verses.original: ਲੇਖੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਕਾਚੀ ਭੀਤਿ ਨ ਸੁਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: lekhai ganat na chhooTeeaai kaachee bheet na sudh ||
verses.translation: When their accounts are called for, they shall not be released; their wall of mud cannot be washed clean.

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤਿਹ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬੁਧਿ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: jiseh bujhaae naanakaa teh gurmukh niramal budh ||9||
verses.translation: One who is made to understand - O Nanak, that Gurmukh obtains immaculate understanding. ||9||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਜਾਸੁ ਕੇ ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: TooTe ba(n)dhan jaas ke hoaa saadhoo sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: One whose bonds are cut away joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗ ਏਕ ਕੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੂੜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo raate ra(n)g ek kai naanak gooRaa ra(n)g ||1||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the Love of the One Lord, O Nanak, take on the deep and lasting color of His Love. ||1||
Pauree:
RARRA: Dye this heart of yours in the color of the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japahu jap rasanaa ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - chant it with your tongue.

verses.original: ਰੇ ਰੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
verses.translit: re re dharageh kahai na kouoo ||
verses.translation: In the Court of the Lord, no one shall speak harshly to you.
Everyone shall welcome you, saying, ""Come, and sit down.""
In that Mansion of the Lord's Presence, you shall find a home.
There is no birth or death, or destruction there.

verses.original: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਧੁਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: masatak karam likhio dhur jaa kai ||
verses.translation: One who has such karma written on his forehead,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)pai naanak ghar taa kai ||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, has the wealth of the Lord in his home. ||10||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਮੂੜੇ ਅੰਧ ॥
verses.translit: laalach jhooTh bikaar moh biaapat mooRe a(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Greed, falsehood, corruption and emotional attachment entangle the blind and the foolish.

verses.original: ਲਾਗਿ ਪਰੇ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: laag pare dhuraga(n)dh siau naanak maiaa ba(n)dh ||1||
verses.translation: Bound down by Maya, O Nanak, a foul odor clings to them. ||1||
Pauree:
LALLA: People are entangled in the love of corrupt pleasures;
they are drunk with the wine of egotistical intellect and Maya.
In this Maya, they are born and die.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jiau jiau hukam tivai tiau karanaa ||
verses.translation: People act according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.
No one is perfect, and no one is imperfect.
No one is wise, and no one is foolish.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jit jit laavahu tit tit laganaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever the Lord engages someone, there he is engaged.
O Nanak, our Lord and Master is forever detached. ||11||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਲਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਥਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: laal gupaal gobi(n)dh prabh gahir ga(n)bheer athaeh ||
verses.translation: My Beloved God, the Sustainer of the World, the Lord of the Universe, is deep, profound and unfathomable.

verses.original: ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਵਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhoosar naahee avar ko naanak beparavaeh ||1||
verses.translation: There is no other like Him; O Nanak, He is not worried. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਲਲਾ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
verses.translit: lalaa taa kai lavai na kouoo ||
verses.translation: LALLA: There is no one equal to Him.
He Himself is the One; there shall never be any other.
He is now, He has been, and He shall always be.

verses.original: ਉਆ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: auaa kaa a(n)t na kaahoo paiaa ||
verses.translation: No one has ever found His limit.
In the ant and in the elephant, He is totally pervading.
The Lord, the Primal Being, is known by everyone everywhere.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau dheeno har ras apanaa ||
verses.translation: That one, unto whom the Lord has given His Love

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਹ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh har har teh japanaa ||12||
verses.translation: - O Nanak, that Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||12||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: aatam ras jeh jaaniaa har ra(n)g sahaje maan ||
verses.translation: One who knows the taste of the Lord's sublime essence, intuitively enjoys the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਜਨ ਆਏ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dhan dhan dha(n)n jan aae te paravaan ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, blessed, blessed, blessed are the Lord's humble servants; how fortunate is their coming into the world! ||1||
Pauree:
How fruitful is the coming into the world, of those

verses.original: ਜਾਸੁ ਰਸਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਭਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jaas rasan har har jas bhaneeaai ||
verses.translation: whose tongues celebrate the Praises of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
They come and dwell with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;
night and day, they lovingly meditate on the Naam.
Blessed is the birth of those humble beings who are attuned to the Naam;
the Lord, the Architect of Destiny, bestows His Kind Mercy upon them.

verses.original: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਵਨ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ekeh aavan fir jon na aaiaa ||
verses.translation: They are born only once - they shall not be reincarnated again.
O Nanak, they are absorbed into the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||13||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਯਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥ ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: yaas japat man hoi ana(n)dh binasai dhoojaa bhaau || dhookh dharadh tirasanaa bujhai naanak naam samaau ||1||
verses.translation: Chanting it, the mind is filled with bliss; love of duality is eliminated, and pain, distress and desires are quenched. O Nanak, immerse yourself in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
Pauree:
YAYYA: Burn away duality and evil-mindedness.
Give them up, and sleep in intuitive peace and poise.
Yaya: Go, and seek the Sanctuary of the Saints;
with their help, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਯਯਾ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸੋਊ ॥ ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਲੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਪਰੋਊ ॥
verses.translit: yayaa janam na aavai souoo || ek naam le maneh parouoo ||
verses.translation: Yaya: One who weaves the One Name into his heart, does not have to take birth again.

verses.original: ਯਯਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: yayaa janam na haareeaai gur poore kee Tek ||
verses.translation: Yaya: This human life shall not be wasted, if you take the Support of the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਏਕ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak teh sukh paiaa jaa kai heearai ek ||14||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one whose heart is filled with the One Lord finds peace. ||14||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਬਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar man tan bas rahe ieet uoot ke meet ||
verses.translation: The One who dwells deep within the mind and body is your friend here and hereafter.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur poorai upadhesiaa naanak japeeaai neet ||1||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has taught me, O Nanak, to chant His Name continually. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin simarahu taas kau jo a(n)t sahaiee hoi ||
verses.translation: Night and day, meditate in remembrance on the One who will be your Help and Support in the end.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਛਿਅ ਛਾਡਿ ਚਲਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eeh bikhiaa dhin chaar chhia chhaadd chalio sabh koi ||
verses.translation: This poison shall last for only a few days; everyone must depart, and leave it behind.

verses.original: ਕਾ ਕੋ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਧੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaa ko maat pitaa sut dheeaa ||
verses.translation: Who is our mother, father, son and daughter?

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: gireh banitaa kachh sa(n)g na leeaa ||
verses.translation: Household, wife, and other things shall not go along with you.
So gather that wealth which shall never perish,
so that you may go to your true home with honor.
In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, those who sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak te te bahur na aaiaa ||15||
verses.translation: - O Nanak, they do not have to endure reincarnation again. ||15||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਕੁਲੀਨ ਚਤੁਰ ਮੁਖਿ ਙਿਆਨੀ ਧਨਵੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: at su(n)dhar kuleen chatur mukh n(g)iaanee dhanava(n)t ||
verses.translation: He may be very handsome, born into a highly respected family, very wise, a famous spiritual teacher, prosperous and wealthy;

verses.original: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mritak kahe'eeh naanakaa jeh preet nahee bhagava(n)t ||1||
verses.translation: but even so, he is looked upon as a corpse, O Nanak, if he does not love the Lord God. ||1||
Pauree:
NGANGA: He may be a scholar of the six Shaastras.
He may practice inhaling, exhaling and holding the breath.
He may practice spiritual wisdom, meditation, pilgrimages to sacred shrines and ritual cleansing baths.
He may cook his own food, and never touch anyone else's; he may live in the wilderness like a hermit.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਹੇਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam sa(n)g man nahee hetaa ||
verses.translation: But if he does not enshrine love for the Lord's Name within his heart,
then everything he does is transitory.
Even an untouchable pariah is superior to him,
O Nanak, if the Lord of the World abides in his mind. ||16||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਕੁੰਟ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕੀ ਰੇਖ ॥
verses.translit: ku(n)T chaar dheh dhis bhrame karam kirat kee rekh ||
verses.translation: He wanders around in the four quarters and in the ten directions, according to the dictates of his karma.

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਲੇਖ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sookh dhookh mukat jon naanak likhio lekh ||1||
verses.translation: Pleasure and pain, liberation and reincarnation, O Nanak, come according to one's pre-ordained destiny. ||1||
Pauree:
KAKKA: He is the Creator, the Cause of causes.
No one can erase His pre-ordained plan.
Nothing can be done a second time.
The Creator Lord does not make mistakes.
To some, He Himself shows the Way.
While He causes others to wander miserably in the wilderness.
He Himself has set His own play in motion.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਦੀਨੋ ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਨੋ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: jo jo dheeno su naanak leeno ||17||
verses.translation: Whatever He gives, O Nanak, that is what we receive. ||17||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਬਿਲਛਤ ਰਹੇ ਟੂਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: khaat kharachat bilachhat rahe TooT na jaeh bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: People continue to eat and consume and enjoy, but the Lord's warehouses are never exhausted.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har japat anek jan naanak naeh sumaar ||1||
verses.translation: So many chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; O Nanak, they cannot be counted. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਖਖਾ ਖੂਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਕੈ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: khakhaa khoonaa kachh nahee tis sa(n)mrath kai paeh ||
verses.translation: KHAKHA: The All-powerful Lord lacks nothing;

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੇਨਾ ਸੋ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਓ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhenaa so dhe rahio bhaavai teh teh jaeh ||
verses.translation: whatever He is to give, He continues to give - let anyone go anywhere he pleases.

verses.original: ਖਰਚੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਇਆ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: kharach khajaanaa naam dhan iaa bhagatan kee raas ||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a treasure to spend; it is the capital of His devotees.

verses.original: ਖਿਮਾ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਅਨਦ ਸਹਜ ਜਪਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: khimaa gareebee anadh sahaj japat raheh gunataas ||
verses.translation: With tolerance, humility, bliss and intuitive poise, they continue to meditate on the Lord, the Treasure of excellence.

verses.original: ਖੇਲਹਿ ਬਿਗਸਹਿ ਅਨਦ ਸਿਉ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: kheleh bigaseh anadh siau jaa kau hot kirapaal ||
verses.translation: Those, unto whom the Lord shows His Mercy, play happily and blossom forth.

verses.original: ਸਦੀਵ ਗਨੀਵ ਸੁਹਾਵਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: sadheev ganeev suhaavane raam naam gireh maal ||
verses.translation: Those who have the wealth of the Lord's Name in their homes are forever wealthy and beautiful.

verses.original: ਖੇਦੁ ਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਡਾਨੁ ਤਿਹ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: khedh na dhookh na ddaan teh jaa kau nadhar karee ||
verses.translation: Those who are blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace suffer neither torture, nor pain, nor punishment.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਪਰੀ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: naanak jo prabh bhaaniaa pooree tinaa paree ||18||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are pleasing to God become perfectly successful. ||18||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਗਨਿ ਮਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਰਪਰ ਚਲਨੋ ਲੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: gan min dhekhahu manai maeh sarapar chalano log ||
verses.translation: See, that even by calculating and scheming in their minds, people must surely depart in the end.

verses.original: ਆਸ ਅਨਿਤ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਰੋਗ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aas anit gurmukh miTai naanak naam arog ||1||
verses.translation: Hopes and desires for transitory things are erased for the Gurmukh; O Nanak, the Name alone brings true health. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਗਗਾ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਜਪਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: gagaa gobidh gun ravahu saas saas jap neet ||
verses.translation: GAGGA: Chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe with each and every breath; meditate on Him forever.

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਬਿਸਾਸਾ ਦੇਹ ਕਾ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਕਰਿਹੋ ਮੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa bisaasaa dheh kaa bilam na kariho meet ||
verses.translation: How can you rely on the body? Do not delay, my friend;

verses.original: ਨਹ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਨਹ ਜੋਬਨੈ ਨਹ ਬਿਰਧੀ ਕਛੁ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: neh baarik neh jobanai neh biradhee kachh ba(n)dh ||
verses.translation: there is nothing to stand in Death's way - neither in childhood, nor in youth, nor in old age.

verses.original: ਓਹ ਬੇਰਾ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਜਉ ਆਇ ਪਰੈ ਜਮ ਫੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: oh beraa neh boojheeaai jau aai parai jam fa(n)dh ||
verses.translation: That time is not known, when the noose of Death shall come and fall on you.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਚਤੁਰ ਪੇਖਿ ਰਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਹ ਠਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: giaanee dhiaanee chatur pekh rahan nahee ieh Thai ||
verses.translation: See, that even spiritual scholars, those who meditate, and those who are clever shall not stay in this place.

verses.original: ਛਾਡਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਗਈ ਮੂੜ ਤਹਾ ਲਪਟਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: chhaadd chhaadd sagalee giee mooR tahaa lapaTaeh ||
verses.translation: Only the fool clings to that, which everyone else has abandoned and left behind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹੈ ਜਾਹੂ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh simarat rahai jaahoo masatak bhaag ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one who has such good destiny written on his forehead remembers the Lord in meditation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਏ ਸਫਲ ਤੇ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਅਹਿ ਸੁਹਾਗ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: naanak aae safal te jaa kau prieh suhaag ||19||
verses.translation: O Nanak, blessed and fruitful is the coming of those who obtain the Beloved Lord as their Husband. ||19||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਘੋਖੇ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਸਭ ਆਨ ਨ ਕਥਤਉ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ghokhe saasatr bedh sabh aan na kathatau koi ||
verses.translation: I have searched all the Shaastras and the Vedas, and they say nothing except this:

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੁਣਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadhee hun hovat naanak ekai soi ||1||
verses.translation: "In the beginning, throughout the ages, now and forevermore, O Nanak, the One Lord alone exists."||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਘਘਾ ਘਾਲਹੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਏਹ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: ghaghaa ghaalahu maneh eh bin har dhoosar naeh ||
verses.translation: GHAGHA: Put this into your mind, that there is no one except the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਹ ਹੋਆ ਨਹ ਹੋਵਨਾ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਓਹੀ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: neh hoaa neh hovanaa jat kat ohee samaeh ||
verses.translation: There never was, and there never shall be. He is pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਘੂਲਹਿ ਤਉ ਮਨ ਜਉ ਆਵਹਿ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghooleh tau man jau aaveh saranaa ||
verses.translation: You shall be absorbed into Him, O mind, if you come to His Sanctuary.
In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall be of any real use to you.
So many work and slave continually, but they come to regret and repent in the end.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਹਾ ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin har bhagat kahaa thit paaveh ||
verses.translation: Without devotional worship of the Lord, how can they find stability?

verses.original: ਘੋਲਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਿਹ ਪੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: ghol mahaa ras a(n)mrit teh peeaa ||
verses.translation: They alone taste the supreme essence, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: naanak har gur jaa kau dheeaa ||20||
verses.translation: O Nanak, unto whom the Lord, the Guru, gives it. ||20||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਙਣਿ ਘਾਲੇ ਸਭ ਦਿਵਸ ਸਾਸ ਨਹ ਬਢਨ ਘਟਨ ਤਿਲੁ ਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: n(g)n ghaale sabh dhivas saas neh baddan ghaTan til saar ||
verses.translation: He has counted all the days and the breaths, and placed them in people's destiny; they do not increase or decrease one little bit.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨ ਲੋਰਹਿ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਊ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeevan loreh bharam moh naanak teuoo gavaar ||1||
verses.translation: Those who long to live in doubt and emotional attachment, O Nanak, are total fools. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਙੰਙਾ ਙ੍ਰਾਸੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਹ ਜੋ ਸਾਕਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨ ॥
verses.translit: n(g)(n)n(g)aa n(g)raasai kaal teh jo saakat prabh keen ||
verses.translation: NGANGA: Death seizes those whom God has made into faithless cynics.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨ ॥
verses.translit: anik jon janameh mareh aatam raam na cheen ||
verses.translation: They are born and they die, enduring countless incarnations; they do not realize the Lord, the Supreme Soul.
They alone find spiritual wisdom and meditation,
whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy;
no one is emancipated by counting and calculating.
The vessel of clay shall surely break.
They alone live, who, while alive, meditate on the Lord.
They are respected, O Nanak, and do not remain hidden. ||21||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਚਿਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਊਧ ਕਵਲ ਬਿਗਸਾਂਤ ॥
verses.translit: chit chitavau charanaarabi(n)dh uoodh kaval bigasaa(n)t ||
verses.translation: Focus your consciousness on His Lotus Feet, and the inverted lotus of your heart shall blossom forth.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਆਪਹਿ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਮਤਾਂਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pragaT bhe aapeh guobi(n)dh naanak sa(n)t mataa(n)t ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe Himself becomes manifest, O Nanak, through the Teachings of the Saints. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਚਚਾ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਾ ॥ ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਉਆ ਦਿਨ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: chachaa charan kamal gur laagaa || dhan dhan uaa dhin sa(n)jog sabhaagaa ||
verses.translation: CHACHA: Blessed, blessed is that day, when I became attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: chaar ku(n)T dheh dhis bhram aaio ||
verses.translation: After wandering around in the four quarters and the ten directions,
God showed His Mercy to me, and then I obtained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
By pure lifestyle and meditation, all duality is removed.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the mind becomes immaculate.
Anxieties are forgotten, and the One Lord alone is seen,
O Nanak, by those whose eyes are anointed with the ointment of spiritual wisdom. ||22||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਛਾਤੀ ਸੀਤਲ ਮਨੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਛੰਤ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: chhaatee seetal man sukhee chha(n)t gobidh gun gai ||
verses.translation: The heart is cooled and soothed, and the mind is at peace, chanting and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaisee kirapaa karahu prabh naanak dhaas dhasai ||1||
verses.translation: Show such Mercy, O God, that Nanak may become the slave of Your slaves. ||1||
Pauree:
CHHACHHA: I am Your child-slave.
I am the water-carrier of the slave of Your slaves.
Chhachha: I long to become the dust under the feet of Your Saints.
Please shower me with Your Mercy, O Lord God!
I have given up my excessive cleverness and scheming,
and I have taken the support of the Saints as my mind's support.

verses.original: ਛਾਰੁ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: chhaar kee putaree param gat paiee ||
verses.translation: Even a puppet of ashes attains the supreme status,
O Nanak, if it has the help and support of the Saints. ||23||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਜੋਰ ਜੁਲਮ ਫੂਲਹਿ ਘਨੋ ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jor julam fooleh ghano kaachee dheh bikaar ||
verses.translation: Practicing oppression and tyranny, he puffs himself up; he acts in corruption with his frail, perishable body.

verses.original: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਪਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਛੁਟਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aha(n)budh ba(n)dhan pare naanak naam chhuTaar ||1||
verses.translation: He is bound by his egotistical intellect; O Nanak, salvation comes only through the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
Pauree:
JAJJA: When someone, in his ego, believes that he has become something,
he is caught in his error, like a parrot in a trap.
When he believes, in his ego, that he is a devotee and a spiritual teacher,
then, in the world hereafter, the Lord of the Universe shall have no regard for him at all.
When he believes himself to be a preacher,
he is merely a peddler wandering over the earth.
But one who conquers his ego in the Company of the Holy,
O Nanak, meets the Lord. ||24||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਝਾਲਾਘੇ ਉਠਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: jhaalaaghe uTh naam jap nis baasur aaraadh ||
verses.translation: Rise early in the morning, and chant the Naam; worship and adore the Lord, night and day.

verses.original: ਕਾਰ੍ਹਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਨ ਬਿਆਪਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਟੈ ਉਪਾਧਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaarhaa tujhai na biaapiee naanak miTai upaadh ||1||
verses.translation: Anxiety shall not afflict you, O Nanak, and your misfortune shall vanish. ||1||
Pauree:
JHAJHA: Your sorrows shall depart,
when you deal with the Lord's Name.
The faithless cynic dies in sorrow and pain;

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਹੋਤ ਭਾਉ ਬੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai ridhai hot bhaau beeaa ||
verses.translation: his heart is filled with the love of duality.
Your evil deeds and sins shall fall away, O my mind,
listening to the ambrosial speech in the Society of the Saints.
Sexual desire, anger and wickedness fall away,
O Nanak, from those who are blessed by the Mercy of the Lord of the World. ||25||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਞਤਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: n(j)tan karahu tum anik bidh rahan na paavahu meet ||
verses.translation: You can try all sorts of things, but you still cannot remain here, my friend.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤ ਰਹਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeevat rahahu har har bhajahu naanak naam pareet ||1||
verses.translation: But you shall live forevermore, O Nanak, if you vibrate and love the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਞੰਞਾ ਞਾਣਹੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਸਹੀ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਤ ਏਹ ਹੇਤ ॥
verses.translit: n(j)(n)n(j)aa n(j)aanahu dhiraR sahee binas jaat eh het ||
verses.translation: NYANYA: Know this as absolutely correct, that that this ordinary love shall come to an end.

verses.original: ਗਣਤੀ ਗਣਉ ਨ ਗਣਿ ਸਕਉ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਕੇਤ ॥
verses.translit: ganatee ganau na gan sakau uooTh sidhaare ket ||
verses.translation: You may count and calculate as much as you want, but you cannot count how many have arisen and departed.

verses.original: ਞੋ ਪੇਖਉ ਸੋ ਬਿਨਸਤਉ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀਐ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: n(j)o pekhau so binasatau kaa siau kareeaai sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: Whoever I see shall perish. With whom should I associate?

verses.original: ਞਾਣਹੁ ਇਆ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਹੀ ਚਿਤ ਝੂਠਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: n(j)aanahu iaa bidh sahee chit jhooThau maiaa ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: Know this as true in your consciousness, that the love of Maya is false.

verses.original: ਞਾਣਤ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ਸੁਇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਤੇ ਕੀਚਿਤ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
verses.translit: n(j)aanat soiee sa(n)t sui bhram te keechit bhi(n)n ||
verses.translation: He alone knows, and he alone is a Saint, who is free of doubt.

verses.original: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਤਿਹ ਕਢਹੁ ਜਿਹ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dh koop te teh kaddahu jeh hovahu suprasa(n)n ||
verses.translation: He is lifted up and out of the deep dark pit; the Lord is totally pleased with him.

verses.original: ਞਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਤੇ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: n(j)aa kai haath samarath te kaaran karanai jog ||
verses.translation: God's Hand is All-powerful; He is the Creator, the Cause of causes.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਞਾਹੂ ਕੀਓ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: naanak teh usatat karau n(j)aahoo keeo sa(n)jog ||26||
verses.translation: O Nanak, praise the One, who joins us to Himself. ||26||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: TooTe ba(n)dhan janam maran saadh sev sukh pai ||
verses.translation: The bondage of birth and death is broken and peace is obtained, by serving the Holy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਬੀਸਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak manahu na beesarai gun nidh gobidh rai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, may I never forget from my mind, the Treasure of Virtue, the Sovereign Lord of the Universe. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਟਹਲ ਕਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: Tahal karahu tau ek kee jaa te birathaa na koi ||
verses.translation: Work for the One Lord; no one returns empty-handed from Him.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੀਐ ਬਸੈ ਜੋ ਚਾਹਹੁ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan mukh heeaai basai jo chaahahu so hoi ||
verses.translation: When the Lord abides within your mind, body, mouth and heart, then whatever you desire shall come to pass.

verses.original: ਟਹਲ ਮਹਲ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: Tahal mahal taa kau milai jaa kau saadh kirapaal ||
verses.translation: He alone obtains the Lord's service, and the Mansion of His Presence, unto whom the Holy Saint is compassionate.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਉ ਬਸੈ ਜਉ ਆਪਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)gat tau basai jau aapan hoh dhiaal ||
verses.translation: He joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, only when the Lord Himself shows His Mercy.

verses.original: ਟੋਹੇ ਟਾਹੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਵਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: Tohe Taahe bahu bhavan bin naavai sukh naeh ||
verses.translation: I have searched and searched, across so many worlds, but without the Name, there is no peace.

verses.original: ਟਲਹਿ ਜਾਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਤ ਤਿਹ ਜੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: Taleh jaam ke dhoot teh ju saadhoo sa(n)g samaeh ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death retreats from those who dwell in the Saadh Sangat.
Again and again, I am forever devoted to the Saints.
O Nanak, my sins from so long ago have been erased. ||27||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਠਾਕ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਿਨਹੁ ਦਰਿ ਜਿਹ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥
verses.translit: Thaak na hotee tinahu dhar jeh hovahu suprasa(n)n ||
verses.translation: Those beings, with whom the Lord is thoroughly pleased, meet with no obstacles at His Door.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo jan prabh apune kare naanak te dhan dha(n)n ||1||
verses.translation: Those humble beings whom God has made His own, O Nanak, are blessed, so very blessed. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਠਠਾ ਮਨੂਆ ਠਾਹਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥ ਜੋ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਏਕਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: ThaThaa manooaa Thaaheh naahee || jo sagal tiaag ekeh lapaTaahee ||
verses.translation: T'HAT'HA: Those who have abandoned all else, and who cling to the One Lord alone, do not make trouble for anyone's mind.
Those who are totally absorbed and preoccupied with Maya are dead;

verses.original: ਉਆ ਕੈ ਕੁਸਲ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਹੂਏ ॥
verses.translit: auaa kai kusal na katahoo hooe ||
verses.translation: they do not find happiness anywhere.
One who dwells in the Society of the Saints finds a great peace;
the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam becomes sweet to his soul.
That humble being, who is pleasing to his Lord and Master
- O Nanak, his mind is cooled and soothed. ||28||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਬੰਦਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥ ॥
verses.translit: dda(n)ddaut ba(n)dhan anik baar sarab kalaa samarath ||
verses.translation: I bow down, and fall to the ground in humble adoration, countless times, to the All-powerful Lord, who possesses all powers.

verses.original: ਡੋਲਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਥ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ddolan te raakhahu prabhoo naanak dhe kar hath ||1||
verses.translation: Please protect me, and save me from wandering, God. Reach out and give Nanak Your Hand. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਡਡਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਹ ਡੇਰਾ ਤਹ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: ddaddaa dderaa ih nahee jeh dderaa teh jaan ||
verses.translation: DADDA: This is not your true place; you must know where that place really is.

verses.original: ਉਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: auaa dderaa kaa sa(n)jamo gur kai sabadh pachhaan ||
verses.translation: You shall come to realize the way to that place, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਇਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕਉ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: eiaa dderaa kau sram kar ghaalai ||
verses.translation: This place, here, is established by hard work,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਤਸੂ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kaa tasoo nahee sa(n)g chaalai ||
verses.translation: but not one iota of this shall go there with you.

verses.original: ਉਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕੀ ਸੋ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: auaa dderaa kee so mit jaanai ||
verses.translation: The value of that place beyond is known only to those,
upon whom the Perfect Lord God casts His Glance of Grace.
That permanent and true place is obtained in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;
O Nanak, those humble beings do not waver or wander. ||29||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਢਾਹਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਿਨਹਿ ਨ ਘਾਲਿਓ ਬੰਧ ॥
verses.translit: ddaahan laage dharam rai kineh na ghaalio ba(n)dh ||
verses.translation: When the Righteous Judge of Dharma begins to destroy someone, no one can place any obstacle in His Way.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਨਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ubare jap haree saadhasa(n)g sanaba(n)dh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who join the Saadh Sangat and meditate on the Lord are saved. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਢਢਾ ਢੂਢਤ ਕਹ ਫਿਰਹੁ ਢੂਢਨੁ ਇਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: ddaddaa ddooddat keh firahu ddooddan iaa man maeh ||
verses.translation: DHADHA: Where are you going, wandering and searching? Search instead within your own mind.

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਸੈ ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g tuhaarai prabh basai ban ban kahaa firaeh ||
verses.translation: God is with you, so why do you wander around from forest to forest?
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, tear down the mound of your frightful, egotistical pride.

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਸਹੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: sukh paavahu sahaje basahu dharasan dhekh nihaal ||
verses.translation: You shall find peace, and abide in intuitive bliss; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan, you shall be delighted.

verses.original: ਢੇਰੀ ਜਾਮੈ ਜਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dderee jaamai jam marai garabh jon dhukh pai ||
verses.translation: One who has such a mound as this, dies and suffers the pain of reincarnation through the womb.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਲਪਟਤ ਰਹੈ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: moh magan lapaTat rahai hau hau aavai jai ||
verses.translation: One who is intoxicated by emotional attachment, entangled in egotism, selfishness and conceit, shall continue coming and going in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਢਹਤ ਢਹਤ ਅਬ ਢਹਿ ਪਰੇ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ddahat ddahat ab ddeh pare saadh janaa saranai ||
verses.translation: Slowly and steadily, I have now surrendered to the Holy Saints; I have come to their Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਏ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: dhukh ke faahe kaaTiaa naanak le'ee samai ||30||
verses.translation: God has cut away the noose of my pain; O Nanak, He has merged me into Himself. ||30||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਜਹ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: jeh saadhoo gobidh bhajan keeratan naanak neet ||
verses.translation: Where the Holy people constantly vibrate the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, O Nanak

verses.original: ਣਾ ਹਉ ਣਾ ਤੂੰ ਣਹ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਅਹੁ ਦੂਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naa hau naa too(n) neh chhuTeh nikaT na jaieeahu dhoot ||1||
verses.translation: - the Righteous Judge says, ""Do not approach that place, O Messenger of Death, or else neither you nor I shall escape!""||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਣਾਣਾ ਰਣ ਤੇ ਸੀਝੀਐ ਆਤਮ ਜੀਤੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanaa ran te seejheeaai aatam jeetai koi ||
verses.translation: NANNA: One who conquers his own soul, wins the battle of life.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੂ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai an siau lar marai so sobhaa dhoo hoi ||
verses.translation: One who dies, while fighting against egotism and alienation, becomes sublime and beautiful.

verses.original: ਮਣੀ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
verses.translit: manee miTai jeevat marai gur poore upadhes ||
verses.translation: One who eradicates his ego, remains dead while yet alive, through the Teachings of the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਮਨੂਆ ਜੀਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਹ ਸੂਰਤਣ ਵੇਸ ॥
verses.translit: manooaa jeetai har milai teh sooratan ves ||
verses.translation: He conquers his mind, and meets the Lord; he is dressed in robes of honor.

verses.original: ਣਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੋ ਏਕਹਿ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: naa ko jaanai aapano ekeh Tek adhaar ||
verses.translation: He does not claim anything as his own; the One Lord is his Anchor and Support.

verses.original: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਣਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: rain dhinas simarat rahai so prabh purakh apaar ||
verses.translation: Night and day, he continually contemplates the Almighty, Infinite Lord God.

verses.original: ਰੇਣ ਸਗਲ ਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਏਊ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ren sagal iaa man karai euoo karam kamai ||
verses.translation: He makes his mind the dust of all; such is the karma of the deeds he does.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: hukamai boojhai sadhaa sukh naanak likhiaa pai ||31||
verses.translation: Understanding the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he attains everlasting peace. O Nanak, such is his pre-ordained destiny. ||31||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਤਿਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: tan man dhan arapau tisai prabhoo milaavai moh ||
verses.translation: I offer my body, mind and wealth to anyone who can unite me with God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਉ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੋਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bhram bhau kaaTeeaai chookai jam kee joh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, my doubts and fears have been dispelled, and the Messenger of Death does not see me any longer. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਤਤਾ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tataa taa siau preet kar gun nidh gobidh rai ||
verses.translation: TATTA: Embrace love for the Treasure of Excellence, the Sovereign Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਬਾਛਤੇ ਤਪਤਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: fal paaveh man baachhate tapat tuhaaree jai ||
verses.translation: You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires, and your burning thirst shall be quenched.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੈ ਜਮ ਪੰਥ ਕੀ ਜਾਸੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: traas miTai jam pa(n)th kee jaas basai man naau ||
verses.translation: One whose heart is filled with the Name shall have no fear on the path of death.

verses.original: ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gat paaveh mat hoi pragaas mahalee paaveh Thaau ||
verses.translation: He shall obtain salvation, and his intellect shall be enlightened; he will find his place in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

verses.original: ਤਾਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਧਨੁ ਚਲੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜੋਬਨ ਨਹ ਰਾਜ ॥
verses.translit: taahoo sa(n)g na dhan chalai gireh joban neh raaj ||
verses.translation: Neither wealth, nor household, nor youth, nor power shall go along with you.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਹੁ ਇਹੈ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਕਾਜ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)g simarat rahahu ihai tuhaarai kaaj ||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, meditate in remembrance on the Lord. This alone shall be of use to you.

verses.original: ਤਾਤਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਜਉ ਤਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਆਪ ॥
verses.translit: taataa kachhoo na hoiee hai jau taap nivaarai aap ||
verses.translation: There will be no burning at all, when He Himself takes away your fever.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮਹਿ ਆਪਹਿ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: pratipaalai naanak hameh aapeh maiee baap ||32||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Himself cherishes us; He is our Mother and Father. ||32||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਥਾਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਘਾਲਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: thaake bahu bidh ghaalate tirapat na tirasanaa laath ||
verses.translation: They have grown weary, struggling in all sorts of ways; but they are not satisfied, and their thirst is not quenched.

verses.original: ਸੰਚਿ ਸੰਚਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਨ ਸਾਥ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)ch sa(n)ch saakat mooe naanak maiaa na saath ||1||
verses.translation: Gathering in and hoarding what they can, the faithless cynics die, O Nanak, but the wealth of Maya does not go with them in the end. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਥਥਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਕੋਊ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਇ ਪਸਾਰਹੁ ਪਾਵ ॥
verses.translit: thathaa thir kouoo nahee kai pasaarahu paav ||
verses.translation: T'HAT'HA: Nothing is permanent - why do you stretch out your feet?

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਬੰਚ ਬਲ ਛਲ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਏਕ ਉਪਾਵ ॥
verses.translit: anik ba(n)ch bal chhal karahu maiaa ek upaav ||
verses.translation: You commit so many fraudulent and deceitful actions as you chase after Maya.

verses.original: ਥੈਲੀ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਥਾਕਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: thailee sa(n)chahu sram karahu thaak parahu gaavaar ||
verses.translation: You work to fill up your bag, you fool, and then you fall down exhausted.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਅੰਤੇ ਅਉਸਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: man kai kaam na aaviee a(n)te aausar baar ||
verses.translation: But this shall be of no use to you at all at that very last instant.

verses.original: ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਹੁ ਸੰਤਹ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: thit paavahu gobidh bhajahu sa(n)teh kee sikh leh ||
verses.translation: You shall find stability only by vibrating upon the Lord of the Universe, and accepting the Teachings of the Saints.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਦ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਇਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਸਨੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: preet karahu sadh ek siau iaa saachaa asaneh ||
verses.translation: Embrace love for the One Lord forever - this is true love!

verses.original: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨੋ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਏਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: kaaran karan karaavano sabh bidh ekai haath ||
verses.translation: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes. All ways and means are in His Hands alone.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਅਨਾਥ ॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: jit jit laavahu tit tit lageh naanak ja(n)t anaath ||33||
verses.translation: Whatever You attach me to, to that I am attached; O Nanak, I am just a helpless creature. ||33||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਦਾਸਹ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhaaseh ek nihaariaa sabh kachh dhevanahaar ||
verses.translation: His slaves have gazed upon the One Lord, the Giver of everything.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saas saas simarat raheh naanak dharas adhaar ||1||
verses.translation: They continue to contemplate Him with each and every breath; O Nanak, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is their Support. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਦਦਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhadhaa dhaataa ek hai sabh kau dhevanahaar ||
verses.translation: DADDA: The One Lord is the Great Giver; He is the Giver to all.

verses.original: ਦੇਂਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਅਗਨਤ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhe(n)dhe toT na aaviee aganat bhare bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: There is no limit to His Giving. His countless warehouses are filled to overflowing.
The Great Giver is alive forever.
O foolish mind, why have you forgotten Him?
No one is at fault, my friend.
God created the bondage of emotional attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਆਪੇ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: dharadh nivaareh jaa ke aape || naanak te te gurmukh dhraape ||34||
verses.translation: He Himself removes the pains of the Gurmukh; O Nanak, he is fulfilled. ||34||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਧਰ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਇਕ ਟੇਕ ਤੂ ਲਾਹਿ ਬਿਡਾਨੀ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: dhar jeeare ik Tek too laeh biddaanee aas ||
verses.translation: O my soul, grasp the Support of the One Lord; give up your hopes in others.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam dhiaaieeaai kaaraj aavai raas ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, your affairs shall be resolved. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਧਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਤਉ ਮਿਟੈ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhadhaa dhaavat tau miTai sa(n)tasa(n)g hoi baas ||
verses.translation: DHADHA: The mind's wanderings cease, when one comes to dwell in the Society of the Saints.

verses.original: ਧੁਰ ਤੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਹਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhur te kirapaa karahu aap tau hoi maneh paragaas ||
verses.translation: If the Lord is Merciful from the very beginning, then one's mind is enlightened.
Those who have the true wealth are the true bankers.
The Lord, Har, Har, is their wealth, and they trade in His Name.
Patience, glory and honor come to those

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਜਿਹ ਸੁਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam sravan jeh suniaa ||
verses.translation: who listen to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
That Gurmukh whose heart remains merged with the Lord,
O Nanak, obtains glorious greatness. ||35||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak naam naam jap japiaa a(n)tar baahar ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who chants the Naam, and meditates on the Naam with love inwardly and outwardly,

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਨਰਕੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur poorai upadhesiaa narak naeh saadhasa(n)g ||1||
verses.translation: receives the Teachings from the Perfect Guru; he joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and does not fall into hell. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਨੰਨਾ ਨਰਕਿ ਪਰਹਿ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਸਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: na(n)naa narak pareh te naahee || jaa kai man tan naam basaahee ||
verses.translation: NANNA: Those whose minds and bodies are filled with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall not fall into hell.
Those Gurmukhs who chant the treasure of the Naam,

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਖਪਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: bikh maiaa meh naa oi khapate ||
verses.translation: are not destroyed by the poison of Maya.

verses.original: ਨੰਨਾਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਤਾ ਕਹੁ ॥ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਜਾ ਕਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: na(n)naakaar na hotaa taa kahu || naam ma(n)tr gur dheeno jaa kahu ||
verses.translation: Those who have been given the Mantra of the Naam by the Guru, shall not be turned away.
They are filled and fulfilled with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, the Treasure of sublime wealth;
O Nanak, the unstruck celestial melody vibrates for them. ||36||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤਜਿ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: pat raakhee gur paarabraham taj parapa(n)ch moh bikaar ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the Supreme Lord God, preserved my honor, when I renounced hypocrisy, emotional attachment and corruption.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਊ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak souoo aaraadheeaai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, worship and adore the One, who has no end or limitation. ||1||
Pauree:
PAPPA: He is beyond estimation; His limits cannot be found.
The Sovereign Lord King is inaccessible;
He is the Purifier of sinners. Millions of sinners are purified;
they meet the Holy, and chant the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Deception, fraud and emotional attachment are eliminated,
by those who are protected by the Lord of the World.
He is the Supreme King, with the royal canopy above His Head.
O Nanak, there is no other at all. ||37||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਗਵਨ ਫਤਿਹ ਭਈ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: faahe kaaTe miTe gavan fateh bhiee man jeet ||
verses.translation: The noose of Death is cut, and one's wanderings cease; victory is obtained, when one conquers his own mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਥਿਤ ਪਾਈ ਫਿਰਨ ਮਿਟੇ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gur te thit paiee firan miTe nit neet ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, eternal stability is obtained from the Guru, and one's day-to-day wanderings cease. ||1||
Pauree:
FAFFA: After wandering and wandering for so long, you have come;
in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, you have obtained this human body, so very difficult to obtain.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਇਆ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਨ ਹਾਥਾ ॥
