verses.translit: fir iaa aausar charai na haathaa ||
verses.translation: This opportunity shall not come into your hands again.
So chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the noose of Death shall be cut away.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: fir fir aavan jaan na hoiee ||
verses.translation: You shall not have to come and go in reincarnation over and over again,
if you chant and meditate on the One and Only Lord.
Shower Your Mercy, O God, Creator Lord,
and unite poor Nanak with Yourself. ||38||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: binau sunahu tum paarabraham dheen dhiaal gupaal ||
verses.translation: Hear my prayer, O Supreme Lord God, Merciful to the meek, Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪੈ ਬਹੁ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sukh sa(n)pai bahu bhog ras naanak saadh ravaal ||1||
verses.translation: The dust of the feet of the Holy is peace, wealth, great enjoyment and pleasure for Nanak. ||1||
Pauree:
BABBA: One who knows God is a Brahmin.
A Vaishnaav is one who, as Gurmukh, lives the righteous life of Dharma.
One who eradicates his own evil is a brave warrior;
no evil even approaches him.
Man is bound by the chains of his own egotism, selfishness and conceit.
The spiritually blind place the blame on others.
But all debates and clever tricks are of no use at all.
O Nanak, he alone comes to know, whom the Lord inspires to know. ||39||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਅਘ ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bha(n)jan agh dhookh naas maneh araadh hare ||
verses.translation: The Destroyer of fear, the Eradicator of sin and sorrow - enshrine that Lord in your mind.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗ ਜਿਹ ਰਿਦ ਬਸਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਨ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)g jeh ridh basio naanak te na bhrame ||1||
verses.translation: One whose heart abides in the Society of the Saints, O Nanak, does not wander around in doubt. ||1||
Pauree:
BHABHA: Cast out your doubt and delusion
this world is just a dream.
The angelic beings, goddesses and gods are deluded by doubt.
The Siddhas and seekers, and even Brahma are deluded by doubt.
Wandering around, deluded by doubt, people are ruined.
It is so very difficult and treacherous to cross over this ocean of Maya.
That Gurmukh who has eradicated doubt, fear and attachment,
O Nanak, obtains supreme peace. ||40||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਪਟਿਓ ਤਿਹ ਸੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa ddolai bahu bidhee man lapaTio teh sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: Maya clings to the mind, and causes it to waver in so many ways.

verses.original: ਮਾਗਨ ਤੇ ਜਿਹ ਤੁਮ ਰਖਹੁ ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਹਿ ਰੰਗ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maagan te jeh tum rakhahu su naanak naameh ra(n)g ||1||
verses.translation: When You, O Lord, restrain someone from asking for wealth, then, O Nanak, he comes to love the Name. ||1||
Pauree:
MAMMA: The beggar is so ignorant
the Great Giver continues to give. He is All-knowing.
Whatever He gives, He gives once and for all.
O foolish mind, why do you complain, and cry out so loud?
Whenever you ask for something, you ask for worldly things;

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਕੁਸਲ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਥੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaa te kusal na kaahoo theeaa ||
verses.translation: no one has obtained happiness from these.
If you must ask for a gift, then ask for the One Lord.
O Nanak, by Him, you shall be saved. ||41||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: mat pooree paradhaan te gur poore man ma(n)t ||
verses.translation: Perfect is the intellect, and most distinguished is the reputation, of those whose minds are filled with the Mantra of the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeh jaanio prabh aapunaa naanak te bhagava(n)t ||1||
verses.translation: Those who come to know their God, O Nanak, are very fortunate. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਮਮਾ ਜਾਹੂ ਮਰਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥ ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਪਤੀਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: mamaa jaahoo maram pachhaanaa || bheTat saadhasa(n)g pateeaanaa ||
verses.translation: MAMMA: Those who understand God's mystery are satisfied, joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਉਆ ਕੈ ਸਮਤ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh uaa kai samat beechaaraa ||
verses.translation: They look upon pleasure and pain as the same.
They are exempt from incarnation into heaven or hell.
They live in the world, and yet they are detached from it.
The Sublime Lord, the Primal Being, is totally pervading each and every heart.

verses.original: ਉਆ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਉਆਹੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: auaa ras meh uaahoo sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: In His Love, they find peace.
O Nanak, Maya does not cling to them at all. ||42||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਯਾਰ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਾਜਨਹੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: yaar meet sun saajanahu bin har chhooTan naeh ||
verses.translation: Listen, my dear friends and companions: without the Lord, there is no salvation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak teh ba(n)dhan kaTe gur kee charanee paeh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who falls at the Feet of the Guru, has his bonds cut away. ||1||
Pauree:
YAYYA: People try all sorts of things,

verses.original: ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਹ ਲਉ ਸਿਧੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: ek naam bin keh lau sidheeaa ||
verses.translation: but without the One Name, how far can they succeed?
Those efforts, by which emancipation may be attained
those efforts are made in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
Everyone has this idea of salvation,

verses.original: ਉਆਹਿ ਜਪੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਉਬਰ ਨ ਹੋਊ ॥
verses.translit: auaaeh jape bin ubar na houoo ||
verses.translation: but without meditation, there can be no salvation.
The All-powerful Lord is the boat to carry us across.
O Lord, please save these worthless beings!

verses.original: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਜਿਹ ਆਪਿ ਜਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man bach karam jeh aap janaiee ||
verses.translation: Those whom the Lord Himself instructs in thought, word and deed
- O Nanak, their intellect is enlightened. ||43||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਸੰਗ ਕਰਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: ros na kaahoo sa(n)g karahu aapan aap beechaar ||
verses.translation: Do not be angry with anyone else; look within your own self instead.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਨਾ ਜਗਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hoi nimaanaa jag rahahu naanak nadharee paar ||1||
verses.translation: Be humble in this world, O Nanak, and by His Grace you shall be carried across. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਰਾਰਾ ਰੇਨ ਹੋਤ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: raaraa ren hot sabh jaa kee ||
verses.translation: RARRA: Be the dust under the feet of all.
Give up your egotistical pride, and the balance of your account shall be written off.
Then, you shall win the battle in the Court of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jau gurmukh raam naam liv laiee ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, lovingly attune yourself to the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਰਹਤ ਰਹਤ ਰਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: rahat rahat reh jaeh bikaaraa || gur poore kai sabadh apaaraa ||
verses.translation: Your evil ways shall be slowly and steadily blotted out, by the Shabad, the Incomparable Word of the Perfect Guru.
You shall be imbued with the Lord's Love, and intoxicated with the Nectar of the Naam.
O Nanak, the Lord, the Guru, has given this gift. ||44||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਇਆ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: laalach jhooTh bikhai biaadh iaa dhehee meh baas ||
verses.translation: The afflictions of greed, falsehood and corruption abide in this body.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੂਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har a(n)mrit gurmukh peeaa naanak sookh nivaas ||1||
verses.translation: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, O Nanak, the Gurmukh abides in peace. ||1||
Pauree:
LALLA: One who takes the medicine of the Naam, the Name of the Lord,
is cured of his pain and sorrow in an instant.
One whose heart is filled with the medicine of the Naam,
is not infested with disease, even in his dreams.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har aaukhadh sabh ghaT hai bhaiee ||
verses.translation: The medicine of the Lord's Name is in all hearts, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore bin bidh na banaiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Perfect Guru, no one knows how to prepare it.
When the Perfect Guru gives the instructions to prepare it,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੪੫॥
verses.translit: naanak tau fir dhookh na theeaa ||45||
verses.translation: then, O Nanak, one does not suffer illness again. ||45||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਵਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਊਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਠਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaasudhev sarabatr mai uoon na katahoo Thai ||
verses.translation: The All-pervading Lord is in all places. There is no place where He does not exist.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਇ ਦੁਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar sa(n)g hai naanak kai dhurai ||1||
verses.translation: Inside and outside, He is with you. O Nanak, what can be hidden from Him? ||1||
Pauree:
WAWWA: Do not harbor hatred against anyone.
In each and every heart, God is contained.
The All-pervading Lord is permeating and pervading the oceans and the land.
How rare are those who, by Guru's Grace, sing of Him.

verses.original: ਵੈਰ ਵਿਰੋਧ ਮਿਟੇ ਤਿਹ ਮਨ ਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: vair virodh miTe teh man te ||
verses.translation: Hatred and alienation depart from those
who, as Gurmukh, listen to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਵਰਨ ਚਿਹਨ ਸਗਲਹ ਤੇ ਰਹਤਾ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋ ਕਹਤਾ ॥੪੬॥
verses.translit: varan chihan sagaleh te rahataa || naanak har har gurmukh jo kahataa ||46||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who becomes Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and rises above all social classes and status symbols. ||46||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਨੀਆ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: hau hau karat bihaaneeaa saakat mugadh ajaan ||
verses.translation: Acting in egotism, selfishness and conceit, the foolish, ignorant, faithless cynic wastes his life.

verses.original: ੜੜਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਜਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: RaRak mue jiau tirakhaava(n)t naanak kirat kamaan ||1||
verses.translation: He dies in agony, like one dying of thirst; O Nanak, this is because of the deeds he has done. ||1||
Pauree:
RARRA: Conflict is eliminated in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;
meditate in adoration on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the essence of karma and Dharma.
When the Beautiful Lord abides within the heart,
conflict is erased and ended.
The foolish, faithless cynic picks arguments
his heart is filled with corruption and egotistical intellect.

verses.original: ੜਾੜਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ੜਾੜਿ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥੪੭॥
verses.translit: RaaRaa gurmukh RaaR miTaiee || nimakh maeh naanak samajhaiee ||47||
verses.translation: RARRA: For the Gurmukh, conflict is eliminated in an instant, O Nanak, through the Teachings. ||47||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਓਟ ਗਹੁ ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo kee man oT gahu ukat siaanap tiaag ||
verses.translation: O mind, grasp the Support of the Holy Saint; give up your clever arguments.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਜਿਹ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur dheekhiaa jeh man basai naanak masatak bhaag ||1||
verses.translation: One who has the Guru's Teachings within his mind, O Nanak, has good destiny inscribed upon his forehead. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਸਾ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਅਬ ਹਾਰੇ ॥ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੂਕਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sasaa saran pare ab haare || saasatr simirat bedh pookaare ||
verses.translation: SASSA: I have now entered Your Sanctuary, Lord; I am so tired of reciting the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas.
I searched and searched and searched, and now I have come to realize,
that without meditating on the Lord, there is no emancipation.
With each and every breath, I make mistakes.
You are All-powerful, endless and infinite.
I seek Your Sanctuary - please save me, Merciful Lord!
Nanak is Your child, O Lord of the World. ||48||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਖੁਦੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਤਬ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਅਰੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: khudhee miTee tab sukh bhe man tan bhe arog ||
verses.translation: When selfishness and conceit are erased, peace comes, and the mind and body are healed.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਇਆ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dhirasaTee aaiaa usatat karanai jog ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, then He comes to be seen - the One who is worthy of praise. ||1||
Pauree:
KHAKHA: Praise and extol Him on High,

verses.original: ਜੋ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਊਨੇ ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰਾਹੂ ॥
verses.translit: jo khin meh uoone subhar bharaahoo ||
verses.translation: who fills the empty to over-flowing in an instant.
When the mortal being becomes totally humble,
then he meditates night and day on God, the Detached Lord of Nirvaanaa.

verses.original: ਭਾਵੈ ਖਸਮ ਤ ਉਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhaavai khasam ta uaa sukh dhetaa ||
verses.translation: If it pleases the Will of our Lord and Master, then He blesses us with peace.
Such is the Infinite, Supreme Lord God.
He forgives countless sins in an instant.
O Nanak, our Lord and Master is merciful forever. ||49||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਕਹਉ ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sat kahau sun man mere saran parahu har rai ||
verses.translation: I speak the Truth - listen, O my mind: take to the Sanctuary of the Sovereign Lord King.

verses.original: ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਏ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aukat siaanap sagal tiaag naanak le samai ||1||
verses.translation: Give up all your clever tricks, O Nanak, and He shall absorb you into Himself. ||1||
Pauree:
SASSA: Give up your clever tricks, you ignorant fool!
God is not pleased with clever tricks and commands.
You may practice a thousand forms of cleverness,
but not even one will go along with you in the end.
Meditate on that Lord, that Lord, day and night.
O soul, He alone shall go along with you.
Those whom the Lord Himself commits to the service of the Holy,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥੫੦॥
verses.translit: naanak taa kau dhookh na biaapai ||50||
verses.translation: O Nanak, are not afflicted by suffering. ||50||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਬੋਲਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har har mukh te bolanaa man vooThai sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and keeping it in your mind, you shall find peace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sabh meh rav rahiaa thaan thana(n)tar soi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord is pervading everywhere; He is contained in all spaces and interspaces. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਹੇਰਉ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਗਲ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: herau ghaT ghaT sagal kai poor rahe bhagavaan ||
verses.translation: Behold! The Lord God is totally pervading each and every heart.

verses.original: ਹੋਵਤ ਆਏ ਸਦ ਸਦੀਵ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
verses.translit: hovat aae sadh sadheev dhukh bha(n)jan gur giaan ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, the Guru's wisdom has been the Destroyer of pain.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਛੁਟਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਤਿਹ ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਹ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: hau chhuTakai hoi ana(n)dh teh hau naahee teh aap ||
verses.translation: Quieting the ego, ecstasy is obtained. Where the ego does not exist, God Himself is there.

verses.original: ਹਤੇ ਦੂਖ ਜਨਮਹ ਮਰਨ ਸੰਤਸੰਗ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: hate dhookh janameh maran sa(n)tasa(n)g parataap ||
verses.translation: The pain of birth and death is removed, by the power of the Society of the Saints.

verses.original: ਹਿਤ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥ ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਤ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: hit kar naam dhiraRai dhiaalaa || sa(n)teh sa(n)g hot kirapaalaa ||
verses.translation: He becomes kind to those who lovingly enshrine the Name of the Merciful Lord within their hearts, in the Society of the Saints.
In this world, no one accomplishes anything by himself.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੂਆ ॥੫੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sabh kachh prabh te hooaa ||51||
verses.translation: O Nanak, everything is done by God. ||51||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਲੇਖੈ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭੂਲਨਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: lekhai kateh na chhooTeeaai khin khin bhoolanahaar ||
verses.translation: Because of the balance due on his account, he can never be released; he makes mistakes each and every moment.

verses.original: ਬਖਸਨਹਾਰ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bakhasanahaar bakhas lai naanak paar utaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Forgiving Lord, please forgive me, and carry Nanak across. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰ ਬੇਗਾਨਾ ਅਲਪ ਮਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: loon haraamee gunahagaar begaanaa alap mat ||
verses.translation: The sinner is unfaithful to himself; he is ignorant, with shallow understanding.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਏ ਤਾਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਤਤ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd jin sukh dhe'ee taeh na jaanat tat ||
verses.translation: He does not know the essence of all, the One who gave him body, soul and peace.

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਢੂਢਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: laahaa maiaa kaarane dheh dhis ddooddan jai ||
verses.translation: For the sake of personal profit and Maya, he goes out, searching in the ten directions.

verses.original: ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਸਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhevanahaar dhaataar prabh nimakh na maneh basai ||
verses.translation: He does not enshrine the Generous Lord God, the Great Giver, in his mind, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੋਹ ਇਆ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: laalach jhooTh bikaar moh iaa sa(n)pai man maeh ||
verses.translation: Greed, falsehood, corruption and emotional attachment - these are what he collects within his mind.

verses.original: ਲੰਪਟ ਚੋਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਹਾ ਤਿਨਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: la(n)paT chor ni(n)dhak mahaa tinahoo sa(n)g bihai ||
verses.translation: The worst perverts, thieves and slanderers - he passes his time with them.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਖਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tudh bhaavai taa bakhas laih khoTe sa(n)g khare ||
verses.translation: But if it pleases You, Lord, then You forgive the counterfeit along with the genuine.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਾਹਨ ਨੀਰਿ ਤਰੇ ॥੫੨॥
verses.translit: naanak bhaavai paarabraham paahan neer tare ||52||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if it pleases the Supreme Lord God, then even a stone will float on water. ||52||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਤ ਖੇਲਤ ਹਸਤ ਭਰਮੇ ਜਨਮ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: khaat peet khelat hasat bharame janam anek ||
verses.translation: Eating, drinking, playing and laughing, I have wandered through countless incarnations.

verses.original: ਭਵਜਲ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhavajal te kaaddahu prabhoo naanak teree Tek ||1||
verses.translation: Please, God, lift me up and out of the terrifying world-ocean. Nanak seeks Your Support. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਖੇਲਤ ਖੇਲਤ ਆਇਓ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: khelat khelat aaio anik jon dhukh pai ||
verses.translation: Playing, playing, I have been reincarnated countless times, but this has only brought pain.

verses.original: ਖੇਦ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਲਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: khedh miTe saadhoo milat satigur bachan samai ||
verses.translation: Troubles are removed, when one meets with the Holy; immerse yourself in the Word of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਖਿਮਾ ਗਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਚਿਓ ਖਾਇਓ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: khimaa gahee sach sa(n)chio khaio a(n)mrit naam ||
verses.translation: Adopting an attitude of tolerance, and gathering truth, partake of the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name.

verses.original: ਖਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਈ ਅਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: kharee kirapaa Thaakur bhiee anadh sookh bisraam ||
verses.translation: When my Lord and Master showed His Great Mercy, I found peace, happiness and bliss.

verses.original: ਖੇਪ ਨਿਬਾਹੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲਾਭ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਪਤਿਵੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: khep nibaahee bahut laabh ghar aae pativa(n)t ||
verses.translation: My merchandise has arrived safely, and I have made a great profit; I have returned home with honor.

verses.original: ਖਰਾ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: kharaa dhilaasaa gur dheeaa aai mile bhagava(n)t ||
verses.translation: The Guru has given me great consolation, and the Lord God has come to meet me.

verses.original: ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: aapan keeaa kareh aap aagai paachhai aap ||
verses.translation: He Himself has acted, and He Himself acts. He was in the past, and He shall be in the future.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਊ ਸਰਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥੫੩॥
verses.translit: naanak souoo saraaheeaai j ghaT ghaT rahiaa biaap ||53||
verses.translation: O Nanak, praise the One, who is contained in each and every heart. ||53||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਾਗਤੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: aae prabh saranaagatee kirapaa nidh dhiaal ||
verses.translation: O God, I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Merciful Lord, Ocean of compassion.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਅਖਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਬਸਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ek akhar har man basat naanak hot nihaal ||1||
verses.translation: One whose mind is filled with the One Word of the Lord, O Nanak, becomes totally blissful. ||1||
Pauree:
In the Word, God established the three worlds.
Created from the Word, the Vedas are contemplated.
From the Word, came the Shaastras, Simritees and Puraanas.
From the Word, came the sound current of the Naad, speeches and explanations.
From the Word, comes the way of liberation from fear and doubt.
From the Word, come religious rituals, karma, sacredness and Dharma.
In the visible universe, the Word is seen.
O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God remains unattached and untouched. ||54||
Shalok:
With pen in hand, the Inaccessible Lord writes man's destiny on his forehead.

verses.original: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪਾਵਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: aurajh rahio sabh sa(n)g anoop roopaavatee ||
verses.translation: The Lord of Incomparable Beauty is involved with all.

verses.original: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: ausatat kahan na jai mukhahu tuhaareeaa ||
verses.translation: I cannot describe Your Praises with my mouth, O Lord.
Nanak is fascinated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; he is a sacrifice to You. ||1||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਹੇ ਅਚੁਤ ਹੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਘਨਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: he achut he paarabraham abinaasee aghanaas ||
verses.translation: O Immovable Lord, O Supreme Lord God, Imperishable, Destroyer of sins:

verses.original: ਹੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੇ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: he pooran he sarab mai dhukh bha(n)jan gunataas ||
verses.translation: O Perfect, All-pervading Lord, Destroyer of pain, Treasure of virtue:

verses.original: ਹੇ ਸੰਗੀ ਹੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਹੇ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਸਭ ਟੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: he sa(n)gee he nira(n)kaar he niragun sabh Tek ||
verses.translation: O Companion, Formless, Absolute Lord, Support of all:

verses.original: ਹੇ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਹੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: he gobidh he gun nidhaan jaa kai sadhaa bibek ||
verses.translation: O Lord of the Universe, Treasure of excellence, with clear eternal understanding:

verses.original: ਹੇ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਹਿ ਭੀ ਹੋਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: he apara(n)par har hare heh bhee hovanahaar ||
verses.translation: Most Remote of the Remote, Lord God: You are, You were, and You shall always be.

verses.original: ਹੇ ਸੰਤਹ ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਧਾਰਾ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: he sa(n)teh kai sadhaa sa(n)g nidhaaraa aadhaar ||
verses.translation: O Constant Companion of the Saints, You are the Support of the unsupported.

verses.original: ਹੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਉ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: he Thaakur hau dhaasaro mai niragun gun nahee koi ||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, I am Your slave. I am worthless, I have no worth at all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਰਾਖਉ ਹੀਐ ਪਰੋਇ ॥੫੫॥
verses.translit: naanak dheejai naam dhaan raakhau heeaai paroi ||55||
verses.translation: Nanak: grant me the Gift of Your Name, Lord, that I may string it and keep it within my heart. ||55||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਿਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurdhev maataa gurdhev pitaa gurdhev suaamee paramesuraa ||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru is our mother, the Divine Guru is our father; the Divine Guru is our Lord and Master, the Transcendent Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਖਾ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਬੰਧਿਪ ਸਹੋਦਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurdhev sakhaa agiaan bha(n)jan gurdhev ba(n)dhip sahodharaa ||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru is my companion, the Destroyer of ignorance; the Divine Guru is my relative and brother.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੰਤੁ ਨਿਰੋਧਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurdhev dhaataa har naam upadhesai gurdhev ma(n)t nirodharaa ||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru is the Giver, the Teacher of the Lord's Name. The Divine Guru is the Mantra which never fails.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਪਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurdhev saa(n)t sat budh moorat gurdhev paaras paras paraa ||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru is the image of peace, truth and wisdom. The Divine Guru is the Philosopher's Stone - touching it, one is transformed.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਜਨੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurdhev teerath a(n)mirat sarovar gur giaan majan apara(n)paraa ||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage, and the pool of divine nectar; bathing in the Guru's wisdom, one experiences the Infinite.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਹਰਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਕਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurdhev karataa sabh paap harataa gurdhev patit pavit karaa ||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru is the Creator, and the Destroyer of all sins; the Divine Guru is the Purifier of sinners.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਧਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurdhev aadh jugaadh jug jug gurdhev ma(n)t har jap udharaa ||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru existed in the very beginning, throughout the ages, in each and every age. The Divine Guru is the Mantra of the Lord's Name; chanting it, one is saved.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurdhev sa(n)gat prabh mel kar kirapaa ham mooR paapee jit lag taraa ||
verses.translation: O God, please be merciful to me, that I may be with the Divine Guru; I am a foolish sinner, but holding onto Him, I will be carried across.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurdhev satigur paarabraham paramesar gurdhev naanak har namasakaraa ||1||
verses.translation: The Divine Guru is the True Guru, the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord; Nanak bows in humble reverence to the Lord, the Divine Guru. ||1||
Read this Shalok at the beginning, and at the end. ||
Gauree Sukhmani, Fifth Mehla,
Shalok:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
I bow to the Primal Guru.
I bow to the Guru of the ages.
I bow to the True Guru.
I bow to the Great, Divine Guru. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.
Worry and anguish shall be dispelled from your body.
Remember in praise the One who pervades the whole Universe.
His Name is chanted by countless people, in so many ways.
The Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, the purest of utterances,
were created from the One Word of the Name of the Lord.
That one, in whose soul the One Lord dwells

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਗਨੀ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: taa kee mahimaa ganee na aavai ||
verses.translation: the praises of his glory cannot be recounted.
Those who yearn only for the blessing of Your Darshan
- Nanak: save me along with them! ||1||
Sukhmani: Peace of Mind, the Nectar of the Name of God.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa kai man bisraam || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The minds of the devotees abide in a joyful peace. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਬਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kai simaran garabh na basai ||
verses.translation: Remembering God, one does not have to enter into the womb again.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਜਮੁ ਨਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kai simaran dhookh jam nasai ||
verses.translation: Remembering God, the pain of death is dispelled.
Remembering God, death is eliminated.
Remembering God, one's enemies are repelled.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh simarat kachh bighan na laagai ||
verses.translation: Remembering God, no obstacles are met.
Remembering God, one remains awake and aware, night and day.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kai simaran bhau na biaapai ||
verses.translation: Remembering God, one is not touched by fear.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kai simaran dhukh na sa(n)taapai ||
verses.translation: Remembering God, one does not suffer sorrow.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kaa simaran saadh kai sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: The meditative remembrance of God is in the Company of the Holy.
All treasures, O Nanak, are in the Love of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kai simaran ridh sidh nau nidh ||
verses.translation: In the remembrance of God are wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kai simaran giaan dhiaan tat budh ||
verses.translation: In the remembrance of God are knowledge, meditation and the essence of wisdom.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kai simaran jap tap poojaa ||
verses.translation: In the remembrance of God are chanting, intense meditation and devotional worship.
In the remembrance of God, duality is removed.
In the remembrance of God are purifying baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
In the remembrance of God, one attains honor in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kai simaran hoi su bhalaa ||
verses.translation: In the remembrance of God, one becomes good.
In the remembrance of God, one flowers in fruition.
They alone remember Him in meditation, whom He inspires to meditate.
Nanak grasps the feet of those humble beings. ||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kaa simaran sabh te uoochaa ||
verses.translation: The remembrance of God is the highest and most exalted of all.
In the remembrance of God, many are saved.
In the remembrance of God, thirst is quenched.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kai simaran sabh kichh sujhai ||
verses.translation: In the remembrance of God, all things are known.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kai simaran naahee jam traasaa ||
verses.translation: In the remembrance of God, there is no fear of death.
In the remembrance of God, hopes are fulfilled.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kai simaran man kee mal jai ||
verses.translation: In the remembrance of God, the filth of the mind is removed.
The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is absorbed into the heart.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਬਸਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh jee baseh saadh kee rasanaa ||
verses.translation: God abides upon the tongues of His Saints.
Nanak is the servant of the slave of His slaves. ||4||
Those who remember God are wealthy.
Those who remember God are honorable.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kau simareh se jan paravaan ||
verses.translation: Those who remember God are approved.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kau simareh se purakh pradhaan ||
verses.translation: Those who remember God are the most distinguished persons.
Those who remember God are not lacking.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kau simareh s sarab ke raaje ||
verses.translation: Those who remember God are the rulers of all.
Those who remember God dwell in peace.
Those who remember God are immortal and eternal.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਨ ਤੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਿਨ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: simaran te laage jin aap dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: They alone hold to the remembrance of Him, unto whom He Himself shows His Mercy.
Nanak begs for the dust of their feet. ||5||
Those who remember God generously help others.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kau simareh tin sadh balihaaree ||
verses.translation: Those who remember God - to them, I am forever a sacrifice.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਮੁਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kau simareh se mukh suhaave ||
verses.translation: Those who remember God - their faces are beautiful.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੂਖਿ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kau simareh tin sookh bihaavai ||
verses.translation: Those who remember God abide in peace.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਆਤਮੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kau simareh tin aatam jeetaa ||
verses.translation: Those who remember God conquer their souls.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kau simareh tin niramal reetaa ||
verses.translation: Those who remember God have a pure and spotless lifestyle.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਅਨਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kau simareh tin anadh ghanere ||
verses.translation: Those who remember God experience all sorts of joys.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kau simareh baseh har nere ||
verses.translation: Those who remember God abide near the Lord.
By the Grace of the Saints, one remains awake and aware, night and day.
O Nanak, this meditative remembrance comes only by perfect destiny. ||6||
Remembering God, one's works are accomplished.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kai simaran kabahu na jhoore ||
verses.translation: Remembering God, one never grieves.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kai simaran har gun baanee ||
verses.translation: Remembering God, one speaks the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Remembering God, one is absorbed into the state of intuitive ease.
Remembering God, one attains the unchanging position.
Remembering God, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.
Remembering God, the unstruck melody vibrates.

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sukh prabh simaran kaa a(n)t na paar ||
verses.translation: The peace of the meditative remembrance of God has no end or limitation.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: simareh se jan jin kau prabh miaa ||
verses.translation: They alone remember Him, upon whom God bestows His Grace.
Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of those humble beings. ||7||
Remembering the Lord, His devotees are famous and radiant.
Remembering the Lord, the Vedas were composed.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਭਏ ਸਿਧ ਜਤੀ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: har simaran bhe sidh jatee dhaate ||
verses.translation: Remembering the Lord, we become Siddhas, celibates and givers.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨੀਚ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: har simaran neech chahu ku(n)T jaate ||
verses.translation: Remembering the Lord, the lowly become known in all four directions.
For the remembrance of the Lord, the whole world was established.
Remember, remember in meditation the Lord, the Creator, the Cause of causes.
For the remembrance of the Lord, He created the whole creation.
In the remembrance of the Lord, He Himself is Formless.
By His Grace, He Himself bestows understanding.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh har simaran tin paiaa ||8||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh attains the remembrance of the Lord. ||8||1||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dharadh dhukh bha(n)janaa ghaT ghaT naath anaath ||
verses.translation: O Destroyer of the pains and the suffering of the poor, O Master of each and every heart, O Masterless One:

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਥ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saran tum(h)aaree aaio naanak ke prabh saath ||1||
verses.translation: I have come seeking Your Sanctuary. O God, please be with Nanak! ||1||
Ashtapadee:

verses.original: ਜਹ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh maat pitaa sut meet na bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Where there is no mother, father, children, friends or siblings

verses.original: ਮਨ ਊਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man uoohaa naam terai sa(n)g sahaiee ||
verses.translation: O my mind, there, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall be with you as your help and support.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਦੂਤ ਜਮ ਦਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh mahaa bhiaan dhoot jam dhalai ||
verses.translation: Where the great and terrible Messenger of Death shall try to crush you,

verses.original: ਤਹ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: teh keval naam sa(n)g terai chalai ||
verses.translation: there, only the Naam shall go along with you.
Where the obstacles are so very heavy,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ko naam khin maeh udhaaree ||
verses.translation: the Name of the Lord shall rescue you in an instant.
By performing countless religious rituals, you shall not be saved.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਪ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: har ko naam koT paap paraharai ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord washes off millions of sins.
As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, O my mind.
O Nanak, you shall obtain countless joys. ||1||
The rulers of the all the world are unhappy;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਖੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam japat hoi sukheeaa ||
verses.translation: one who chants the Name of the Lord becomes happy.
Acquiring hundreds of thousands and millions, your desires shall not be contained.
Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall find release.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਤਿਖ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: anik maiaa ra(n)g tikh na bujhaavai ||
verses.translation: By the countless pleasures of Maya, your thirst shall not be quenched.
Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall be satisfied.
Upon that path where you must go all alone,

verses.original: ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਤ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: teh har naam sa(n)g hot suhelaa ||
verses.translation: there, only the Lord's Name shall go with you to sustain you.
On such a Name, O my mind, meditate forever.
O Nanak, as Gurmukh, you shall obtain the state of supreme dignity. ||2||
You shall not be saved by hundreds of thousands and millions of helping hands.
Chanting the Naam, you shall be lifted up and carried across.
Where countless misfortunes threaten to destroy you,
the Name of the Lord shall rescue you in an instant.
Through countless incarnations, you were born, then died and then born again.
Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall come to rest in peace.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਮੈਲਾ ਮਲੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hau mailaa mal kabahu na dhovai ||
verses.translation: The ego is polluted by a filth which can never be washed off.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਪ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam koT paap khovai ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord erases millions of sins.
Chant such a Name with love, O my mind.
O Nanak, it is obtained in the Company of the Holy. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਮਾਰਗ ਕੇ ਗਨੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਨ ਕੋਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh maarag ke gane jaeh na kosaa ||
verses.translation: On that path where the miles cannot be counted,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਹਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੋਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam uoohaa sa(n)g tosaa ||
verses.translation: there, the Name of the Lord shall be your sustenance.
On that journey of total, pitch-black darkness,
the Name of the Lord shall be the Light with you.

verses.original: ਜਹਾ ਪੰਥਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਿਞਾਨੂ ॥
verses.translit: jahaa pa(n)th teraa ko na sin(j)aanoo ||
verses.translation: On that journey where no one knows you,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਛਾਨੂ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam teh naal pachhaanoo ||
verses.translation: with the Name of the Lord, you shall be recognized.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਤਪਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਘਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jeh mahaa bhiaan tapat bahu ghaam ||
verses.translation: Where there is awesome and terrible heat and blazing sunshine,

verses.original: ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਤੁਮ ਊਪਰਿ ਛਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: teh har ke naam kee tum uoopar chhaam ||
verses.translation: there, the Name of the Lord will give you shade.
Where thirst, O my mind, torments you to cry out,

verses.original: ਤਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਰਖੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: teh naanak har har a(n)mrit barakhai ||4||
verses.translation: there, O Nanak, the Ambrosial Name, Har, Har, shall rain down upon you. ||4||
Unto the devotee, the Naam is an article of daily use.
The minds of the humble Saints are at peace.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam dhaas kee oT ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the Support of His servants.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਨ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
verses.translit: har kai naam udhare jan koT ||
verses.translation: By the Name of the Lord, millions have been saved.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਤ ਸੰਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: har jas karat sa(n)t dhin raat ||
verses.translation: The Saints chant the Praises of the Lord, day and night.
Har, Har - the Lord's Name - the Holy use it as their healing medicine.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: har jan kai har naam nidhaan ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is the treasure of the Lord's servant.
The Supreme Lord God has blessed His humble servant with this gift.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗ ਏਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: man tan ra(n)g rate ra(n)g ekai ||
verses.translation: Mind and body are imbued with ecstasy in the Love of the One Lord.
O Nanak, careful and discerning understanding is the way of the Lord's humble servant. ||5||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam jan kau mukat jugat ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the path of liberation for His humble servants.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: har kai naam jan kau tirapat bhugat ||
verses.translation: With the food of the Name of the Lord, His servants are satisfied.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam jan kaa roop ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the beauty and delight of His servants.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕਬ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਭੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: har naam japat kab parai na bha(n)g ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Lord's Name, one is never blocked by obstacles.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam jan kee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the glorious greatness of His servants.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har kai naam jan sobhaa paiee ||
verses.translation: Through the Name of the Lord, His servants obtain honor.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਭੋਗ ਜੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam jan kau bhog jog ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the enjoyment and Yoga of His servants.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਬਿਓਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: har naam japat kachh naeh biog ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Lord's Name, there is no separation from Him.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: jan raataa har naam kee sevaa ||
verses.translation: His servants are imbued with the service of the Lord's Name.
O Nanak, worship the Lord, the Lord Divine, Har, Har. ||6||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਮਾਲੁ ਖਜੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har jan kai maal khajeenaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name, Har, Har, is the treasure of wealth of His servants.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: har dhan jan kau aap prabh dheenaa ||
verses.translation: The treasure of the Lord has been bestowed on His servants by God Himself.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਓਟ ਸਤਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har jan kai oT sataanee ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har is the All-powerful Protection of His servants.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ ਜਨ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: har prataap jan avar na jaanee ||
verses.translation: His servants know no other than the Lord's Magnificence.

verses.original: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: ot pot jan har ras raate ||
verses.translation: Through and through, His servants are imbued with the Lord's Love.
In deepest Samaadhi, they are intoxicated with the essence of the Naam.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar jan har har japai ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, His servants chant Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਨਹੀ ਛਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa bhagat pragaT nahee chhapai ||
verses.translation: The devotees of the Lord are known and respected; they do not hide in secrecy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har kee bhagat mukat bahu kare ||
verses.translation: Through devotion to the Lord, many have been liberated.
O Nanak, along with His servants, many others are saved. ||7||
This Elysian Tree of miraculous powers is the Name of the Lord.
The Khaamadhayn, the cow of miraculous powers, is the singing of the Glory of the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh te uootam har kee kathaa ||
verses.translation: Highest of all is the Lord's Speech.
Hearing the Naam, pain and sorrow are removed.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਸੰਤ ਰਿਦ ਵਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: naam kee mahimaa sa(n)t ridh vasai ||
verses.translation: The Glory of the Naam abides in the hearts of His Saints.
By the Saint's kind intervention, all guilt is dispelled.
The Society of the Saints is obtained by great good fortune.
Serving the Saint, one meditates on the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਕਛੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam tul kachh avar na hoi ||
verses.translation: There is nothing equal to the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh naam paavai jan koi ||8||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, rare are those, who, as Gurmukh, obtain the Naam. ||8||2||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਪੇਖੇ ਸਰਬ ਢਢੋਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: bahu saasatr bahu simritee pekhe sarab ddaddol ||
verses.translation: The many Shaastras and the many Simritees - I have seen and searched through them all.

verses.original: ਪੂਜਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਮੋਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: poojas naahee har hare naanak naam amol ||1||
verses.translation: They are not equal to Har, Haray - O Nanak, the Lord's Invaluable Name. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Chanting, intense meditation, spiritual wisdom and all meditations;
the six schools of philosophy and sermons on the scriptures;
the practice of Yoga and righteous conduct;
the renunciation of everything and wandering around in the wilderness;
the performance of all sorts of works;
donations to charities and offerings of jewels to fire;
cutting the body apart and making the pieces into ceremonial fire offerings;
keeping fasts and making vows of all sorts
- none of these are equal to the contemplation of the Name of the Lord,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਇਕ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh naam japeeaai ik baar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if, as Gurmukh, one chants the Naam, even once. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: nau kha(n)dd pirathamee firai chir jeevai ||
verses.translation: You may roam over the nine continents of the world and live a very long life;
you may become a great ascetic and a master of disciplined meditation
and burn yourself in fire;
you may give away gold, horses, elephants and land;
you may practice techniques of inner cleansing and all sorts of Yogic postures;
you may adopt the self-mortifying ways of the Jains and great spiritual disciplines;
piece by piece, you may cut your body apart;

verses.original: ਤਉ ਭੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: tau bhee haumai mail na jaavai ||
verses.translation: but even so, the filth of your ego shall not depart.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam samasar kachh naeh ||
verses.translation: There is nothing equal to the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh naam japat gat paeh ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, chant the Naam, and obtain salvation. ||2||
With your mind filled with desire, you may give up your body at a sacred shrine of pilgrimage;

verses.original: ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਹੁਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: garab gumaan na man te huTai ||
verses.translation: but even so, egotistical pride shall not be removed from your mind.
You may practice cleansing day and night,

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: man kee mail na tan te jaat ||
verses.translation: but the filth of your mind shall not leave your body.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: eis dhehee kau bahu saadhanaa karai ||
verses.translation: You may subject your body to all sorts of disciplines,

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਟਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: man te kabahoo na bikhiaa Tarai ||
verses.translation: but your mind will never be rid of its corruption.
You may wash this transitory body with loads of water,
but how can a wall of mud be washed clean?

verses.original: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਊਚ ॥
verses.translit: man har ke naam kee mahimaa uooch ||
verses.translation: O my mind, the Glorious Praise of the Name of the Lord is the highest;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਪਤਿਤ ਬਹੁ ਮੂਚ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam udhare patit bahu mooch ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam has saved so many of the worst sinners. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: bahut siaanap jam kaa bhau biaapai ||
verses.translation: Even with great cleverness, the fear of death clings to you.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨਾ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: anik jatan kar tirasan naa dhraapai ||
verses.translation: You try all sorts of things, but your thirst is still not satisfied.
Wearing various religious robes, the fire is not extinguished.
Even making millions of efforts, you shall not be accepted in the Court of the Lord.
You cannot escape to the heavens, or to the nether regions,
if you are entangled in emotional attachment and the net of Maya.
All other efforts are punished by the Messenger of Death,

verses.original: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: govi(n)dh bhajan bin til nahee maanai ||
verses.translation: which accepts nothing at all, except meditation on the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam japat dhukh jai ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, sorrow is dispelled.
O Nanak, chant it with intuitive ease. ||4||
One who prays for the four cardinal blessings
should commit himself to the service of the Saints.
If you wish to erase your sorrows,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਦ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam ridhai sadh gaavai ||
verses.translation: sing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within your heart.
If you long for honor for yourself,
then renounce your ego in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ ਡਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: je ko janam maran te ddarai ||
verses.translation: If you fear the cycle of birth and death,
then seek the Sanctuary of the Holy.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis jan kau prabh dharas piaasaa ||
verses.translation: Those who thirst for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak taa kai bal bal jaasaa ||5||
verses.translation: - Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them. ||5||
Among all persons, the supreme person is the one
who gives up his egotistical pride in the Company of the Holy.
One who sees himself as lowly,
shall be accounted as the highest of all.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kaa man hoi sagal kee reenaa ||
verses.translation: One whose mind is the dust of all,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam tin ghaT ghaT cheenaa ||
verses.translation: recognizes the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in each and every heart.
One who eradicates cruelty from within his own mind,
looks upon all the world as his friend.
One who looks upon pleasure and pain as one and the same,
O Nanak, is not affected by sin or virtue. ||6||
To the poor, Your Name is wealth.
To the homeless, Your Name is home.
To the dishonored, You, O God, are honor.
To all, You are the Giver of gifts.
O Creator Lord, Cause of causes, O Lord and Master,
Inner-knower, Searcher of all hearts:
You alone know Your own condition and state.
You Yourself, God, are imbued with Yourself.
You alone can celebrate Your Praises.
O Nanak, no one else knows. ||7||
Of all religions, the best religion

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: har ko naam jap niramal karam ||
verses.translation: is to chant the Name of the Lord and maintain pure conduct.
Of all religious rituals, the most sublime ritual
is to erase the filth of the dirty mind in the Company of the Holy.
Of all efforts, the best effort

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਸਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam japahu jeea sadhaa ||
verses.translation: is to chant the Name of the Lord in the heart, forever.
Of all speech, the most ambrosial speech

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: har ko jas sun rasan bakhaanee ||
verses.translation: is to hear the Lord's Praise and chant it with the tongue.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਥਾਨ ਤੇ ਓਹੁ ਊਤਮ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sagal thaan te oh uootam thaan ||
verses.translation: Of all places, the most sublime place,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੮॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak jeh ghaT vasai har naam ||8||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, is that heart in which the Name of the Lord abides. ||8||3||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰ ਇਆਨਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: niraguneeaar iaaniaa so prabh sadhaa samaal ||
verses.translation: You worthless, ignorant fool - dwell upon God forever.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਰਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin keeaa tis cheet rakh naanak nibahee naal ||1||
verses.translation: Cherish in your consciousness the One who created you; O Nanak, He alone shall go along with you. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Think of the Glory of the All-pervading Lord, O mortal;
what is your origin, and what is your appearance?
He who fashioned, adorned and decorated you
in the fire of the womb, He preserved you.
In your infancy, He gave you milk to drink.
In the flower of your youth, He gave you food, pleasure and understanding.

verses.original: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਾਕ ਸੈਨ ॥ ਮੁਖਿ ਅਪਿਆਉ ਬੈਠ ਕਉ ਦੈਨ ॥
verses.translit: biradh bhiaa uoopar saak sain || mukh apiaau baiTh kau dhain ||
verses.translation: As you grow old, family and friends are there to feed you as you rest.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਗੁਨੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: eih niragun gun kachhoo na boojhai ||
verses.translation: This worthless person has not appreciated in the least, all the good deeds done for him.
If you bless him with forgiveness, O Nanak, only then will he be saved. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਧਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਬਸਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeh prasaadh dhar uoopar sukh baseh ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, you abide in comfort upon the earth.

verses.original: ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਸਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sut bhraat meet banitaa sa(n)g haseh ||
verses.translation: With your children, siblings, friends and spouse, you laugh.
By His Grace, you drink in cool water.
You have peaceful breezes and priceless fire.
By His Grace, you enjoy all sorts of pleasures.
You are provided with all the necessities of life.

verses.original: ਦੀਨੇ ਹਸਤ ਪਾਵ ਕਰਨ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: dheene hasat paav karan netr rasanaa ||
verses.translation: He gave you hands, feet, ears, eyes and tongue,
and yet, you forsake Him and attach yourself to others.
Such sinful mistakes cling to the blind fools;
Nanak: uplift and save them, God! ||2||
From beginning to end, He is our Protector,

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis siau preet na karai gavaar ||
verses.translation: and yet, the ignorant do not give their love to Him.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee sevaa nav nidh paavai ||
verses.translation: Serving Him, the nine treasures are obtained,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਮੂੜਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: taa siau mooRaa man nahee laavai ||
verses.translation: and yet, the foolish do not link their minds with Him.
Our Lord and Master is Ever-present, forever and ever,
and yet, the spiritually blind believe that He is far away.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਪਾਵੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee Tahal paavai dharageh maan ||
verses.translation: In His service, one obtains honor in the Court of the Lord,
and yet, the ignorant fool forgets Him.
Forever and ever, this person makes mistakes;
O Nanak, the Infinite Lord is our Saving Grace. ||3||
Forsaking the jewel, they are engrossed with a shell.
They renounce Truth and embrace falsehood.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਛਡਨਾ ਸੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo chhaddanaa su asathir kar maanai ||
verses.translation: That which passes away, they believe to be permanent.
That which is immanent, they believe to be far off.

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: chhodd jai tis kaa sram karai ||
verses.translation: They struggle for what they must eventually leave.
They turn away from the Lord, their Help and Support, who is always with them.
They wash off the sandalwood paste;
like donkeys, they are in love with the mud.
They have fallen into the deep, dark pit.
Nanak: lift them up and save them, O Merciful Lord God! ||4||
They belong to the human species, but they act like animals.
They curse others day and night.
Outwardly, they wear religious robes, but within is the filth of Maya.
They cannot conceal this, no matter how hard they try.
Outwardly, they display knowledge, meditation and purification,
but within clings the dog of greed.
The fire of desire rages within; outwardly they apply ashes to their bodies.
There is a stone around their neck - how can they cross the unfathomable ocean?

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai a(n)tar basai prabh aap ||
verses.translation: Those, within whom God Himself abides
- O Nanak, those humble beings are intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||5||
By listening, how can the blind find the path?
Take hold of his hand, and then he can reach his destination.
How can a riddle be understood by the deaf?
Say 'night', and he thinks you said 'day'.
How can the mute sing the Songs of the Lord?

verses.original: ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਤਉ ਭੀ ਸੁਰ ਭੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: jatan karai tau bhee sur bha(n)g ||
verses.translation: He may try, but his voice will fail him.
How can the cripple climb up the mountain?
He simply cannot go there.

verses.original: ਕਰਤਾਰ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਦੀਨੁ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: karataar karunaa mai dheen benatee karai ||
verses.translation: O Creator, Lord of Mercy - Your humble servant prays;
Nanak: by Your Grace, please save me. ||6||

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੁ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g sahaiee su aavai na cheet ||
verses.translation: The Lord, our Help and Support, is always with us, but the mortal does not remember Him.
He shows love to his enemies.
He lives in a castle of sand.
He enjoys the games of pleasure and the tastes of Maya.
He believes them to be permanent - this is the belief of his mind.
Death does not even come to mind for the fool.
Hate, conflict, sexual desire, anger, emotional attachment,
falsehood, corruption, immense greed and deceit:
So many lifetimes are wasted in these ways.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਮ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak raakh leh aapan kar karam ||7||
verses.translation: Nanak: uplift them, and redeem them, O Lord - show Your Mercy! ||7||
You are our Lord and Master; to You, I offer this prayer.
This body and soul are all Your property.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tum maat pitaa ham baarik tere ||
verses.translation: You are our mother and father; we are Your children.
In Your Grace, there are so many joys!
No one knows Your limits.
O Highest of the High, Most Generous God,
the whole creation is strung on Your thread.
That which has come from You is under Your Command.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: tumaree gat mit tum hee jaanee ||
verses.translation: You alone know Your state and extent.
Nanak, Your slave, is forever a sacrifice. ||8||4||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਦੇਨਹਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਛੋਡਿ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਆਨ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhenahaar prabh chhodd kai laageh aan suaai ||
verses.translation: One who renounces God the Giver, and attaches himself to other affairs

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹੂ ਨ ਸੀਝਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kahoo na seejhiee bin naavai pat jai ||1||
verses.translation: - O Nanak, he shall never succeed. Without the Name, he shall lose his honor. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
He obtains ten things, and puts them behind him;
for the sake of one thing withheld, he forfeits his faith.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਭੀ ਨ ਦੇਇ ਦਸ ਭੀ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: ek bhee na dhei dhas bhee hir lei ||
verses.translation: But what if that one thing were not given, and the ten were taken away?
Then, what could the fool say or do?
Our Lord and Master cannot be moved by force.
Unto Him, bow forever in adoration.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai man laagaa prabh meeThaa ||
verses.translation: That one, unto whose mind God seems sweet
all pleasures come to abide in his mind.
One who abides by the Lord's Will,
O Nanak, obtains all things. ||1||
God the Banker gives endless capital to the mortal,
who eats, drinks and expends it with pleasure and joy.

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੀ ਅਮਾਨ ਕਛੁ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਸਾਹੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: apunee amaan kachh bahur saahu lei ||
verses.translation: If some of this capital is later taken back by the Banker,
the ignorant person shows his anger.
He himself destroys his own credibility,

verses.original: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: bahur us kaa bisavaiaas na hovai ||
verses.translation: and he shall not again be trusted.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis kee basat tis aagai raakhai ||
verses.translation: When one offers to the Lord, that which belongs to the Lord,
and willingly abides by the Will of God's Order,
the Lord will make him happy four times over.
O Nanak, our Lord and Master is merciful forever. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਹੇਤ ॥ ਸਰਪਰ ਹੋਵਤ ਜਾਨੁ ਅਨੇਤ ॥
verses.translit: anik bhaat maiaa ke het || sarapar hovat jaan anet ||
verses.translation: The many forms of attachment to Maya shall surely pass away - know that they are transitory.

verses.original: ਬਿਰਖ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: birakh kee chhaiaa siau ra(n)g laavai ||
verses.translation: People fall in love with the shade of the tree,
and when it passes away, they feel regret in their minds.
Whatever is seen, shall pass away;
and yet, the blindest of the blind cling to it.
One who gives her love to a passing traveler

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: taa kau haath na aavai keh ||
verses.translation: nothing shall come into her hands in this way.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man har ke naam kee preet sukhadhaiee ||
verses.translation: O mind, the love of the Name of the Lord bestows peace.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa naanak aap le laiee ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord, in His Mercy, unites us with Himself. ||3||
False are body, wealth, and all relations.
False are ego, possessiveness and Maya.
False are power, youth, wealth and property.
False are sexual desire and wild anger.
False are chariots, elephants, horses and expensive clothes.

verses.original: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਪੇਖਿ ਹਸਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: mithiaa ra(n)g sa(n)g maiaa pekh hasataa ||
verses.translation: False is the love of gathering wealth, and reveling in the sight of it.
False are deception, emotional attachment and egotistical pride.
False are pride and self-conceit.
Only devotional worship is permanent, and the Sanctuary of the Holy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak jap jap jeevai har ke charan ||4||
verses.translation: Nanak lives by meditating, meditating on the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||4||
False are the ears which listen to the slander of others.

verses.original: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਹਸਤ ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਕਉ ਹਿਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: mithiaa hasat par dharab kau hireh ||
verses.translation: False are the hands which steal the wealth of others.

verses.original: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪੇਖਤ ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੂਪਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: mithiaa netr pekhat par tria roopaadh ||
verses.translation: False are the eyes which gaze upon the beauty of another's wife.
False is the tongue which enjoys delicacies and external tastes.

verses.original: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਚਰਨ ਪਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: mithiaa charan par bikaar kau dhaaveh ||
verses.translation: False are the feet which run to do evil to others.
False is the mind which covets the wealth of others.
False is the body which does not do good to others.
False is the nose which inhales corruption.
Without understanding, everything is false.

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਦੇਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਲਏ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: safal dheh naanak har har naam le ||5||
verses.translation: Fruitful is the body, O Nanak, which takes to the Lord's Name. ||5||
The life of the faithless cynic is totally useless.
Without the Truth, how can anyone be pure?
Useless is the body of the spiritually blind, without the Name of the Lord.
From his mouth, a foul smell issues forth.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin simaran dhin rain birathaa bihai ||
verses.translation: Without the remembrance of the Lord, day and night pass in vain,
like the crop which withers without rain.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥੇ ਸਭ ਕਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gobidh bhajan bin birathe sabh kaam ||
verses.translation: Without meditation on the Lord of the Universe, all works are in vain,
like the wealth of a miser, which lies useless.

verses.original: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਬਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)n dha(n)n te jan jeh ghaT basio har naau ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed are those, whose hearts are filled with the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak taa kai bal bal jaau ||6||
verses.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them. ||6||
He says one thing, and does something else.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਗੰਢ ਲਾਵਤ ॥
verses.translit: man nahee preet mukhahu ga(n)dd laavat ||
verses.translation: There is no love in his heart, and yet with his mouth he talks tall.
The Omniscient Lord God is the Knower of all.
He is not impressed by outward display.
One who does not practice what he preaches to others,
shall come and go in reincarnation, through birth and death.
One whose inner being is filled with the Formless Lord
by his teachings, the world is saved.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਨੇ ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo tum bhaane tin prabh jaataa ||
verses.translation: Those who are pleasing to You, God, know You.
Nanak falls at their feet. ||7||
Offer your prayers to the Supreme Lord God, who knows everything.
He Himself values His own creatures.
He Himself, by Himself, makes the decisions.

verses.original: ਕਿਸੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਜਨਾਵਤ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਵਤ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kisai dhoor janaavat kisai bujhaavat neraa ||
verses.translation: To some, He appears far away, while others perceive Him near at hand.
He is beyond all efforts and clever tricks.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਤਮ ਕੀ ਰਹਤ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kachh jaanai aatam kee rahat ||
verses.translation: He knows all the ways and means of the soul.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis bhaavai tis le laR lai ||
verses.translation: Those with whom He is pleased are attached to the hem of His robe.
He is pervading all places and interspaces.
Those upon whom He bestows His favor, become His servants.
Each and every moment, O Nanak, meditate on the Lord. ||8||5||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh ar lobh moh binas jai aha(n)mev ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment - may these be gone, and egotism as well.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh saranaagatee kar prasaadh gurdhev ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God; please bless me with Your Grace, O Divine Guru. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
By His Grace, you partake of the thirty-six delicacies;

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: tis Thaakur kau rakh man maeh ||
verses.translation: enshrine that Lord and Master within your mind.
By His Grace, you apply scented oils to your body;

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: tis kau simarat param gat paaveh ||
verses.translation: remembering Him, the supreme status is obtained.
By His Grace, you dwell in the palace of peace;
meditate forever on Him within your mind.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਖ ਬਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh prasaadh gireh sa(n)g sukh basanaa ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, you abide with your family in peace;
keep His remembrance upon your tongue, twenty-four hours a day.
By His Grace, you enjoy tastes and pleasures;
O Nanak, meditate forever on the One, who is worthy of meditation. ||1||
By His Grace, you wear silks and satins;
why abandon Him, to attach yourself to another?
By His Grace, you sleep in a cozy bed;

verses.original: ਮਨ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: man aaTh pahar taa kaa jas gaaveejai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, sing His Praises, twenty-four hours a day.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh prasaadh tujh sabh kouoo maanai ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, you are honored by everyone;

verses.original: ਮੁਖਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: mukh taa ko jas rasan bakhaanai ||
verses.translation: with your mouth and with your tongue, chant His Praises.
By His Grace, you remain in the Dharma;
O mind, meditate continually on the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਜਪਤ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh jee japat dharageh maan paaveh ||
verses.translation: Meditating on God, you shall be honored in His Court;
O Nanak, you shall return to your true home with honor. ||2||
By His Grace, you have a healthy, golden body;
attune yourself to that Loving Lord.
By His Grace, your honor is preserved;

verses.original: ਮਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤ ॥
verses.translit: man sukh paaveh har har jas kahat ||
verses.translation: O mind, chant the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, and find peace.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਢਾਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeh prasaadh tere sagal chhidhr ddaake ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, all your deficits are covered;

verses.original: ਮਨ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: man saranee par Thaakur prabh taa kai ||
verses.translation: O mind, seek the Sanctuary of God, our Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh prasaadh tujh ko na pahoochai ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, no one can rival you;

verses.original: ਮਨ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਊਚੇ ॥
verses.translit: man saas saas simarahu prabh uooche ||
verses.translation: O mind, with each and every breath, remember God on High.
By His Grace, you obtained this precious human body;
O Nanak, worship Him with devotion. ||3||
By His Grace, you wear decorations;

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਿਉ ਆਲਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: man tis simarat kiau aalas keejai ||
verses.translation: O mind, why are you so lazy? Why don't you remember Him in meditation?
By His Grace, you have horses and elephants to ride;

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: man tis prabh kau kabahoo na bisaaree ||
verses.translation: O mind, never forget that God.
By His Grace, you have land, gardens and wealth;
keep God enshrined in your heart.
O mind, the One who formed your form
standing up and sitting down, meditate always on Him.
Meditate on Him - the One Invisible Lord;
here and hereafter, O Nanak, He shall save you. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਬਹੁ ਦਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jeh prasaadh kareh pu(n)n bahu dhaan ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, you give donations in abundance to charities;

verses.original: ਮਨ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
verses.translit: man aaTh pahar kar tis kaa dhiaan ||
verses.translation: O mind, meditate on Him, twenty-four hours a day.
By His Grace, you perform religious rituals and worldly duties;

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: tis prabh kau saas saas chitaaree ||
verses.translation: think of God with each and every breath.
By His Grace, your form is so beautiful;
constantly remember God, the Incomparably Beautiful One.
By His Grace, you have such high social status;

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: so prabh simar sadhaa dhin raat ||
verses.translation: remember God always, day and night.
By His Grace, your honor is preserved;
by Guru's Grace, O Nanak, chant His Praises. ||5||
By His Grace, you listen to the sound current of the Naad.
By His Grace, you behold amazing wonders.
By His Grace, you speak ambrosial words with your tongue.
By His Grace, you abide in peace and ease.
By His Grace, your hands move and work.
By His Grace, you are completely fulfilled.
By His Grace, you obtain the supreme status.
By His Grace, you are absorbed into celestial peace.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਕਤ ਲਾਗਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa prabh tiaag avar kat laagahu ||
verses.translation: Why forsake God, and attach yourself to another?
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, awaken your mind! ||6||
By His Grace, you are famous all over the world;

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: tis prabh kau mool na manahu bisaar ||
verses.translation: never forget God from your mind.
By His Grace, you have prestige;

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੂੜ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: re man mooR too taa kau jaap ||
verses.translation: O foolish mind, meditate on Him!
By His Grace, your works are completed;
O mind, know Him to be close at hand.
By His Grace, you find the Truth;

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: re man mere too(n) taa siau raach ||
verses.translation: O my mind, merge yourself into Him.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਭ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeh prasaadh sabh kee gat hoi ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, everyone is saved;
O Nanak, meditate, and chant His Chant. ||7||
Those, whom He inspires to chant, chant His Name.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਗਾਵਾਏ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aap gaavaae su har gun gaau ||
verses.translation: Those, whom He inspires to sing, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
By God's Grace, enlightenment comes.
By God's Kind Mercy, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.
When God is totally pleased, He comes to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh dhiaa te mat uootam hoi ||
verses.translation: By God's Kind Mercy, the intellect is exalted.
All treasures, O Lord, come by Your Kind Mercy.
No one obtains anything by himself.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: jit jit laavahu tit lageh har naath ||
verses.translation: As You have delegated, so do we apply ourselves, O Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਨ ਕੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹਾਥ ॥੮॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak in kai kachhoo na haath ||8||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, nothing is in our hands. ||8||6||
Shalok:
Unapproachable and Unfathomable is the Supreme Lord God;

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo kahai su mukataa hoi ||
verses.translation: whoever speaks of Him shall be liberated.

verses.original: ਸੁਨਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਿਨਵੰਤਾ ॥ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਅਚਰਜ ਕਥਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sun meetaa naanak binava(n)taa || saadh janaa kee acharaj kathaa ||1||
verses.translation: Listen, O friends, Nanak prays, to the wonderful story of the Holy. ||1||
Ashtapadee:

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਹੋਤ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g mukh uoojal hot ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, one's face becomes radiant.
In the Company of the Holy, all filth is removed.
In the Company of the Holy, egotism is eliminated.
In the Company of the Holy, spiritual wisdom is revealed.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g bujhai prabh neraa ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, God is understood to be near at hand.
In the Company of the Holy, all conflicts are settled.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g paae naam ratan ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains the jewel of the Naam.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਏਕ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਤਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g ek uoopar jatan ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, one's efforts are directed toward the One Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬਰਨੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kee mahimaa baranai kaun praanee ||
verses.translation: What mortal can speak of the Glorious Praises of the Holy?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak saadh kee sobhaa prabh maeh samaanee ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the glory of the Holy people merges into God. ||1||
In the Company of the Holy, one meets the Incomprehensible Lord.
In the Company of the Holy, one flourishes forever.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਬਸਿ ਪੰਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g aaveh bas pa(n)chaa ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, the five passions are brought to rest.
In the Company of the Holy, one enjoys the essence of ambrosia.
In the Company of the Holy, one becomes the dust of all.
In the Company of the Holy, one's speech is enticing.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g na katahoo(n) dhaavai ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, the mind does not wander.
In the Company of the Holy, the mind becomes stable.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g maiaa te bhi(n)n ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, one is rid of Maya.
In the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, God is totally pleased. ||2||
In the Company of the Holy, all one's enemies become friends.
In the Company of the Holy, there is great purity.
In the Company of the Holy, no one is hated.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਬੀਗਾ ਪੈਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g na beegaa pair ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, one's feet do not wander.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g naahee ko ma(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, no one seems evil.
In the Company of the Holy, supreme bliss is known.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਉ ਤਾਪੁ ॥
