verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g naahee hau taap ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, the fever of ego departs.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g tajai sabh aap ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, one renounces all selfishness.
He Himself knows the greatness of the Holy.
O Nanak, the Holy are at one with God. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g na kabahoo dhaavai ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, the mind never wanders.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g sadhaa sukh paavai ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains everlasting peace.
In the Company of the Holy, one grasps the Incomprehensible.
In the Company of the Holy, one can endure the unendurable.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਊਚੈ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g basai thaan uoochai ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, one abides in the loftiest place.
In the Company of the Holy, one attains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g dhiraRai sabh dharam ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, one's Dharmic faith is firmly established.
In the Company of the Holy, one dwells with the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g paae naam nidhaan ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains the treasure of the Naam.
O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Holy. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g sabh kul udhaarai ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, all one's family is saved.
In the Company of the Holy, one's friends, acquaintances and relatives are redeemed.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo kai sa(n)g so dhan paavai ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, that wealth is obtained.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਰਸਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhan te sabh ko varasaavai ||
verses.translation: Everyone benefits from that wealth.
In the Company of the Holy, the Lord of Dharma serves.
In the Company of the Holy, the divine, angelic beings sing God's Praises.
In the Company of the Holy, one's sins fly away.
In the Company of the Holy, one sings the Ambrosial Glories.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਨ ਗੰਮਿ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g srab thaan ga(n)m ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, all places are within reach.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak saadh kai sa(n)g safal jana(n)m ||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy, one's life becomes fruitful. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਘਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g nahee kachh ghaal ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, there is no suffering.
The Blessed Vision of their Darshan brings a sublime, happy peace.
In the Company of the Holy, blemishes are removed.
In the Company of the Holy, hell is far away.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g ieehaa uoohaa suhelaa ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, one is happy here and hereafter.
In the Company of the Holy, the separated ones are reunited with the Lord.
The fruits of one's desires are obtained.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g na birathaa jaavai ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, no one goes empty-handed.
The Supreme Lord God dwells in the hearts of the Holy.
O Nanak, listening to the sweet words of the Holy, one is saved. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਨਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g sunau har naau ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, listen to the Name of the Lord.
In the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g na man te bisarai ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, do not forget Him from your mind.
In the Company of the Holy, you shall surely be saved.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g lagai prabh meeThaa ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, God seems very sweet.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo kai sa(n)g ghaT ghaT ddeeThaa ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, He is seen in each and every heart.
In the Company of the Holy, we become obedient to the Lord.
In the Company of the Holy, we obtain the state of salvation.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kai sa(n)g miTe sabh rog ||
verses.translation: In the Company of the Holy, all diseases are cured.
O Nanak, one meets with the Holy, by highest destiny. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬੇਦ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kee mahimaa bedh na jaaneh ||
verses.translation: The glory of the Holy people is not known to the Vedas.
They can describe only what they have heard.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kee upamaa tih gun te dhoor ||
verses.translation: The greatness of the Holy people is beyond the three qualities.
The greatness of the Holy people is all-pervading.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kee sobhaa kaa naahee a(n)t ||
verses.translation: The glory of the Holy people has no limit.
The glory of the Holy people is infinite and eternal.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚੀ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kee sobhaa uooch te uoochee ||
verses.translation: The glory of the Holy people is the highest of the high.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਮੂਚ ਤੇ ਮੂਚੀ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kee sobhaa mooch te moochee ||
verses.translation: The glory of the Holy people is the greatest of the great.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਾਧ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: saadh kee sobhaa saadh ban aaiee ||
verses.translation: The glory of the Holy people is theirs alone;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੮॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak saadh prabh bhedh na bhaiee ||8||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, there is no difference between the Holy people and God. ||8||7||
Shalok:
The True One is on his mind, and the True One is upon his lips.

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਪੇਖੈ ਏਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: avar na pekhai ekas bin koi ||
verses.translation: He sees only the One.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਲਛਣ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ieh lachhan braham giaanee hoi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, these are the qualities of the God-conscious being. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
The God-conscious being is always unattached,
as the lotus in the water remains detached.
The God-conscious being is always unstained,
like the sun, which gives its comfort and warmth to all.
The God-conscious being looks upon all alike,

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜ ਰੰਕ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੈ ਤੁਲਿ ਪਵਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jaise raaj ra(n)k kau laagai tul pavaan ||
verses.translation: like the wind, which blows equally upon the king and the poor beggar.
The God-conscious being has a steady patience,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਕੋਊ ਖੋਦੈ ਕੋਊ ਚੰਦਨ ਲੇਪ ॥
verses.translit: jiau basudhaa kouoo khodhai kouoo cha(n)dhan lep ||
verses.translation: like the earth, which is dug up by one, and anointed with sandal paste by another.
This is the quality of the God-conscious being:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਵਕ ਕਾ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jiau paavak kaa sahaj subhaau ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, his inherent nature is like a warming fire. ||1||
The God-conscious being is the purest of the pure;
filth does not stick to water.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee kai man hoi pragaas ||
verses.translation: The God-conscious being's mind is enlightened,
like the sky above the earth.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee kai mitr satr samaan ||
verses.translation: To the God-conscious being, friend and foe are the same.
The God-conscious being has no egotistical pride.
The God-conscious being is the highest of the high.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨੀਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: man apanai hai sabh te neechaa ||
verses.translation: Within his own mind, he is the most humble of all.
They alone become God-conscious beings,
O Nanak, whom God Himself makes so. ||2||
The God-conscious being is the dust of all.
The God-conscious being knows the nature of the soul.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee kee sabh uoopar miaa ||
verses.translation: The God-conscious being shows kindness to all.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee te kachh buraa na bhiaa ||
verses.translation: No evil comes from the God-conscious being.
The God-conscious being is always impartial.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਰਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee kee dhirasaT a(n)mrit barasee ||
verses.translation: Nectar rains down from the glance of the God-conscious being.
The God-conscious being is free from entanglements.
The lifestyle of the God-conscious being is spotlessly pure.
Spiritual wisdom is the food of the God-conscious being.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak braham giaanee kaa braham dhiaan ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is absorbed in God's meditation. ||3||
The God-conscious being centers his hopes on the One alone.
The God-conscious being shall never perish.
The God-conscious being is steeped in humility.
The God-conscious being delights in doing good to others.
The God-conscious being has no worldly entanglements.
The God-conscious being holds his wandering mind under control.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee kai hoi su bhalaa ||
verses.translation: The God-conscious being acts in the common good.
The God-conscious being blossoms in fruitfulness.
In the Company of the God-conscious being, all are saved.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਪੈ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak braham giaanee japai sagal sa(n)saar ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the God-conscious being, the whole world meditates on God. ||4||
The God-conscious being loves the One Lord alone.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਬਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee kai basai prabh sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: The God-conscious being dwells with God.
The God-conscious being takes the Naam as his Support.
The God-conscious being has the Naam as his Family.
The God-conscious being is awake and aware, forever and ever.
The God-conscious being renounces his proud ego.
In the mind of the God-conscious being, there is supreme bliss.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee kai ghar sadhaa ana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: In the home of the God-conscious being, there is everlasting bliss.
The God-conscious being dwells in peaceful ease.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak braham giaanee kaa nahee binaas ||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the God-conscious being shall never perish. ||5||
The God-conscious being knows God.
The God-conscious being is in love with the One alone.
The God-conscious being is carefree.
Pure are the Teachings of the God-conscious being.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee jis karai prabh aap ||
verses.translation: The God-conscious being is made so by God Himself.
The God-conscious being is gloriously great.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee kaa dharas baddabhaagee paieeaai ||
verses.translation: The Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the God-conscious being, is obtained by great good fortune.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee kau bal bal jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: To the God-conscious being, I make my life a sacrifice.
The God-conscious being is sought by the great god Shiva.
O Nanak, the God-conscious being is Himself the Supreme Lord God. ||6||
The God-conscious being cannot be appraised.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਸਗਲ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee kai sagal man maeh ||
verses.translation: The God-conscious being has all within his mind.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਕਉਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੇਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee kaa kaun jaanai bhedh ||
verses.translation: Who can know the mystery of the God-conscious being?
Forever bow to the God-conscious being.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਕਥਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਅਧਾਖੵਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee kaa kathiaa na jai adhaakhayer ||
verses.translation: The God-conscious being cannot be described in words.
The God-conscious being is the Lord and Master of all.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਉਨੁ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee kee mit kaun bakhaanai ||
verses.translation: Who can describe the limits of the God-conscious being?

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee kee gat braham giaanee jaanai ||
verses.translation: Only the God-conscious being can know the state of the God-conscious being.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee kaa a(n)t na paar ||
verses.translation: The God-conscious being has no end or limitation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak braham giaanee kau sadhaa namasakaar ||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, to the God-conscious being, bow forever in reverence. ||7||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee sabh sirasaT kaa karataa ||
verses.translation: The God-conscious being is the Creator of all the world.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਦ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee sadh jeevai nahee marataa ||
verses.translation: The God-conscious being lives forever, and does not die.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee mukat jugat jeea kaa dhaataa ||
verses.translation: The God-conscious being is the Giver of the way of liberation of the soul.
The God-conscious being is the Perfect Supreme Being, who orchestrates all.
The God-conscious being is the helper of the helpless.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee kaa sabh uoopar haath ||
verses.translation: The God-conscious being extends his hand to all.
The God-conscious being owns the entire creation.
The God-conscious being is himself the Formless Lord.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee kee sobhaa braham giaanee banee ||
verses.translation: The glory of the God-conscious being belongs to the God-conscious being alone.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਰਬ ਕਾ ਧਨੀ ॥੮॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak braham giaanee sarab kaa dhanee ||8||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is the Lord of all. ||8||8||
Shalok:
One who enshrines the Naam within the heart,
who sees the Lord God in all,
who, each and every moment, bows in reverence to the Lord Master
- O Nanak, such a one is the true 'touch-nothing Saint', who emancipates everyone. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
One whose tongue does not touch falsehood;
whose mind is filled with love for the Blessed Vision of the Pure Lord,

verses.original: ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਪੇਖੈ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ॥
verses.translit: par tria roop na pekhai netr ||
verses.translation: whose eyes do not gaze upon the beauty of others' wives,
who serves the Holy and loves the Saints' Congregation,

verses.original: ਕਰਨ ਨ ਸੁਨੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: karan na sunai kaahoo kee ni(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: whose ears do not listen to slander against anyone,

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh te jaanai aapas kau ma(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: who deems himself to be the worst of all,
who, by Guru's Grace, renounces corruption,

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਟਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: man kee baasanaa man te Tarai ||
verses.translation: who banishes the mind's evil desires from his mind,

verses.original: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਜਿਤ ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ॥
verses.translit: ei(n)dhree jit pa(n)ch dhokh te rahat ||
verses.translation: who conquers his sexual instincts and is free of the five sinful passions

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋ ਐਸਾ ਅਪਰਸ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak koT madhe ko aaisaa aparas ||1||
verses.translation: - O Nanak, among millions, there is scarcely one such 'touch-nothing Saint'. ||1||
The true Vaishnaav, the devotee of Vishnu, is the one with whom God is thoroughly pleased.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
verses.translit: bisan kee maiaa te hoi bhi(n)n ||
verses.translation: He dwells apart from Maya.
Performing good deeds, he does not seek rewards.
Spotlessly pure is the religion of such a Vaishnaav;

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਫਲ ਕੀ ਇਛਾ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਛੈ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo fal kee ichhaa nahee baachhai ||
verses.translation: he has no desire for the fruits of his labors.
He is absorbed in devotional worship and the singing of Kirtan, the songs of the Lord's Glory.
Within his mind and body, he meditates in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe.
He is kind to all creatures.
He holds fast to the Naam, and inspires others to chant it.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਹੁ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak oh baisano param gat paavai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, such a Vaishnaav obtains the supreme status. ||2||
The true Bhagaautee, the devotee of Adi Shakti, loves the devotional worship of God.
He forsakes the company of all wicked people.
All doubts are removed from his mind.
He performs devotional service to the Supreme Lord God in all.
In the Company of the Holy, the filth of sin is washed away.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: tis bhagautee kee mat uootam hovai ||
verses.translation: The wisdom of such a Bhagaautee becomes supreme.

verses.original: ਭਗਵੰਤ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhagava(n)t kee Tahal karai nit neet ||
verses.translation: He constantly performs the service of the Supreme Lord God.
He dedicates his mind and body to the Love of God.
The Lotus Feet of the Lord abide in his heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸਾ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਕਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak aaisaa bhagautee bhagava(n)t kau paavai ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, such a Bhagaautee attains the Lord God. ||3||
He is a true Pandit, a religious scholar, who instructs his own mind.
He searches for the Lord's Name within his own soul.
He drinks in the Exquisite Nectar of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਉਸੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aus pa(n)ddit kai upadhes jag jeevai ||
verses.translation: By that Pandit's teachings, the world lives.
He implants the Sermon of the Lord in his heart.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: so pa(n)ddit fir jon na aavai ||
verses.translation: Such a Pandit is not cast into the womb of reincarnation again.
He understands the fundamental essence of the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees.
In the unmanifest, he sees the manifest world to exist.
He gives instruction to people of all castes and social classes.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਸੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਦੇਸੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak us pa(n)ddit kau sadhaa adhes ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, to such a Pandit, I bow in salutation forever. ||4||
The Beej Mantra, the Seed Mantra, is spiritual wisdom for everyone.

verses.original: ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਜਪੈ ਕੋਊ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: chahu varanaa meh japai kouoo naam ||
verses.translation: Anyone, from any class, may chant the Naam.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo japai tis kee gat hoi ||
verses.translation: Whoever chants it, is emancipated.
And yet, rare are those who attain it, in the Company of the Holy.
By His Grace, He enshrines it within.

verses.original: ਪਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਮੁਘਦ ਪਾਥਰ ਕਉ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: pas pret mughadh paathar kau taarai ||
verses.translation: Even beasts, ghosts and the stone-hearted are saved.
The Naam is the panacea, the remedy to cure all ills.
Singing the Glory of God is the embodiment of bliss and emancipation.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਧਰਮਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo jugat kitai na paieeaai dharam ||
verses.translation: It cannot be obtained by any religious rituals.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak tis milai jis likhiaa dhur karam ||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone obtains it, whose karma is so pre-ordained. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis kai man paarabraham kaa nivaas ||
verses.translation: One whose mind is a home for the Supreme Lord God
- his name is truly Ram Das, the Lord's servant.
He comes to have the Vision of the Lord, the Supreme Soul.
Deeming himself to be the slave of the Lord's slaves, he obtains it.
He knows the Lord to be Ever-present, close at hand.
Such a servant is honored in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: apune dhaas kau aap kirapaa karai ||
verses.translation: To His servant, He Himself shows His Mercy.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: tis dhaas kau sabh sojhee parai ||
verses.translation: Such a servant understands everything.
Amidst all, his soul is unattached.
Such is the way, O Nanak, of the Lord's servant. ||6||
One who, in his soul, loves the Will of God,
is said to be Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.
As is joy, so is sorrow to him.
He is in eternal bliss, and is not separated from God.
As is gold, so is dust to him.
As is ambrosial nectar, so is bitter poison to him.
As is honor, so is dishonor.
As is the beggar, so is the king.
Whatever God ordains, that is his way.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਹੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak oh purakh kaheeaai jeevan mukat ||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that being is known as Jivan Mukta. ||7||
All places belong to the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jit jit ghar raakhai taisaa tin naau ||
verses.translation: According to the homes in which they are placed, so are His creatures named.
He Himself is the Doer, the Cause of causes.
Whatever pleases God, ultimately comes to pass.
He Himself is All-pervading, in endless waves.

verses.original: ਲਖੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: lakhe na jaeh paarabraham ke ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: The playful sport of the Supreme Lord God cannot be known.
As the understanding is given, so is one enlightened.
The Supreme Lord God, the Creator, is eternal and everlasting.
Forever, forever and ever, He is merciful.
Remembering Him, remembering Him in meditation, O Nanak, one is blessed with ecstasy. ||8||9||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: ausatat kareh anek jan a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
verses.translation: Many people praise the Lord. He has no end or limitation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਚਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਚੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak rachanaa prabh rachee bahu bidh anik prakaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God created the creation, with its many ways and various species. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Many millions are His devotees.
Many millions perform religious rituals and worldly duties.
Many millions become dwellers at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
Many millions wander as renunciates in the wilderness.
Many millions listen to the Vedas.
Many millions become austere penitents.
Many millions enshrine meditation within their souls.
Many millions of poets contemplate Him through poetry.
Many millions meditate on His eternally new Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak karate kaa a(n)t na paaveh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, none can find the limits of the Creator. ||1||
Many millions become self-centered.
Many millions are blinded by ignorance.
Many millions are stone-hearted misers.
Many millions are heartless, with dry, withered souls.

verses.original: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਕਉ ਹਿਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kiee koT par dharab kau hireh ||
verses.translation: Many millions steal the wealth of others.
Many millions slander others.
Many millions struggle in Maya.
Many millions wander in foreign lands.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jit jit laavahu tit tit laganaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever God attaches them to - with that they are engaged.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak karate kee jaanai karataa rachanaa ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Creator alone knows the workings of His creation. ||2||
Many millions are Siddhas, celibates and Yogis.
Many millions are kings, enjoying worldly pleasures.
Many millions of birds and snakes have been created.
Many millions of stones and trees have been produced.
Many millions are the winds, waters and fires.
Many millions are the countries and realms of the world.
Many millions are the moons, suns and stars.

verses.original: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤ੍ਰ ॥
verses.translit: kiee koT dhev dhaanav i(n)dhr sir chhatr ||
verses.translation: Many millions are the demi-gods, demons and Indras, under their regal canopies.
He has strung the entire creation upon His thread.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak jis jis bhaavai tis tis nisataarai ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He emancipates those with whom He is pleased. ||3||
Many millions abide in heated activity, slothful darkness and peaceful light.

verses.original: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਸਾਸਤ ॥
verses.translit: kiee koT bedh puraan simirat ar saasat ||
verses.translation: Many millions are the Vedas, Puraanas, Simritees and Shaastras.
Many millions are the pearls of the oceans.
Many millions are the beings of so many descriptions.
Many millions are made long-lived.

verses.original: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਗਿਰੀ ਮੇਰ ਸੁਵਰਨ ਥੀਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: kiee koT giree mer suvaran theeve ||
verses.translation: Many millions of hills and mountains have been made of gold.
Many millions are the Yakhshas - the servants of the god of wealth, the Kinnars - the gods of celestial music, and the evil spirits of the Pisaach.

verses.original: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਸੂਕਰ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਾਚ ॥
verses.translit: kiee koT bhoot pret sookar miragaach ||
verses.translation: Many millions are the evil nature-spirits, ghosts, pigs and tigers.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨੇਰੈ ਸਭਹੂ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh te nerai sabhahoo te dhoor ||
verses.translation: He is near to all, and yet far from all;
O Nanak, He Himself remains distinct, while yet pervading all. ||4||
Many millions inhabit the nether regions.
Many millions dwell in heaven and hell.
Many millions are born, live and die.
Many millions are reincarnated, over and over again.
Many millions eat while sitting at ease.
Many millions are exhausted by their labors.
Many millions are created wealthy.
Many millions are anxiously involved in Maya.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jeh bhaanaa teh teh raakhe ||
verses.translation: Wherever He wills, there He keeps us.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਹਾਥੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak sabh kichh prabh kai haathe ||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, everything is in the Hands of God. ||5||
Many millions become Bairaagees, who renounce the world.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam sa(n)g tin liv laagee ||
verses.translation: They have attached themselves to the Lord's Name.
Many millions are searching for God.
Within their souls, they find the Supreme Lord God.
Many millions thirst for the Blessing of God's Darshan.
They meet with God, the Eternal.
Many millions pray for the Society of the Saints.
They are imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.
Those with whom He Himself is pleased,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak te jan sadhaa dhan dha(n)n ||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, are blessed, forever blessed. ||6||
Many millions are the fields of creation and the galaxies.
Many millions are the etheric skies and the solar systems.
Many millions are the divine incarnations.
In so many ways, He has unfolded Himself.
So many times, He has expanded His expansion.
Forever and ever, He is the One, the One Universal Creator.
Many millions are created in various forms.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh te hoe prabh maeh samaat ||
verses.translation: From God they emanate, and into God they merge once again.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: taa kaa a(n)t na jaanai koi ||
verses.translation: His limits are not known to anyone.
Of Himself, and by Himself, O Nanak, God exists. ||7||
Many millions are the servants of the Supreme Lord God.
Their souls are enlightened.
Many millions know the essence of reality.
Their eyes gaze forever on the One alone.
Many millions drink in the essence of the Naam.

verses.original: ਅਮਰ ਭਏ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜੀਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: amar bhe sadh sadh hee jeeveh ||
verses.translation: They become immortal; they live forever and ever.
Many millions sing the Glorious Praises of the Naam.
They are absorbed in intuitive peace and pleasure.

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: apune jan kau saas saas samaare ||
verses.translation: He remembers His servants with each and every breath.
O Nanak, they are the beloveds of the Transcendent Lord God. ||8||10||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran prabh ek hai dhoosar naahee koi ||
verses.translation: God alone is the Doer of deeds - there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak tis balihaaranai jal thal maheeal soi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the One, who pervades the waters, the lands, the sky and all space. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
The Doer, the Cause of causes, is potent to do anything.
That which pleases Him, comes to pass.
In an instant, He creates and destroys.
He has no end or limitation.
By His Order, He established the earth, and He maintains it unsupported.
By His Order, the world was created; by His Order, it shall merge again into Him.
By His Order, one's occupation is high or low.
By His Order, there are so many colors and forms.
Having created the Creation, He beholds His own greatness.
O Nanak, He is pervading in all. ||1||
If it pleases God, one attains salvation.
If it pleases God, then even stones can swim.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਸ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh bhaavai bin saas te raakhai ||
verses.translation: If it pleases God, the body is preserved, even without the breath of life.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਭਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh bhaavai taa har gun bhaakhai ||
verses.translation: If it pleases God, then one chants the Lord's Glorious Praises.
If it pleases God, then even sinners are saved.
He Himself acts, and He Himself contemplates.
He Himself is the Master of both worlds.
He plays and He enjoys; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
As He wills, He causes actions to be done.
Nanak sees no other than Him. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kahu maanukh te kiaa hoi aavai ||
verses.translation: Tell me - what can a mere mortal do?
Whatever pleases God is what He causes us to do.

verses.original: ਇਸ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: eis kai haath hoi taa sabh kichh lei ||
verses.translation: If it were in our hands, we would grab up everything.
Whatever pleases God - that is what He does.
Through ignorance, people are engrossed in corruption.
If they knew better, they would save themselves.
Deluded by doubt, they wander around in the ten directions.

verses.original: ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: nimakh maeh chaar ku(n)T fir aavai ||
verses.translation: In an instant, their minds go around the four corners of the world and come back again.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa jis apanee bhagat dhei ||
verses.translation: Those whom the Lord mercifully blesses with His devotional worship
- O Nanak, they are absorbed into the Naam. ||3||

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਨੀਚ ਕੀਟ ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ॥
verses.translit: khin meh neech keeT kau raaj ||
verses.translation: In an instant, the lowly worm is transformed into a king.
The Supreme Lord God is the Protector of the humble.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kaa dhirasaT kachhoo na aavai ||
verses.translation: Even one who has never been seen at all,
becomes instantly famous in the ten directions.
And that one upon whom He bestows His blessings

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਨ ਗਨੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
verses.translit: taa kaa lekhaa na ganai jagadhees ||
verses.translation: the Lord of the world does not hold him to his account.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tis kee raas ||
verses.translation: Soul and body are all His property.
Each and every heart is illuminated by the Perfect Lord God.
He Himself fashioned His own handiwork.
Nanak lives by beholding His greatness. ||4||

verses.original: ਇਸ ਕਾ ਬਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਹਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: eis kaa bal naahee is haath ||
verses.translation: There is no power in the hands of mortal beings;
the Doer, the Cause of causes is the Lord of all.
The helpless beings are subject to His Command.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਥੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai soiee fun theeau ||
verses.translation: That which pleases Him, ultimately comes to pass.
Sometimes, they abide in exaltation; sometimes, they are depressed.
Sometimes, they are sad, and sometimes they laugh with joy and delight.
Sometimes, they are occupied with slander and anxiety.
Sometimes, they are high in the Akaashic Ethers, sometimes in the nether regions of the underworld.
Sometimes, they know the contemplation of God.
O Nanak, God Himself unites them with Himself. ||5||
Sometimes, they dance in various ways.
Sometimes, they remain asleep day and night.
Sometimes, they are awesome, in terrible rage.
Sometimes, they are the dust of the feet of all.
Sometimes, they sit as great kings.
Sometimes, they wear the coat of a lowly beggar.
Sometimes, they come to have evil reputations.
Sometimes, they are known as very, very good.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau prabh raakhai tiv hee rahai ||
verses.translation: As God keeps them, so they remain.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, the Truth is told. ||6||
Sometimes, as scholars, they deliver lectures.
Sometimes, they hold to silence in deep meditation.
Sometimes, they take cleansing baths at places of pilgrimage.
Sometimes, as Siddhas or seekers, they impart spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਕਬਹੂ ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤਿ ਪਤੰਗ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: kabahoo keeT hasat pata(n)g hoi jeeaa ||
verses.translation: Sometimes, they becomes worms, elephants, or moths.
They may wander and roam through countless incarnations.
In various costumes, like actors, they appear.
As it pleases God, they dance.
Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass.
O Nanak, there is no other at all. ||7||
Sometimes, this being attains the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਉਸੁ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aus asathaan te bahur na aavai ||
verses.translation: From that place, he does not have to come back again.
The light of spiritual wisdom dawns within.
That place does not perish.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: man tan naam rate ik ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: The mind and body are imbued with the Love of the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.
He dwells forever with the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜਲੁ ਆਇ ਖਟਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jiau jal meh jal aai khaTaanaa ||
verses.translation: As water comes to blend with water,
his light blends into the Light.
Reincarnation is ended, and eternal peace is found.
Nanak is forever a sacrifice to God. ||8||11||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਸੁਖੀ ਬਸੈ ਮਸਕੀਨੀਆ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਤਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: sukhee basai masakeeneeaa aap nivaar tale ||
verses.translation: The humble beings abide in peace; subduing egotism, they are meek.

verses.original: ਬਡੇ ਬਡੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਲੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: badde badde aha(n)kaareeaa naanak garab gale ||1||
verses.translation: The very proud and arrogant persons, O Nanak, are consumed by their own pride. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
One who has the pride of power within,
shall dwell in hell, and become a dog.
One who deems himself to have the beauty of youth,
shall become a maggot in manure.
One who claims to act virtuously,
shall live and die, wandering through countless reincarnations.

verses.original: ਧਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhan bhoom kaa jo karai gumaan ||
verses.translation: One who takes pride in wealth and lands
is a fool, blind and ignorant.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਬਸਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa jis kai hiradhai gareebee basaavai ||
verses.translation: One whose heart is mercifully blessed with abiding humility,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਈਹਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਆਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ieehaa mukat aagai sukh paavai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, is liberated here, and obtains peace hereafter. ||1||
One who becomes wealthy and takes pride in it

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: tiran samaan kachh sa(n)g na jaavai ||
verses.translation: not even a piece of straw shall go along with him.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਲਸਕਰ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: bahu lasakar maanukh uoopar kare aas ||
verses.translation: He may place his hopes on a large army of men,

verses.original: ਪਲ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: pal bheetar taa kaa hoi binaas ||
verses.translation: but he shall vanish in an instant.
One who deems himself to be the strongest of all,
in an instant, shall be reduced to ashes.
One who thinks of no one else except his own prideful self
the Righteous Judge of Dharma shall expose his disgrace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh jaa kaa miTai abhimaan ||
verses.translation: One who, by Guru's Grace, eliminates his ego,
O Nanak, becomes acceptable in the Court of the Lord. ||2||
If someone does millions of good deeds, while acting in ego,
he shall incur only trouble; all this is in vain.
If someone performs great penance, while acting in selfishness and conceit,
he shall be reincarnated into heaven and hell, over and over again.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਨਹੀ ਦ੍ਰਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: anik jatan kar aatam nahee dhravai ||
verses.translation: He makes all sorts of efforts, but his soul is still not softened
how can he go to the Court of the Lord?
One who calls himself good
goodness shall not draw near him.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sarab kee ren jaa kaa man hoi ||
verses.translation: One whose mind is the dust of all

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak taa kee niramal soi ||3||
verses.translation: - says Nanak, his reputation is spotlessly pure. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag jaanai mujh te kachh hoi ||
verses.translation: As long as someone thinks that he is the one who acts,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਇਸ ਕਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tab is kau sukh naahee koi ||
verses.translation: he shall have no peace.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਇਹ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jab ieh jaanai mai kichh karataa ||
verses.translation: As long as this mortal thinks that he is the one who does things,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: tab lag garabh jon meh firataa ||
verses.translation: he shall wander in reincarnation through the womb.
As long as he considers one an enemy, and another a friend,
his mind shall not come to rest.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag moh magan sa(n)g mai ||
verses.translation: As long as he is intoxicated with attachment to Maya,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tab lag dharam rai dhei sajai ||
verses.translation: the Righteous Judge shall punish him.
By God's Grace, his bonds are shattered;
by Guru's Grace, O Nanak, his ego is eliminated. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਹਸ ਖਟੇ ਲਖ ਕਉ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sahas khaTe lakh kau uTh dhaavai ||
verses.translation: Earning a thousand, he runs after a hundred thousand.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: tirapat na aavai maiaa paachhai paavai ||
verses.translation: Satisfaction is not obtained by chasing after Maya.
He may enjoy all sorts of corrupt pleasures,
but he is still not satisfied; he indulges again and again, wearing himself out, until he dies.
Without contentment, no one is satisfied.
Like the objects in a dream, all his efforts are in vain.
Through the love of the Naam, all peace is obtained.
Only a few obtain this, by great good fortune.
He Himself is Himself the Cause of causes.
Forever and ever, O Nanak, chant the Lord's Name. ||5||
The Doer, the Cause of causes, is the Creator Lord.
What deliberations are in the hands of mortal beings?
As God casts His Glance of Grace, they come to be.
God Himself, of Himself, is unto Himself.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੁ ਅਪਨੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh keeno su apanai ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: Whatever He created, was by His Own Pleasure.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ਸਭਹੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh te dhoor sabhahoo kai sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: He is far from all, and yet with all.
He understands, He sees, and He passes judgment.
He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the many.

verses.original: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: marai na binasai aavai na jai ||
verses.translation: He does not die or perish; He does not come or go.
O Nanak, He remains forever All-pervading. ||6||
He Himself instructs, and He Himself learns.
He Himself mingles with all.
He Himself created His own expanse.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kachh us kaa oh karanaihaar ||
verses.translation: All things are His; He is the Creator.

verses.original: ਉਸ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aus te bhi(n)n kahahu kichh hoi ||
verses.translation: Without Him, what could be done?
In the spaces and interspaces, He is the One.
In His own play, He Himself is the Actor.
He produces His plays with infinite variety.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: man meh aap man apune maeh ||
verses.translation: He Himself is in the mind, and the mind is in Him.
O Nanak, His worth cannot be estimated. ||7||
True, True, True is God, our Lord and Master.
By Guru's Grace, some speak of Him.
True, True, True is the Creator of all.
Out of millions, scarcely anyone knows Him.
Beautiful, Beautiful, Beautiful is Your Sublime Form.
You are Exquisitely Beautiful, Infinite and Incomparable.
Pure, Pure, Pure is the Word of Your Bani,
heard in each and every heart, spoken to the ears.
Holy, Holy, Holy and Sublimely Pure
- chant the Naam, O Nanak, with heart-felt love. ||8||12||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਨਿ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਰੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਉਧਰਨਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t saran jo jan parai so jan udharanahaar ||
verses.translation: One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Saints shall be saved.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kee ni(n)dhaa naanakaa bahur bahur avataar ||1||
verses.translation: One who slanders the Saints, O Nanak, shall be reincarnated over and over again. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Slandering the Saints, one's life is cut short.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kai dhookhan jam te nahee chhuTai ||
verses.translation: Slandering the Saints, one shall not escape the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kai dhookhan sukh sabh jai ||
verses.translation: Slandering the Saints, all happiness vanishes.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਨਰਕ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kai dhookhan narak meh pai ||
verses.translation: Slandering the Saints, one falls into hell.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਮਲੀਨ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kai dhookhan mat hoi maleen ||
verses.translation: Slandering the Saints, the intellect is polluted.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਤੇ ਹੀਨ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kai dhookhan sobhaa te heen ||
verses.translation: Slandering the Saints, one's reputation is lost.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਹਤੇ ਕਉ ਰਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t ke hate kau rakhai na koi ||
verses.translation: One who is cursed by a Saint cannot be saved.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਥਾਨ ਭ੍ਰਸਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kai dhookhan thaan bhrasaT hoi ||
verses.translation: Slandering the Saints, one's place is defiled.
But if the Compassionate Saint shows His Kindness,
O Nanak, in the Company of the Saints, the slanderer may still be saved. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੂਖਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਖੁ ਭਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t ke dhookhan te mukh bhavai ||
verses.translation: Slandering the Saints, one becomes a wry-faced malcontent.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਕਾਗ ਜਿਉ ਲਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan kai dhookhan kaag jiau lavai ||
verses.translation: Slandering the Saints, one croaks like a raven.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਸਰਪ ਜੋਨਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan kai dhookhan sarap jon pai ||
verses.translation: Slandering the Saints, one is reincarnated as a snake.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਿਰਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kai dhookhan tiragadh jon kiramai ||
verses.translation: Slandering the Saints, one is reincarnated as a wiggling worm.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਜਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan kai dhookhan tirasanaa meh jalai ||
verses.translation: Slandering the Saints, one burns in the fire of desire.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਛਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kai dhookhan sabh ko chhalai ||
verses.translation: Slandering the Saints, one tries to deceive everyone.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਤੇਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kai dhookhan tej sabh jai ||
verses.translation: Slandering the Saints, all one's influence vanishes.
Slandering the Saints, one becomes the lowest of the low.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਾ ਥਾਉ ਕੋ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t dhokhee kaa thaau ko naeh ||
verses.translation: For the slanderer of the Saint, there is no place of rest.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਓਇ ਭੀ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sa(n)t bhaavai taa oi bhee gat paeh ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, even then, he may be saved. ||2||
The slanderer of the Saint is the worst evil-doer.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਟਿਕਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kaa ni(n)dhak khin Tikan na paiee ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint has not even a moment's rest.
The slanderer of the Saint is a brutal butcher.
The slanderer of the Saint is cursed by the Transcendent Lord.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਹੀਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kaa ni(n)dhak raaj te heen ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint has no kingdom.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਅਰੁ ਦੀਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kaa ni(n)dhak dhukheeaa ar dheen ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint becomes miserable and poor.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਉ ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t ke ni(n)dhak kau sarab rog ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint contracts all diseases.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਜੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t ke ni(n)dhak kau sadhaa bijog ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint is forever separated.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੋਖ ਮਹਿ ਦੋਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kee ni(n)dhaa dhokh meh dhokh ||
verses.translation: To slander a Saint is the worst sin of sins.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਭੀ ਹੋਇ ਮੋਖੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak sa(n)t bhaavai taa us kaa bhee hoi mokh ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even this one may be liberated. ||3||
The slanderer of the Saint is forever impure.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਮਿਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee kisai kaa nahee mit ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint is nobody's friend.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਡਾਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kau ddaan laagai ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint shall be punished.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kau sabh tiaagai ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint is abandoned by all.
The slanderer of the Saint is totally egocentric.
The slanderer of the Saint is forever corrupt.
The slanderer of the Saint must endure birth and death.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਸੁਖ ਤੇ ਟਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kee dhookhanaa sukh te Tarai ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint is devoid of peace.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kau naahee Thaau ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint has no place of rest.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak sa(n)t bhaavai taa le milai ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even such a one may merge in union. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਅਧ ਬੀਚ ਤੇ ਟੂਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee adh beech te TooTai ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint breaks down mid-way.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee kitai kaaj na pahoochai ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint cannot accomplish his tasks.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kau udhiaan bhramaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint wanders in the wilderness.
The slanderer of the Saint is misled into desolation.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਅੰਤਰ ਤੇ ਥੋਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee a(n)tar te thothaa ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint is empty inside,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਸ ਬਿਨਾ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕੀ ਲੋਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: jiau saas binaa mritak kee lothaa ||
verses.translation: like the corpse of a dead man, without the breath of life.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕੀ ਜੜ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kee jaR kichh naeh ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint has no heritage at all.
He himself must eat what he has planted.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kau avar na raakhanahaar ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint cannot be saved by anyone else.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਲਏ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak sa(n)t bhaavai taa le ubaar ||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even he may be saved. ||5||
The slanderer of the Saint bewails like this
like a fish, out of water, writhing in agony.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਭੂਖਾ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee bhookhaa nahee raajai ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint is hungry and is never satisfied,
as fire is not satisfied by fuel.
The slanderer of the Saint is left all alone,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਬੂਆੜੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਖੇਤ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jiau booaaR til khet maeh dhuhelaa ||
verses.translation: like the miserable barren sesame stalk abandoned in the field.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਧਰਮ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee dharam te rahat ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint is devoid of faith.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਦ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਹਤ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee sadh mithiaa kahat ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint constantly lies.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਹੀ ਪਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kirat ni(n)dhak kaa dhur hee piaa ||
verses.translation: The fate of the slanderer is pre-ordained from the very beginning of time.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਥਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak jo tis bhaavai soiee thiaa ||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, whatever pleases God's Will comes to pass. ||6||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਬਿਗੜ ਰੂਪੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee bigaR roop hoi jai ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint becomes deformed.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kau dharageh milai sajai ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint receives his punishment in the Court of the Lord.
The slanderer of the Saint is eternally in limbo.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੀਵਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee na marai na jeevaieeaai ||
verses.translation: He does not die, but he does not live either.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕੀ ਪੁਜੈ ਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t ke dhokhee kee pujai na aasaa ||
verses.translation: The hopes of the slanderer of the Saint are not fulfilled.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee uTh chalai niraasaa ||
verses.translation: The slanderer of the Saint departs disappointed.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੋਖਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t kai dhokh na tirasaTai koi ||
verses.translation: Slandering the Saint, no one attains satisfaction.
As it pleases the Lord, so do people become;
no one can erase their past actions.
O Nanak, the True Lord alone knows all. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ghaT tis ke oh karanaihaar ||
verses.translation: All hearts are His; He is the Creator.
Forever and ever, I bow to Him in reverence.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee usatat karahu dhin raat ||
verses.translation: Praise God, day and night.
Meditate on Him with every breath and morsel of food.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kachh varatai tis kaa keeaa ||
verses.translation: Everything happens as He wills.
As He wills, so people become.
He Himself is the play, and He Himself is the actor.
Who else can speak or deliberate upon this?

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis no kirapaa karai tis aapan naam dhei ||
verses.translation: He Himself gives His Name to those, upon whom He bestows His Mercy.
Very fortunate, O Nanak, are those people. ||8||13||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਤਜਹੁ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸੁਰਿ ਜਨਹੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tajahu siaanap sur janahu simarahu har har rai ||
verses.translation: Give up your cleverness, good people - remember the Lord God, your King!

verses.original: ਏਕ ਆਸ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਰਖਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ek aas har man rakhahu naanak dhookh bharam bhau jai ||1||
verses.translation: Enshrine in your heart, your hopes in the One Lord. O Nanak, your pain, doubt and fear shall depart. ||1||
Ashtapadee:

verses.original: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਬ੍ਰਿਥੀ ਸਭ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: maanukh kee Tek birathee sabh jaan ||
verses.translation: Reliance on mortals is in vain - know this well.
The Great Giver is the One Lord God.
By His gifts, we are satisfied,
and we suffer from thirst no longer.
The One Lord Himself destroys and also preserves.
Nothing at all is in the hands of mortal beings.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis kaa hukam boojh sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: Understanding His Order, there is peace.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis kaa naam rakh ka(n)Th paroi ||
verses.translation: So take His Name, and wear it as your necklace.
Remember, remember, remember God in meditation.
O Nanak, no obstacle shall stand in your way. ||1||
Praise the Formless Lord in your mind.
O my mind, make this your true occupation.
Let your tongue become pure, drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar.
Your soul shall be forever peaceful.
With your eyes, see the wondrous play of your Lord and Master.
In the Company of the Holy, all other associations vanish.
With your feet, walk in the Way of the Lord.
Sins are washed away, chanting the Lord's Name, even for a moment.

verses.original: ਕਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar har karam sravan har kathaa ||
verses.translation: So do the Lord's Work, and listen to the Lord's Sermon.
In the Lord's Court, O Nanak, your face shall be radiant. ||2||
Very fortunate are those humble beings in this world,

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa har ke gun gaeh ||
verses.translation: who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, forever and ever.
Those who dwell upon the Lord's Name,
are the most wealthy and prosperous in the world.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: man tan mukh boleh har mukhee ||
verses.translation: Those who speak of the Supreme Lord in thought, word and deed
know that they are peaceful and happy, forever and ever.
One who recognizes the One and only Lord as One,

verses.original: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕੀ ਓਹੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: eit ut kee oh sojhee jaanai ||
verses.translation: understands this world and the next.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam sa(n)g jis kaa man maaniaa ||
verses.translation: One whose mind accepts the Company of the Naam,
the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, knows the Immaculate Lord. ||3||
By Guru's Grace, one understands himself;
know that then, his thirst is quenched.
In the Company of the Holy, one chants the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ਤੇ ਓਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਰਹਤ ॥
verses.translit: sarab rog te oh har jan rahat ||
verses.translation: Such a devotee of the Lord is free of all disease.
Night and day, sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the One Lord.
In the midst of your household, remain balanced and unattached.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: ek uoopar jis jan kee aasaa ||
verses.translation: One who places his hopes in the One Lord

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: tis kee kaTeeaai jam kee faasaa ||
verses.translation: the noose of Death is cut away from his neck.
One whose mind hungers for the Supreme Lord God,
O Nanak, shall not suffer pain. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis kau har prabh man chit aavai ||
verses.translation: One who focuses his conscious mind on the Lord God
- that Saint is at peace; he does not waver.
Those unto whom God has granted His Grace

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਡਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: so sevak kahu kis te ddarai ||
verses.translation: who do those servants need to fear?
As God is, so does He appear;
in His Own creation, He Himself is pervading.
Searching, searching, searching, and finally, success!
By Guru's Grace, the essence of all reality is understood.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਬ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੂਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: jab dhekhau tab sabh kichh mool ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there I see Him, at the root of all things.
O Nanak, He is the subtle, and He is also the manifest. ||5||

verses.original: ਨਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਨਮੈ ਨਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: neh kichh janamai neh kichh marai ||
verses.translation: Nothing is born, and nothing dies.
He Himself stages His own drama.
Coming and going, seen and unseen,
all the world is obedient to His Will.
He Himself is All-in-Himself.
In His many ways, He establishes and disestablishes.
He is Imperishable; nothing can be broken.
He lends His Support to maintain the Universe.
Unfathomable and Inscrutable is the Glory of the Lord.
As He inspires us to meditate, O Nanak, so do we meditate. ||6||
Those who know God are glorious.
The whole world is redeemed by their teachings.
God's servants redeem all.
God's servants cause sorrows to be forgotten.
The Merciful Lord unites them with Himself.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਪਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh jap bhe nihaal ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they become ecstatic.
He alone is committed to serve them,
upon whom God bestows His Mercy, by great good fortune.
Those who chant the Naam find their place of rest.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਉ ਊਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak tin purakh kau uootam kar maan ||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, respect those persons as the most noble. ||7||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh karai su prabh kai ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: Whatever you do, do it for the Love of God.
Forever and ever, abide with the Lord.
By its own natural course, whatever will be will be.
Acknowledge that Creator Lord;

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਨ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kaa keeaa jan meeTh lagaanaa ||
verses.translation: God's doings are sweet to His humble servant.
As He is, so does He appear.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jis te upaje tis maeh samaae ||
verses.translation: From Him we came, and into Him we shall merge again.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਉਨਹੂ ਬਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: oi sukh nidhaan unahoo ban aae ||
verses.translation: He is the treasure of peace, and so does His servant become.
Unto His own, He has given His honor.
O Nanak, know that God and His humble servant are one and the same. ||8||14||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਨਨਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sarab kalaa bharapoor prabh birathaa jaananahaar ||
verses.translation: God is totally imbued with all powers; He is the Knower of our troubles.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਉਧਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran udhareeaai naanak tis balihaar ||1||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on Him, we are saved; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
The Lord of the World is the Mender of the broken.
He Himself cherishes all beings.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sagal kee chi(n)taa jis man maeh ||
verses.translation: The cares of all are on His Mind;
no one is turned away from Him.

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: re man mere sadhaa har jaap ||
verses.translation: O my mind, meditate forever on the Lord.
The Imperishable Lord God is Himself All-in-all.
By one's own actions, nothing is accomplished,
even though the mortal may wish it so, hundreds of times.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin naahee terai kichh kaam ||
verses.translation: Without Him, nothing is of any use to you.

verses.original: ਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਏਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gat naanak jap ek har naam ||1||
verses.translation: Salvation, O Nanak, is attained by chanting the Name of the One Lord. ||1||
One who is good-looking should not be vain;

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਘਟ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee jot sagal ghaT sohai ||
verses.translation: the Light of God is in all hearts.
Why should anyone be proud of being rich?

verses.original: ਜਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੀਆ ਦਰਬੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa sabh kichh tis kaa dheeaa dharabai ||
verses.translation: All riches are His gifts.
One may call himself a great hero,

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਹ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee kalaa binaa keh dhaavai ||
verses.translation: but without God's Power, what can anyone do?
One who brags about giving to charities
the Great Giver shall judge him to be a fool.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੂਟੈ ਹਉ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis gur prasaadh tooTai hau rog ||
verses.translation: One who, by Guru's Grace, is cured of the disease of ego
- O Nanak, that person is forever healthy. ||2||
As a palace is supported by its pillars,

verses.original: ਤਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਸਥੰਮਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: tiau gur kaa sabadh maneh asatha(n)man ||
verses.translation: so does the Guru's Word support the mind.
As a stone placed in a boat can cross over the river,
so is the mortal saved, grasping hold of the Guru's Feet.
As the darkness is illuminated by the lamp,

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur dharasan dhekh man hoi bigaas ||
verses.translation: so does the mind blossom forth, beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥ ਤਿਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau mahaa udhiaan meh maarag paavai || tiau saadhoo sa(n)g mil jot pragaTaavai ||
verses.translation: The path is found through the great wilderness by joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and one's light shines forth.
I seek the dust of the feet of those Saints;
O Lord, fulfill Nanak's longing! ||3||
O foolish mind, why do you cry and bewail?
You shall obtain your pre-ordained destiny.
God is the Giver of pain and pleasure.
Abandon others, and think of Him alone.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo kachh karai soiee sukh maan ||
verses.translation: Whatever He does - take comfort in that.
Why do you wander around, you ignorant fool?
What things did you bring with you?
You cling to worldly pleasures like a greedy moth.
Dwell upon the Lord's Name in your heart.
O Nanak, thus you shall return to your home with honor. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਖਰ ਕਉ ਲੈਨਿ ਤੂ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis vakhar kau lain too aaiaa ||
verses.translation: This merchandise, which you have come to obtain
the Lord's Name is obtained in the home of the Saints.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੋਲਿ ॥ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਤੋਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: taj abhimaan leh man mol || raam naam hiradhe meh tol ||
verses.translation: Renounce your egotistical pride, and with your mind, purchase the Lord's Name - measure it out within your heart.
Load up this merchandise, and set out with the Saints.
Give up other corrupt entanglements.
"Blessed, blessed", everyone will call you,
and your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord.
In this trade, only a few are trading.
Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||5||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: charan saadh ke dhoi dhoi peeau ||
verses.translation: Wash the feet of the Holy, and drink in this water.
Dedicate your soul to the Holy.
Take your cleansing bath in the dust of the feet of the Holy.
To the Holy, make your life a sacrifice.
Service to the Holy is obtained by great good fortune.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is sung.
From all sorts of dangers, the Saint saves us.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gai a(n)mirat ras chaakhai ||
verses.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, we taste the ambrosial essence.
Seeking the Protection of the Saints, we have come to their door.
All comforts, O Nanak, are so obtained. ||6||
He infuses life back into the dead.
He gives food to the hungry.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sarab nidhaan jaa kee dhirasaTee maeh ||
verses.translation: All treasures are within His Glance of Grace.
People obtain that which they are pre-ordained to receive.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh tis kaa oh karanai jog ||
verses.translation: All things are His; He is the Doer of all.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਸਰ ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin dhoosar hoaa na hog ||
verses.translation: Other than Him, there has never been any other, and there shall never be.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jap jan sadhaa sadhaa dhin rainee ||
verses.translation: Meditate on Him forever and ever, day and night.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਇਹ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sabh te uooch niramal ieh karanee ||
verses.translation: This way of life is exalted and immaculate.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa jis kau naam dheeaa ||
verses.translation: One whom the Lord, in His Grace, blesses with His Name
- O Nanak, that person becomes immaculate and pure. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai man gur kee parateet ||
verses.translation: One who has faith in the Guru in his mind

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: tis jan aavai har prabh cheet ||
verses.translation: comes to dwell upon the Lord God.
He is acclaimed as a devotee, a humble devotee throughout the three worlds.
The One Lord is in his heart.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਹਤ ॥
verses.translit: sach karanee sach taa kee rahat ||
verses.translation: True are his actions; true are his ways.
True is his heart; Truth is what he speaks with his mouth.
True is his vision; true is his form.
He distributes Truth and he spreads Truth.
One who recognizes the Supreme Lord God as True
- O Nanak, that humble being is absorbed into the True One. ||8||15||
Shalok:

verses.original: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
verses.translit: roop na rekh na ra(n)g kichh tirahu gun te prabh bhi(n)n ||
verses.translation: He has no form, no shape, no color; God is beyond the three qualities.

verses.original: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tiseh bujhaae naanakaa jis hovai suprasa(n)n ||1||
verses.translation: They alone understand Him, O Nanak, with whom He is pleased. ||1||
Ashtapadee:
Keep the Immortal Lord God enshrined within your mind.
Renounce your love and attachment to people.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਪਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis te parai naahee kichh koi ||
verses.translation: Beyond Him, there is nothing at all.
The One Lord is pervading among all.
He Himself is All-seeing; He Himself is All-knowing,
Unfathomable, Profound, Deep and All-knowing.
He is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, the Lord of the Universe,
the Treasure of mercy, compassion and forgiveness.
To fall at the Feet of Your Holy Beings
- this is the longing of Nanak's mind. ||1||
The one who fulfills wishes and gives us Sanctuary.
That which He has written, comes to pass.

verses.original: ਹਰਨ ਭਰਨ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਫੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: haran bharan jaa kaa netr for ||
verses.translation: He destroys and creates in the blink of an eye.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis kaa ma(n)tr na jaanai hor ||
verses.translation: No one else knows the mystery of His ways.

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਦ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: anadh roop ma(n)gal sadh jaa kai ||
verses.translation: He is the embodiment of ecstasy and everlasting joy.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਸੁਨੀਅਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: sarab thok sune'eeh ghar taa kai ||
verses.translation: I have heard that all things are in His home.

verses.original: ਰਾਜ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: raaj meh raaj jog meh jogee ||
verses.translation: Among kings, He is the King; among yogis, He is the Yogi.

verses.original: ਤਪ ਮਹਿ ਤਪੀਸਰੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤ ਮਹਿ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: tap meh tapeesar girahasat meh bhogee ||
verses.translation: Among ascetics, He is the Ascetic; among householders, He is the Consummator.
By the constant practice of meditation, His devotee finds peace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak tis purakh kaa kinai a(n)t na paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, no one has found the limits of that Supreme Being. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee leelaa kee mit naeh ||
verses.translation: There is no limit to His play.
All the demigods have grown weary of searching for it.

verses.original: ਪਿਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੂਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: pitaa kaa janam k jaanai poot ||
verses.translation: What does the son know of his father's birth?
All are strung upon His string.

verses.original: ਸੁਮਤਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਦੇਇ ॥ ਜਨ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: sumat giaan dhiaan jin dhei || jan dhaas naam dhiaaveh sei ||
verses.translation: He bestows good sense, spiritual wisdom and meditation on His humble servants and slaves who meditate on the Naam.

verses.original: ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਰਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tih gun meh jaa kau bharamaae ||
verses.translation: He leads some astray in the three qualities;
they are born and die, coming and going over and over again.
The high and the low are His places.
As He inspires us to know Him, O Nanak, so is He known. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪ ਨਾਨਾ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
verses.translit: naanaa roop naanaa jaa ke ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: Many are His forms; many are His colors.
Many are the appearances which He assumes, and yet He is still the One.
In so many ways, He has extended Himself.
The Eternal Lord God is the One, the Creator.
He performs His many plays in an instant.
The Perfect Lord is pervading all places.
In so many ways, He created the creation.
He alone can estimate His worth.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ghaT tis ke sabh tis ke Thaau ||
verses.translation: All hearts are His, and all places are His.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jap jap jeevai naanak har naau ||4||
verses.translation: Nanak lives by chanting, chanting the Name of the Lord. ||4||
The Naam is the Support of all creatures.
The Naam is the Support of the earth and solar systems.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: naam ke dhaare simirat bedh puraan ||
verses.translation: The Naam is the Support of the Simritees, the Vedas and the Puraanas.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਸੁਨਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
verses.translit: naam ke dhaare sunan giaan dhiaan ||
verses.translation: The Naam is the Support by which we hear of spiritual wisdom and meditation.
The Naam is the Support of the Akaashic ethers and the nether regions.
The Naam is the Support of all bodies.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਸਭ ਭਵਨ ॥
verses.translit: naam ke dhaare pureeaa sabh bhavan ||
verses.translation: The Naam is the Support of all worlds and realms.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਸੁਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ॥
verses.translit: naam kai sa(n)g udhare sun sravan ||
verses.translation: Associating with the Naam, listening to it with the ears, one is saved.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਨੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa jis aapanai naam laae ||
verses.translation: Those whom the Lord mercifully attaches to His Naam

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਮਹਿ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak chauthe padh meh so jan gat paae ||5||
verses.translation: - O Nanak, in the fourth state, those humble servants attain salvation. ||5||

verses.original: ਰੂਪੁ ਸਤਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਤਿ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: roop sat jaa kaa sat asathaan ||
verses.translation: His form is true, and true is His place.
His personality is true - He alone is supreme.

verses.original: ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: karatoot sat sat jaa kee baanee ||
verses.translation: His acts are true, and true is His Word.
The True Lord is permeating all.

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਸਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: sat karam jaa kee rachanaa sat ||
verses.translation: True are His actions; His creation is true.
His root is true, and true is what originates from it.
True is His lifestyle, the purest of the pure.
All goes well for those who know Him.
The True Name of God is the Giver of peace.

verses.original: ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bisavaiaas sat naanak gur te paiee ||6||
verses.translation: Nanak has obtained true faith from the Guru. ||6||
True are the Teachings, and the Instructions of the Holy.

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ॥
verses.translit: sat te jan jaa kai ridhai praves ||
verses.translation: True are those into whose hearts He enters.
One who knows and loves the Truth

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam japat taa kee gat hoi ||
verses.translation: chanting the Naam, he obtains salvation.
He Himself is True, and all that He has made is true.
He Himself knows His own state and condition.
